roots.label: Collectable
roots.sub: Holotapes lying in the world: on the ground, in a container, on a body or in a terminal.

roots.label: Environmental
roots.sub: Holotapes you only get from quests, characters or rewards.

items.name: Blood Eagles - AshTrey
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: AshTrey
transcript.text: Maz Tabor, what a fool. I'm pretty sure he sent me and my crew here to whittle us down.

transcript.speaker: AshTrey
transcript.text: Scorched took out half of my squad. I'm screwed.

transcript.speaker: AshTrey
transcript.text: I better ramp up on some new recruits before I head back to la hacienda.

transcript.speaker: AshTrey
transcript.text: That son of a bitch sent us into an ambush intentionally!

items.name: Buck Nixon's Rockhound Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Buck Nixon
transcript.text: Whew, I'm damn glad that headquarters upgraded the Rockhound's power system.

transcript.speaker: Buck Nixon
transcript.text: Now that we have reactors installed, we can finally stop depending on the local power grid and diesel engines to keep this baby humming.

transcript.speaker: Buck Nixon
transcript.text: I can't even count the number of times the machine stalled because of blackouts or the engines quit.

transcript.speaker: Buck Nixon
transcript.text: Of course, working right next to four nuclear reactors isn't as cozy as it sounds.

transcript.speaker: Buck Nixon
transcript.text: The engineers say those things are perfectly safe, but they aren't the ones that'll be vaporized after a meltdown.

transcript.speaker: Buck Nixon
transcript.text: Still, those fat bonuses I've been getting on my paycheck are hard to ignore, so looks like I'll be staying for a while.

transcript.speaker: Buck Nixon
transcript.text: Anyway, it's almost time to change out the Ignition Cores. I'll record more later if I have the time.

items.name: Eviction Notice Recording: The Kaminskis
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: AMS Agent
transcript.text: Mr. and Mrs. Armand Kaminski. This is your final warning. Your domicile is situated on top of AMS property.

transcript.speaker: AMS Agent
transcript.text: You have 15 seconds to exit your home. If you do not do so, my men and I are well within our rights to remove you by force.
Don't think they're coming out, boys.

transcript.speaker: AMS Agent
transcript.text: Sir, this does not concern you. Please step back.
You company boys take our jobs. Take our dignity. Now you want our homes, too? I'd say it concerns me plenty.

transcript.speaker: AMS Agent
transcript.text: Sir, I'm going to ask you one more time. Get back in your house. The only people in trouble are the Kaminskis ... for now.
That's where you're wrong, son.

items.name: Isaac's Message to the Sloth
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: The majestic sloth.

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: So misunderstood. So intelligent.

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: Yes, they move cautiously. With great precision.

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: But it is not mere laziness, oh no, my friend.

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: It is... evolution.

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: So many of their predators with their keen sight. Adapted so well to catch prey in flight.

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: But do they catch you? No, no they don't.

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: I am just a branch, aren't you, my lovely?

transcript.speaker: Isaac Garrahan
transcript.text: Don't worry. Your protector... Your savior, Master Isaac, yes, I will keep you safe.

items.name: Janelle's Revenge

location.text: Found near Hornwright Air Purifier Site #04.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: Raymond is dead. I heard his scream, I heard the beast's howl. I know it was him. He's gone.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: I told him in my note at camp not to follow me. Why didn't he listen?

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: I tracked this monster down to a cave towards Beckley. He... he has to be between the cave and the pond.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: This beast has a litter of pups. I was going to call the hunt off entirely... but now... now I'm finishing it. For good.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: I'll go to Beckley and get help after I'm done with it. Then we'll... take care of Raymond. My poor dear fool.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: *cocks gun*

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: I should have killed that beast when I had the chance. I'm coming for you, you piece of ---

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: *screaming*

items.name: Join the Auto-Miners Support Squad!
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Hornwright Recruiter
transcript.text: Looking for a new career? Like working with your hands? Finding solutions to challenging problems? Fixing complex machinery in exciting environments?

transcript.speaker: Hornwright Recruiter
transcript.text: Then its time you joined the Hornwright Industrial Auto-Miner Support Squads!

transcript.speaker: Hornwright Recruiter
transcript.text: We're looking for talented men ... and gals! ... interested in earning good pay for hard work...

transcript.speaker: Hornwright Recruiter
transcript.text: ... keeping Hornwright Industrial's fleet of advanced Auto-Mining robots active and kicking!

transcript.speaker: Hornwright Recruiter
transcript.text: Pop the Hornwright recruitment booth in downtown Charleston and sign-up today!

items.name: Klein's Notes, Part 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Officer Sidney
transcript.text: Alright, stay close, let's creep up to the corner here.

transcript.speaker: Officer Klein
transcript.text: A fancy suit... dark glasses... and a motive for... murder?

transcript.speaker: Officer Sidney
transcript.text: You can't seriously be recording still.

transcript.speaker: Officer Klein
transcript.text: Does it matter? Look, he's just making repairs on that grill.

transcript.speaker: Wolf
transcript.text: Good afternoon, gentlemen.

transcript.speaker: Wolf
transcript.text: *Silenced gun shots, footsteps along wood floor*

items.name: Life with Calvin
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: My little brother, Calvin, and I grew up in this strange old place. Our folks ran the shop downstairs and when they passed, the business ended up with me.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Calvin was always the odd sort... and smart, too. After college, he ran off to work for some big-shot company out of state. Barely heard from him after that.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Calvin has... conditions; obsessions. A "research project?" I didn't buy it. It wouldn't surprise me if this had nothing to do with his job, if he even had one.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: (sigh) The last time I saw Calvin was right before I went away for the weekend. Not even a goodbye. When I came back, he was gone.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: The only thing Calvin ever cared about was this god damn Sheepsquatch... I know that's the root of his disappearance, I have no doubt about it.

items.name: My Name's James
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: My name is James.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: And I like trains.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: So here I sit.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: Waiting in vain.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: The trains don't go.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: Since the world did blow!

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: Now it's just James.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: And a pile of dead trains.
James? James! There you are! You can't keep coming back here! It's not-- shit. Put your mask back on. Lets go!

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: Sorry, papa.

items.name: Note to Self
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Calvin van Lowe
transcript.text: Note to, uh, self. Calvin. Keep it together.

transcript.speaker: Calvin van Lowe
transcript.text: I have... I mean, "You" have a real job to do. You can't be distracted by your academic pursuits-- no, no, "fantasies." This is too important.

transcript.speaker: Calvin van Lowe
transcript.text: <sigh> But if you're listening to this, it means you're slipping. So, repeat after me: the Sheepsquatch isn't real. The Sheepsquatch... isn't real....

transcript.speaker: Calvin van Lowe
transcript.text: But... if it is, then I could... Interesting, I hadn't considered that. I wonder if I still have that article... No! Hey! No! Stay focused, stay on task!

transcript.speaker: Calvin van Lowe
transcript.text: If you screw up, you know what will happen... So... This is so stupid. Calvin. Me. Just... concentrate. God... and get back to work!

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 5
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's personal journal.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Vault 76 was built to take the best and brightest, but... that wasn't what all the Vaults were for.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The Societal Preservation Program. I wasn't supposed to know about it, but when I found out...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Evan wanted me to tell the press, but... I didn't.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Yes, experimenting on Vault residents was ethically wrong, but the goal of finding the most suitable people to repopulate, to understand humanity pushed to the extremes, what if that was the only way for us to survive?

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: We can't save everyone. That's what they always told us. And I thought... I still think... they were right.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Vault-Tec found out that I knew. I thought I was going to be fired, or arrested, but instead they confided in me. Vault 76 was going to be a control Vault. No experiment.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I was so relieved, but... they told me I was going to be assigned to Vault 101, in Washington DC. I had to leave West Virginia... my people... behind.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I couldn't let them do that. No matter what it took.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, Evan. I wish I could say I would've made another choice. That I would've picked dying in this house together when the bombs fell.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I never stopped thinking about you, and I'm not giving up until I find out what happened. If you're not here, then there's only one other place you'd want to be. The mines.

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 6
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's... Overseer's personal journal...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I found him. Evan. He's down there, just like I thought he'd be. But I... I didn't think he'd be... one of those things. The green lesions on his face...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Oh god... I did this to him. It's all my fault.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: They told me I could have Vault 76, but not... not if I was married. They would've had to give Evan a spousal exemption and give him space in the Vault.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: But... there was someone more qualified. A civil engineer, someone with the skills to help rebuild. He was a distant cousin of a Vault-Tec executive and almost made the cut...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: 76 was for the best and brightest, and Evan didn't qualify. Deep down, I knew they were right.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: So I broke off the engagement. I... sacrificed him. For the Vault. For Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I know what I have to do, but I... I just can't. I love him. I already killed him once, I can't do it again.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Please, I gave 76 everything. You were all so brilliant. The first few years were hard, but we learned to trust each other. You learned to trust me. I was young... So young... Younger than most of you. But you accepted me as your Overseer.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: So I need you to do this for me. Let Evan rest. He didn't deserve any of this.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The Scorched. Eliminating this plague. It's not just about survival now. It's personal. We have to secure the nukes. Wipe this disease off the map.

items.name: Project Vulcan Log #01: Goals
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log. Day one.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Today we begin an undertaking with the potential to reshape the very nature of energy.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: The true power of Ultracite -- a fountain of untold potential -- will be revealed to us.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: We are all well aware now of Atomic Mining Services' exploitation of this material.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: That is nothing new, and we do not intend to expand on its usage merely as an energy source.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: No, this project, codenamed 'Vulcan,' has a different aim. For while others simply use Ultracite, we intend to understand it.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: That, ladies and gentlemen, is where the true power lies.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Our understanding of Ultracite -- how it is created, how it grows -- will assure our dominance for generations to come.

items.name: Project Vulcan Log #02: Direction
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log. The fundamental course of our experiments is in debate.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: I stand for sonic wave manipulation to stimulate crystal growth. Dr. Robert Gaines argues that radiation treatment is the only path forward.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: To be frank, the heart of the impasse is Robert's popularity... The science is on my side, but the rank and file favor his approach.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: The people here are raw and soft. Fewer true believers than I'd like, even among management. Any attempt to overrule him may lead to rebellion.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: It seems inevitable that we will pursue a dead-end course.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: The weakness of the masses may doom Vulcan before it even begins -- then management will have all our heads.

items.name: Project Vulcan Log #03: Breakthrough
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Though our early experiments yielded little in the way of results, we've finally made a breakthrough -- and the credit goes to me!

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: It was only a matter of adjusting the wave frequency, just as I insisted. And now the bastards have no choice but to admit it.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Robert is finished -- professionally, anyway. His influence still lingers, but I'll make short work of that.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: We'll make something of Vulcan yet. For the glory of the Enclave!

items.name: Project Vulcan Log #04: Ultragenesis
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log. Things are progressing well.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: The Ultracite is reacting, more than we ever imagined. The growth is wild, untamed, dangerous.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: I can hear the plaudits now. If we can harness this new power, this 'Ultragenesis,' then we really will be the masters of Ultracite.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: The Enclave will be truly unstoppable!

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: But how to harness it? I have a few ideas -- building on Robert's research, ironically. Not that he's around to see his theories reach fruition.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Torn apart by his own experiments... A tale as old as time! It looked ever so painful. I do hope they find that saboteur soon.

items.name: Project Vulcan Log #05: Disaster
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Dr. Esther Wright, personal log. Agitation among the staff.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Exposure to the empowered Ultracite has resulted in disturbing behavior.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: We have observed a marked increase in paranoia, delusions, and hysteria among the infected. There have been casualties.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: The staff blames me for everything... Robert's influence yet lingers. Even in death he'll be my undoing.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Don't they understand this is simply a setback? Scientific advancement demands sacrifice. The timidity of these bastards boils my blood.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: Management commandeered my defensive measures. There will be a trial, in Enclave style of course, meaning this will be my last message.

transcript.speaker: Esther Wright
transcript.text: I regret nothing. Glory to the Enclave! And a curse on the gutless traitors that doomed Project Vulcan!

items.name: Raymond's Pep Talk

location.text: Found near Hornwright Air Purifier Site #04.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: It's a long drive, so I may as well rehearse this before I say it to her face. Breathe, Raymond... you can do it. She'll listen.

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: Ok, ok. I'm gonna say... "Janelle, honey, I will help you kill this critter but we gotta get back to basics so the business can survive."

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: Hmm.. maybe I should remind her that none of the experimental taxidermies sold last month. Ugh. No, that's mean. She loved making them.

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: Ok, ok, ok. Let's see. More supportive. "I want you to keep being able to make your art... it brings a smile to your face that I always want to see."

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: "But going off to hunt real... monsters? It's too dangerous! We're just trappers, and most of what we get is roadkill!" *sigh*

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: "Calvin buys almost all our stock every month. It's good money. It's enough for your weird.. art..." No! Don't make her feel bad, damn it.

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: Ok, I should just go drop these cages off and go find her. I'm making a big deal over nothing. We can figure this out together.

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: *turns off engine*

transcript.speaker: Raymond
transcript.text: Ok, I'm here. Now... I need to drop off these cages by the pond and then I'll go to her tent. I can do this.

items.name: Surveillance System Tape - 8/08/77
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Agent Danger
transcript.text: Agent Danger, reporting, ma'am.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Oh, it's Agent Danger today?

transcript.speaker: Agent Danger
transcript.text: Yes, ma'am. Agent Tornado's retired. Too much collateral damage during missions.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Is that so?

transcript.speaker: Agent Danger
transcript.text: Yes. Momma said we can't play Agent Tornado anymore. Didn't say anything about Agent Danger.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Well, aren't you a sharp cookie.

transcript.speaker: Agent Danger
transcript.text: That doesn't sound like a particularly good cookie, ma'am.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Hmm. I suppose it doesn't. Now, to what do I owe the distinct pleasure?

transcript.speaker: Agent Danger
transcript.text: Momma said, go ask Ms. Duchess if she can cop us a two extra tabs of Buffout. Gerald can't work without it and she knows we're good for it.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Momma sent you to do her begging.

transcript.speaker: Agent Danger
transcript.text: Yes, ma'am.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Because she knows you're my one weakness in this world.

transcript.speaker: Agent Danger
transcript.text: Uh, I think so, ma'am.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Agent Danger, would you be willing to take a mission for me? I need three of the coldest, iciest Nuka-Colas they've got down at Wabash's.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: If I gave you some money, would you be willing to go get them for me? One of 'em's got your name on it.

transcript.speaker: Agent Danger
transcript.text: Agent Danger can do that!

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: That's my girl. Go quick and you can have Butch's too!

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: ... Butch.
Yes, ma'am?

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Go pay Betty a visit. Let her know this is the last credit she's ever getting.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: I'll keep Agent Danger occupied while you make your point crystal clear.
Yes, ma'am.

items.name: The 197 from DC
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Ed
transcript.text: You got that thing recording, Walter?

transcript.speaker: Walter
transcript.text: It's on.

transcript.speaker: Ed
transcript.text: Good. Dan, tell him what you told me.
Uh, yeah. Sure. So we were unloading the 197 from DC. Huge set of containers. Industrial-sized. Locked up like Fort Knox.

transcript.speaker: Walter
transcript.text: Uh huh.
And as soon as it's off the train, this creepy guy in a suit comes out of nowhere, starts questioning me.

transcript.speaker: Walter
transcript.text: Wait. The 197?
Yeah. Guy said his name was Grey. Kept asking what I was doing. If I'd seen anything.

transcript.speaker: Ed
transcript.text: See! I told you, Walter. There's something screwy going on. This is the third shipment this month--

transcript.speaker: Walter
transcript.text: Look, I don't know what you think you saw, but there is no 197 out of DC. Here. Can look at the manifest yourself.
But, but that's not true. We saw it. We unloaded the damn thing.

transcript.speaker: Walter
transcript.text: Boys, there is no 197 from DC. And if you know what's good for you, you'll stop asking questions about it. Now gimme that tape.

items.name: Thoughts of the Day
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Brandon managed to stick me with cleanup duty underneath the Widowmaker.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Apparently, some group of kids really lost their lunch on there.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Typical vomit chain... All it takes is one, and the rest follow suit.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: The pics were priceless by the way.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: But the real joke's on Brandon. I found a 100 dollar bill down there plus the usual change.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: People say it's not worth it, but I gotta get out of here somehow... and if sifting through barf for cash makes that work, so be it.

items.name: Top of the World Ad Packet

location.text: Found near Sal's Grinders, near Beckley Mine Exhibit, near Beckley.

routes.name: near Sal's Grinders, near Beckley Mine Exhibit, near Beckley

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Have you ever wondered how to grow your business and expand your reach to thousands of new customers every day?

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Allow me to welcome you to the exciting world of radio marketing with Pleasant Valley Ski Resort!

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: We broadcast 24/7 from the Top of the World, reaching the ears of countless locals and vacationers along Appalachia's greatest peaks and valleys.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: So tune in and check us out. Pick up the phone and call to set up an appointment with our marketing team.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: We guarantee your business will boom!

items.name: Vulcan Security Log #01
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Captain Holloway, Vulcan Research Laboratory. With the EN06 deployed out front, I'm confident that intruders pose little threat to this facility.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Thing has more ordinance than a heavy bomber. Any unauthorized anything that walks in here will be dusted faster than a cowboy says 'howdy.'

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: No, our problems will come from within. Never trust a scientist, I say. Heads get too big for their own good.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: They always build some machine or breed some monster that goes crazy and kills half or more of the people who gave it its unwanted life.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Seen it too many times to count...

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Luckily, management's on my side for once. If any one of these brainiacs steps out of line, we'll be sure to take care of it ASAP.

items.name: Vulcan Security Log #02
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Holloway's log. The eggheads are at it already.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Dr. Gaines was working in the lab, shooting soundwaves at crystals and pissing off his mutated test subject.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Well what happens when you piss off a mutie? It breaks out of its cage and turns you into a human pretzel.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: They all swore that 'protocols were in place,' that they'd 'double checked.' We saw how well that worked out.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Won't be the first time, won't be the last. Shame, though. Of all these schmucks, I liked him the best.

items.name: Vulcan Security Log #03
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Captain John Holloway, personal log. I knew it would come to this...

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Give these science types an ounce of control and what do they do with it? Lose it immediately. Never fails.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: I told you, didn't I? Build a machine and grow a forest of radioactive crystals, it makes everyone crazy and people start dying.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Management was quick to act, but not quick enough, I reckon. We've got the place on lockdown, but who knows how long we'll last before the 'fear' gets us, too.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: The Epsilons were called in -- that means extermination mode. Normally I'd find comfort in that, but they're not acting right.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Not sure I'll make it out this time. If anyone finds this, Jimmy gets my car and Sharon my bottlecap collection.

transcript.speaker: John Holloway
transcript.text: Rick gets nothing, and that's more than he deserves.

items.name: Wolf's Message to Bo-Peep
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Wolf
transcript.text: Bo Peep, you failed to make our meeting. How very unlike you.

transcript.speaker: Wolf
transcript.text: I'm going to give you the benefit of the doubt. You never struck me as someone who would skip town when things go south.

transcript.speaker: Wolf
transcript.text: I'm going to take a walk in the park. Maybe we'll bump into each other.

transcript.speaker: Wolf
transcript.text: If I get back and you're here, then I'll forget all about that missed meeting.

transcript.speaker: Wolf
transcript.text: If I get back and you're not? Then we have a problem.

items.name: Your Order's Arrived
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Hello Mick.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Wanted to let you know I've procured those tools you and your boys were asking after.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Along with all the nails and safety equipment you could need.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: But we don't do deliveries.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Bring the money to my place in Welch.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: You know where to find the Duchess.

items.name: A Special Surprise
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Here we are. It's a beautiful Saturday night.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: The merger's complete, and after all his hard work, my dear Stratton will have a special surprise waiting for him: me! *excited giggle*

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Now that everything's done, he has no reason to reject me. And how our love will bloom, like it was always meant to!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *calling out* Stratton, dear? Are you home? Stratton?

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *gasp* No... No, no, no, no! Not breathing... Oh god! *sobbing* You were here all along and I... What happened to you? Did someone...?

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *viciously* Brutus.

items.name: Stella Meets Stratton
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: You're new here. I know all my regulars. How did you like the show?

transcript.speaker: Stratton
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but that spot's taken.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: I don't see anyone taking it. A shame... Whoever stood you up clearly doesn't see what they're missing.

transcript.speaker: Stratton
transcript.text: They're missing the opportunity of a lifetime. If we don't close this merger, it's- You wouldn't understand.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Forget the merger, honey. Forget all of it. You're here with me now, isn't that right?

transcript.speaker: Stratton
transcript.text: No, I'm- I can't be distracted by this right now. Security! I need help with this dancer- Wait, wait! No, it's not me! I'm the one being harassed!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Now, Brutus, hold on. Don't be so rough with him. Brutus! *sigh* What a dolt. I was just getting interested...

items.name: The Final Scene
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Theatre Tech
transcript.text: And... lights.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *door slams open* There you are, you big, stupid animal!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: How could you do this to me? How could you do any of it?! If you truly loved me... you should have backed off!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: No! Don't come any closer! Don't!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *gunshots, followed by a heavy thud, and crying*

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: It was never supposed to be like this... We had love, all of us. Brutus, for me. Me, for Stratton. Stratton... for his job. We all had so much love.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Maybe, after all... It was too much. Maybe... I caused all this...

transcript.speaker: Theatre Tech
transcript.text: Something's wrong. We have to stop the rehearsal.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Oh, for Christ's sake. We're not going to stop- *gunshot*

transcript.speaker: Theatre Tech
transcript.text: Shit! I think they're dead for real!

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Tomorrow is opening night. They can't be dead! Wake up, you idiots!

transcript.speaker: Theatre Tech
transcript.text: Someone replaced the prop gun! Hurry, get a doctor!

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: God damn it! All this work for nothing. *sigh* Well, they're better dead than incompetent.

items.name: Ticking Clock
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: The last time I spoke into one of these was during an interview with a muckraker before the bombs. Ironic.

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: Some nobody farmer from the outskirts of the city came knocking at my door today. Tracked his muddy boots all over City Hall.

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: Said that I've done a terrible job as mayor, and it's about time someone did something about it. As if someone of his ilk could do better!

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: He told me I have two options. Either I leave and get to keep my head, or he blows it off me. I say let him try!

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: He's not the first loon to try to usurp me, that's for sure. Plenty more have tried and failed, and they had a lot more power than Timothy Lane.

transcript.speaker: Carly Day
transcript.text: I'm not going anywhere. My security detail will make quick work of him. Maybe I'll even have Quentino's boys teach him a lesson.

items.name: EV-21 Blackbox Recording
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Pilot
transcript.text: Damn...

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: How much longer till we get there, pilot?

transcript.speaker: Pilot
transcript.text: Not much longer, sir. ETA should be another 45 minutes.

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: Right...right.

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: Do you think you could ease up?

transcript.speaker: The Rust King
transcript.text: *groans*

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: All this turbulence might wake the subject.

transcript.speaker: Pilot
transcript.text: Apologies, sir. I'll see what-

transcript.speaker: The Rust King
transcript.text: *groaning*

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: Oh God...

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: We have to land, right now!

transcript.speaker: Pilot
transcript.text: But sir, we need to-

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: Land the god-damn bird! Now!

transcript.speaker: The Rust King
transcript.text: *roaring*

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: Land now! Get us down now!

transcript.speaker: Pilot
transcript.text: *Pained scream*

transcript.speaker: The Rust King
transcript.text: Pathetic *roaring*

transcript.speaker: Enclave Officer
transcript.text: *terrified screams*

items.name: Professor Metter's Log
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Professor Franklin Metter
transcript.text: The marauders found me on the road from ruined Athens. Stumbling from the ruins of the world, my life. *coughing* The early days were difficult.

transcript.speaker: Professor Franklin Metter
transcript.text: These murderers, now my people. are a far cry from the University's engineering department. They are the raw clay from which I sculpt survival.

transcript.speaker: Professor Franklin Metter
transcript.text: The land is compromised. Unclean. It's the bombs. It's Abraxodyne's product, irradiated, aerosolized, cast wide--far past the point of saturation.

transcript.speaker: Professor Franklin Metter
transcript.text: I teach my supplicants to temper themselves, that they may adapt to life in this world. I allow them the knowledge I permit, and no more.

transcript.speaker: Professor Franklin Metter
transcript.text: In the shadow of this cave, I give them a show. Fire and brimstone! Harden and sharpen them into something that endures. *coughing*

items.name: "That boy"
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amelia
transcript.text: Mom, "that boy" isn't a hippy, he's an artist. Hippies are poor. He's loaded.

transcript.speaker: Amelia
transcript.text: And that's not drugs, that's patchouli... okay, and maybe with a little sweat mixed in. I think it's sexy smelling.

transcript.speaker: Amelia
transcript.text: Just tell those stuck up hags to get a grip. They don't just let anyone live here. He's bona fide.

items.name: Accident
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: All right, settle down now. I'm listening.

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: You recording this?! You agreed this was gonna be private.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: This is just so we all have a record of what's discussed, is all.

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: Yeah right. You're going to use that to get me canned.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: Look, I'm on your side. I --

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: The hell you are!

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: I AM on your side. But I got a boss, too. I've kept as many of you on as I could -

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: At a quarter of our wages.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: Billy, I -

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: Cut our wages.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: Damnit can I finish a sentence?!

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: ... It was either that or cut more of you completely. I couldn't do that. We're all family here. I'm trying. This isn't easy for any of us.

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: It's easier for those damn eggheads.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: I know. I don't like those pocket protectors any more than you. I'd put them out on their scrawny butts if I could.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: But, like it or not, that glass of theirs is paying the bills.

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: Not my bills, it ain't.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: What would you have me do, Billy? Really.

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: What's one them scientist salaries? Got to be, what, ten of ours. What if there was a little... "accident?"

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: ... Billy! You aren't being serious!

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: Maybe I am, maybe I ain't. All I'm saying -- what the...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: *Sound of distant explosion*

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: There's nothing scheduled that'd cause a quake like that. What the hell was that?!

transcript.speaker: Billy
transcript.text: Wa'nt ain't me, boss... Honest!

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: Respirators. Now!

items.name: Bad news
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jake
transcript.text: I don't like it, Sam. Not one bit. They want to drop a nuke down here? And what for again? To get some kind of radioactive glass out?

transcript.speaker: Jake
transcript.text: What'd that labcoat call it, "Ultracite?" You and I both know the main shaft is barely holding together. This is bad news. Don't you let them do it!

items.name: Be more careful

location.text: Found at Watoga Civic Center, Watoga Raider Arena.

routes.name: Watoga Civic Center, Watoga Raider Arena

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Madelyn
transcript.text: Eugene! You got to tell me when you're going to program them to fail. I lost five big-ones last night. Jesus.

transcript.speaker: Madelyn
transcript.text: Also, I found the holotape I left you just laying around. Be more careful!

items.name: Betsy Spinelli's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.
items.contents: A terminal holotape: load it into your Pip-Boy or a terminal to read it.

items.name: Bogged Down
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: Great job, Tieggs. Now what are we supposed to do?!

transcript.speaker: Initiate Tieggs
transcript.text: How was I supposed to know the vehicles would sink into the bog?

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: They weigh something like 60 tons, genius. Of course they're going to sink.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Tieggs
transcript.text: I didn't hear you chiming in with all this wisdom after I hot-wired the damn things.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Tieggs
transcript.text: And it was your idea to bring them back to Paladin Taggerdy. No, no, no. I'm not taking any blame for this.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: I didn't tell you to actually do it, I was just saying it would be great if the Brotherhood had these in their arsenal.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Tieggs
transcript.text: Look, maybe we can go get another one and try to tow them out of there.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: Are you nuts?

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: First of all, we'd be abandoning our post.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: And second of all, do you even know if there are any more armored vehicles we can use around here? No.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Tieggs
transcript.text: Sigh. Sorry, I was just trying to help.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: Well, there isn't much we can do about it now.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: Look, um... we're all strung out from these long duty shifts.

transcript.speaker: Initiate Fowler
transcript.text: Why don't I take first watch so you can get some rest?

transcript.speaker: Initiate Tieggs
transcript.text: Thanks, Fowler. You're the best.

items.name: BoS Archive: ARP Background
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Is the connection good?

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: Yeah. I'm reading you.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Excellent. I'm transmitting the program now. We'll send it multiple times. The static is playing hell with data integrity.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: Three copies should be enough to deal with any corruption.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: We've wracked our brains over here and we've come across a solution for where you can use this program. Vault-Tec University. Can you get there?

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: VTU? Shit. That's in the heart of Responder territory.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Who? That's not important. If the facility is still operational they have a fully Automated Research Lab. It's perfect.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: Do you have any other options?

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: No. We don't. Keep transmitting any viable DNA sample you get of these... Scorchbeasts.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: We'll help as long as we can. But if we go dark, that lab can give you the information you need.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Our preliminary research... Well, it's a possible mass extinction event if the threat isn't contained.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: ...Jesus.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Listen, if we don't talk again... Know that our thoughts are with you, Grant.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: Thanks. Appalachia out.

items.name: BoS Report - Antique Store
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: Scouting report. Brotherhood Squire Schultz.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: This old antique store has been a good source of supplies. I've stashed some weapons and ammo in the shed out back.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: Scavenging runs into Watoga have been... mixed. The robots are everywhere and you never know when a turret is going to pop out of its hiding place and start filling the area with lead or laser fire.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: I really should've paid more attention to during training.

items.name: BoS Report - Kerwood
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: Scouting report. Brotherhood Squire Schultz.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: Kerwood Mine is almost completely flooded. Going down into that brine without Power Armor or a stronger set of lungs seems suicidal.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: It's too bad. My recon instincts are telling me there could be something good down there. Maybe a way into that locked room.

items.name: BoS Report - Trainyard
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: Scouting report. Brotherhood Squire Schultz.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: This whole trainyard is half-sunk in the ground. Anyone in the middle of that mess is just begging for a sniper to pick them off.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: These two warehouses seem to be the only good defensible position. There's a nice walkway between them and plenty of places to get the drop on someone.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: Heh. I might actually be getting the hang of this.

items.name: BoS Report - Watoga Plaza
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: Scouting report. Brotherhood Squire Schultz.

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: Everything in this entire shopping plaza is a load of junk. I thought this place was meant for rich people. Why were they buying all this crap?

transcript.speaker: Squire Schultz
transcript.text: At least the storefronts give you plenty of places to hide. The bots are everywhere. Might be the only things worth salvaging if I could get the drop on one.

items.name: Concerned Mother
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Scarlett
transcript.text: Headmaster Reinhold, this so-called "SMART" vending machine you have set up during the Halloween season appears virtuous, as it encourages children to trade in candy for useful items.

transcript.speaker: Scarlett
transcript.text: If this was all it was, it would be a fine device which I would argue should be installed year round.

transcript.speaker: Scarlett
transcript.text: However, it has an insidious immoral quality, that might have gone unnoticed, so I shall helpfully point it out to you.

transcript.speaker: Scarlett
transcript.text: The machine promotes gambling in children by use of randomized prizes for large candy deposits. Gambling is an immoral activity and carries with it a risk of addiction and abuse.

transcript.speaker: Scarlett
transcript.text: If this machine cannot be reprogrammed to remove the randomization from the rewards, I must insist the device be removed from school property immediately.

items.name: De Silva's Recon Report
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Hannah de Silva
transcript.text: Recon notes to self. I knew it. I remember coming here on a school field trip.

transcript.speaker: Hannah de Silva
transcript.text: The walls are as strong as I remember.

transcript.speaker: Hannah de Silva
transcript.text: Paladin's going to love it. Power lines run underground and connect up to Thunder Mountain.

transcript.speaker: Hannah de Silva
transcript.text: And so much space to grow into.

transcript.speaker: Hannah de Silva
transcript.text: But boy is the whole thing a fixer upper. And the smell.

transcript.speaker: Hannah de Silva
transcript.text: And there's the small problem of the Ghouls. But we've got Power Armor and miniguns for that.

transcript.speaker: Hannah de Silva
transcript.text: Do I want to live in a madhouse? Well, it's better than being crammed in like sardines at Venture.

transcript.speaker: Hannah de Silva
transcript.text: De Silva out.

items.name: Elder Maxson's Final Conversation
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Lizzy. Takano says the satellite's failing. So this is it.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Elder, I'm not ready for this. Can't the Scribes do anything about it?

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: No. The infrastructure of the Old World is failing.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: You are the absolute best second-in-command I've ever had the pleasure of working with.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Now is the time for you to be in charge, Lizzy. I know you're up for it. I know you won't let your men down.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Roger, we don't have the men for the mission. The Bravos just keep coming.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Then find new men. Think outside the playbook.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Elder, you trust the outsiders too readily. They will betray you.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: You, too, Paladin? Everyone around me keeps saying shut the world out, only look out for ourselves.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Even my goddam son. But the Brotherhood alone can't rebuild what's lost.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: We need them. Hell, our whole plan is for them.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: I'm not thinking of some far off future, Elder. I'm worried about today. And tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: We're fighting non-stop to keep the Bravos contained. I can't afford a weak link.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: I trust your judgment.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: If our Scribes find anything new, I'll see if we can get word to you somehow.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: And Lizzy *static*

items.name: Enola Walker's Story, Part 1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: This is Enola Walker. Don't know if anyone'll hear this, but life finally took the last thing I had left. Figured I should leave something behind.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I lost Joan in '77 and the kids in the Drowning, but I had my damned dogs. It's bad enough that the beast tore up the homestead. Ruined everything.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I could've rebuilt, but it's not worth it without my boys. So if you find this place, I'm willing it to you. Just let anyone listen to this tape and they'll know.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I took the last of my good chems for the bites, but the rest is yours. The last thing I'm going to do is hunt that ugly beast down and kill it before I go.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I hope you have a good life here. But that monster flew off toward the Steakhouse... so maybe avoid that area unless I turned it into a fucking crater.

items.name: Enola Walker's Story, Part 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: It's still flying south. It's like one of those Scorchbeasts the Thunder was fighting off, but looks strange. Bigger? Never seen one up close before.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Looks pregnant but maybe she's just full.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Well, those dogs kept me sane longer than makes sense, so they're getting a proper send-off. You hear that, you monster?

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I don't know why I'm recording all this shit... it helps with the disorientation a bit, I suppose.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Chems didn't seem to help me none, neither. My skin's peeling and my eye won't stop bleeding.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I reckon that if this is it... then I'm gonna make it count.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Alright, I'm off to shove this backpack full of explosives down that Scorchbeast's throat as an after dinner mint.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: You have a good day, whoever you are out there. A better day than me, at the very least!

items.name: Enola Walker's Story, Part 3
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Ugh. Joan always wanted to move to this shit town.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Sorry if you found this and you live here.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Mostly because you live here in this abandoned shit town.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Oh, don't mind me. I'm just mad that big Scorchbeast won't slow down long enough to just eat me and this bag of bombs.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: At least she hasn't left me in the dust already. Although... she could've.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Maybe I'm a snack for later? Or she took a bite of me just to take a taste? Too much salt.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Well, it makes no nevermind to me as long as I can get close enough.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: No, she definitely knows I'm following her, and just doesn't care. She circled back just now, like she was looking for me.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I'm coming for you, even if you go halfway to hell! Even if this is a game to you!

items.name: Enola Walker's Story, Part 4
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: She finally stopped long enough to maul a mirelurk, but didn't eat the damn thing. Not like she did my dogs.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: She just chewed it up and spat it out like, just she did me. Like we're a chocolate sampler or something!

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I got pretty close before she took off again, I swear she's got no eyes in that great ugly cauliflower looking head of hers.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: She's staying to the side of Watoga instead of going in. Maybe she doesn't like the taste of tin cans?

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: The mirelurk and myself are just following after her wake like a couple of ducklings. Think I'll call him Dave.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Dave doesn't seem to care none about attacking me. Ate up his own nest like a hog in the pantry though.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I can even touch him and he doesn't do nothing but stare....

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I found some more chems but it's getting hard to keep going. My eyes and ears are bleeding, and... I'm hearing and seeing things that aren't there.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Hell, I'm not sure that Dave is really here, except when I'm downwind of that stink. Nobody's imagination is capable of such as that.

items.name: Enola Walker's Story, Part 5
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I think everybody's dead in Watoga aside from the bots.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I'm dead, too. Just too dumb to stop walking and breathing.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: At least we've got each other, right Dave?

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: It's hard to think straight, but I saw her circling over this pit one minute, and gone the next. My guess is she went in.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: What do you think?

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Dave is following me now that the Scorchbeast went below, but he's about the worst replacement dog I ever had.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: I have to try to find my way down there. I have to keep up with her.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: If you find this and you don't know well enough, you need to get the hell out of here, Joan. I am not kidding with you, neither.

items.name: Enola Walker's Story, Part 6
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Had to drop my bag. Too heavy. All this for nothing. Couldn't even avenge my boys.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: It's not alone down here. There are smaller ones like it, things like me, like Dave. They don't do nothing but stare.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: They're waiting. Waiting for me.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: My skin's bursting, burning, tight like a shroud.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: Oh, I miss you guys.

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: This... This... Can't...

transcript.speaker: Enola Walker
transcript.text: We... Together... Never... Alone!

items.name: Going well
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Old Woman
transcript.text: Things are going well. Those Watogan society ladies are falling over themselves to buy my merchandise.

transcript.speaker: Old Woman
transcript.text: I've had to resort to "distressing" things myself. Seems to be working.

transcript.speaker: Old Woman
transcript.text: I'm going to be able to move to Watoga myself soon enough if this continues.

items.name: Gone scrounging
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Milo
transcript.text: Silas, I'm going out to scratch up supplies. I'll be back in a couple days.

transcript.speaker: Milo
transcript.text: I know you think we should go, that we don't owe these people anything. But... the world ended, man. We can't keep taking advantage of each other.

transcript.speaker: Milo
transcript.text: We NEED each other now. All of us need each other.

transcript.speaker: Milo
transcript.text: My god... did you see Marty? It's almost as if his skin melted. How is he still alive?

transcript.speaker: Milo
transcript.text: Look, just make what's left stretch until I come back. Do what you do best, improvise!

items.name: Goodbye
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Silas
transcript.text: Hey Milo um... look... I'm sorry, but I need to bail.

transcript.speaker: Silas
transcript.text: Yeah, I know, "where the hell I'm gonna go?", well...*Sigh* I don't know. But I know I can't stay here.

transcript.speaker: Silas
transcript.text: We built a great thing here, I even stuck it out when things went sour and we had to switch to our "down home" menu. We made it work.

transcript.speaker: Silas
transcript.text: But after the bombs and everything fell apart...Look, I know this is gonna sound terrible, but...I'm not exactly a soup kitchen kind of guy, you know?

transcript.speaker: Silas
transcript.text: So, um... Ah, anyway, um... this is goodbye. Don't hate me.

items.name: Goodbye Dad
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jenny
transcript.text: Dad, I know you wanted me to stay, but I'm leaving. I... I have my daughter to think about now. This whole town is dying, and you don't even see it.

transcript.speaker: Jenny
transcript.text: The government, the mining companies, Vault-Tec... they want West Virginia to run by the machines.

transcript.speaker: Jenny
transcript.text: Don't you get it? There won't be any work once Watoga is finished. They won't... they won't need people anymore.

transcript.speaker: Jenny
transcript.text: I'm sorry. I really hope one day you'll understand.

items.name: Have a nice life
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jake
transcript.text: You said you'd take care of it, Sam. You promised you'd get AMS to piss off.

transcript.speaker: Jake
transcript.text: What'd it take to buy you off? You got a fancy apartment in Watoga now?

transcript.speaker: Jake
transcript.text: Those boys' deaths are on your hands. You let this happen!

transcript.speaker: Jake
transcript.text: I'm done. I quit. I have half a mind to pay Kerwood's squirt a visit and introduce him to my fist.

transcript.speaker: Jake
transcript.text: In fact, I am going to go do that right now. And don't you try to stop me.

transcript.speaker: Jake
transcript.text: I hope you hear the watery screams of those men, drowning every night in your dreams. Have a nice life, asshole.

items.name: Highschoolers
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Eli
transcript.text: I'll show those little Watogan Highshcool shits. Think they can intimidate me?! Ha. Let's see how they like them changes I made to their batch.

transcript.speaker: Eli
transcript.text: Might just explode in their bellies. Bless their hearts.

items.name: Hospital Report: Staff Incident
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: Hospital Incident Report. Resident Psychiatrist Doctor Kessle.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: One of the junior nurses has suffered a nervous breakdown.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: His assignments included Patient 5A3, whose afflictions manifest in habitual self-harm.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: Patient 5A4, who - while not violent - does aggressively grab and paw at whoever is trying to administer care.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: And also Patient 5B7, who breaks down into loud, un-consolable fits of crying with no apparent cause or trigger.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: That, and the constant attention and sanitary cleanup required throughout the day for all of his charges, was too much for the young nurse.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: We found him standing outside the door to one of the patient rooms, carrying a tray of food but not moving anywhere.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: One of the other nurses noticed he had been standing in place for over an hour.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: When he finally responded to our attempts to get his attention, he seemed surprise that any time had passed.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: During our exit interview, he broke into tears. He wanted to know if something was wrong with him. If he would end up here as a patient.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: I explained that nervous exhaustion was a common ailment, especially for hospital workers.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: Maybe after some months of rest, he could re-apply for his job. That didn't seem to console him.

items.name: Hospital Report: Violent Incident
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: Hospital Incident Report. Resident Psychiatrist Doctor Kessle.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: We had a fight breakout today. All the patients in the dining area for the morning meal and all the attending staff were present.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: Patient 3E2 has never had any problems with violence but can be verbally abusive to whoever happens to be in the area.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: The staff intervened, but Patient 3E2 broke free from restraint by biting into one of the nurse's hands.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: Another nurse and I chased her down the hallway, while the rest of the staff tried to contain the patients in the dining room, who were obviously agitated by what just happened.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: We were finally able to hold her and administer a sedative, and the unfortunate nurse whose hand had been torn open received treatment.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: All the other patients have returned to their routines, but Patient 3E2 and 7C1 will need to be monitored in case this is the start of habitual violent behavior.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Kessle
transcript.text: The prognosis for either of them being released has slipped even further into statistical irrelevancy.

items.name: Hunting
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: You going to turn that thing on every time I walk over here now?

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: You going to keep physically abusing me every time I tell you "no" about something?

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: You're such a baby.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: No, I'm a caring and sensitive individual, which is precisely the type of person we need protecting our wildlife.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: If you had your way, no one would even visit the park!

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: And if you had yours, we'd let in every maniac with a gun to shoot up the place.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Not everyone with a gun is a maniac, Ross. And there's nothing wrong with hunting. It's a manly sport, a time honored tradition --

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: It's murder.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: It's hunting.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: Why are you a Ranger, anyway?

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Because I love nature, and I want to preserve it so that people can enjoy it. Same as you.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: By "enjoy" you mean "destroy," right?

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: For Christ's sake, Ross! I'm not a monster - Hey, what's that?

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: A trashcan?

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: So that's where my Dandy Boy Apples went. Into your goddamn mouth.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Gimme that!

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: Get away from me!

items.name: I'm stuck here
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: There was an accident...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: bucket at drop site D4... got loose and popped...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: shaft collapsed, got most out... but I'm stuck here... drift east from Main D, I think...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: not that it matters much... I don't think I'm getting out...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: Heard Doc Sally say China dropped the Big One... God can that be true?...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: If someone finds this... get it to my wife...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: We had a good run, babe... didn't we?... You know... I still remember our first date... at the pool hall...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: don't remember who won... or what was playing on the radio... but I do remember you...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: I remember how I felt looking at you... how it felt you looking at me... how I still feel about you...

transcript.speaker: Grayson
transcript.text: you are my sunshine... ... my only sunshine... ... ...

items.name: Incident Record 5374
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Sissy
transcript.text: Help!

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: Stay calm, citizen. Watoga Emergency Services is here to assist you.

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: Please state the nature of your emergency.

transcript.speaker: Sissy
transcript.text: Mr. Sparkles is in the tree.

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: Citizen, clarify. What is a "Mr. Sparkles?"

transcript.speaker: Sissy
transcript.text: A cat. And he's in that tree!

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: A cat is in the tree.

transcript.speaker: Sissy
transcript.text: Yeah! He shouldn't be in there!

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: The cat should not be in the tree. Is this correct, Citizen?

transcript.speaker: Sissy
transcript.text: Yes! Hurry!

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: Citizen, please stand back.

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: <Sound of laser blasts>

transcript.speaker: Sissy
transcript.text: *Shrieking* No!!!

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: Situation under control. Cat is no longer in tree.

transcript.speaker: Sissy
transcript.text: Mr. Sparkles...

items.name: Last Words
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: I don't have much... longer. Had I known... I never would have... but it's too late now, isn't it... But maybe I can help...

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: You... listening to this... whoever you are... you can't undo the virus... but...

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: You can upload your likeness into a white list in the software... then you at least, could live in the city...

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: You just need to get to... my office... there's a scanner... attached to the... the...

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: <Sound of recording device falling to the floor>

items.name: Mr. Torturers
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Lisa Fields
transcript.text: Sergei, I don't know what you think you heard, or who you think you heard it from, but we are not, I repeat, not conducting experiments on overcoming pain threshold tolerance.

transcript.speaker: Lisa Fields
transcript.text: Nor, and I cannot stress this enough, nor are we prototyping appendages for so-called "Mr. Torturers" for any agency of the government.

transcript.speaker: Lisa Fields
transcript.text: And, look, even if we were, which we aren't, it wouldn't be torture. It'd be... "improved interrogation." This is America, for Christ's sake!

items.name: My Reputation
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amelia
transcript.text: Mom, I love you, but you're too old fashioned. I'm going to do what makes me happy, other people's opinions be damned.

transcript.speaker: Amelia
transcript.text: My reputation is my own, forged by me, not your friends, not you, and definitely not some boy.

transcript.speaker: Amelia
transcript.text: Besides, our relationship is strictly business. I've lined up some buyers for his latest work. See, that marketing degree hasn't gone so unutilized, has it?

transcript.speaker: Amelia
transcript.text: I'm making a hefty commission. Just between the two us though, I think his work sucks.

items.name: Operation Free Watoga Log 322
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: It's done... I broke the transmission sequencer so no one will be able to remotely reconfigure the machines.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: I also corrupted the software on the update terminals throughout the facility. The only machine capable of creating updates is now in my office.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: I've locked my terminal and wrote a little "fix" to the building's badge access software to prevent any badge other than my own from accessing my office.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: They won't be able to get help from anyone else. Only I will hold the means to their salvation!

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: Soon they'll come down from their ivory towers and come begging me to make it stop.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: And when they do, I'll make each and every one of them fill out MY "Resident Application Fitness Report."

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: And then I'll deny every last one of them. We'll see how they like it. Being judged. Being locked out in the cold.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Allegheny
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Allegheny.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: A mental asylum as a last stand against the Scorched. Brave, crazy, and crazy-brave, the Army way...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: At least, I'm pretty sure the Brotherhood had former US Army members judging by the security systems.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: If only they had survived. What I wouldn't give to have a few of America's finest watching my back right now.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: As it is, I'll have to find out how they were planning to combat the Scorched on my own. Once I can figure out a way through these doors...

items.name: Overseer's Log - Fort Defiance
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Fort Defiance.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The more I travel this godforsaken "Wasteland," the more I realize what truly destroyed West Virginia.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: And what destroyed any chance the survivors had of... actually surviving. Mistrust.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: All these divergent groups... Responders, Brotherhood of Steel, whatever.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Separately, they had everything necessary to beat the odds. Brains, brawn, and bravado to spare.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: And what did they do? Close ranks. Get paranoid. Refuse to work with one another.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: And it cost them all their lives.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: People of Vault 76, if you're listening... DO NOT fall into the same trap.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: You find each other. You work with each other. Only TOGETHER will you win.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: This is your Overseer. And I'm begging you, please...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Save our country.

items.name: Preservation of Technology

location.text: Found at Fort Defiance, near Camp Venture.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Congratulations, Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Paladin Taggerdy told me of you victory at Huntersville. I know it was costly, but future generations will thank you.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: As I'm thanking you now. It makes me proud.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But that's not why I'm calling.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: One of the Brotherhood's standing orders is being on the look out for valuable technology.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Anything that would help us in our efforts.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But as I look in every direction I see chaos. The lights are out, and men have become little better than barbarians.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Civilization. Civilization is something I think of every day. I know Lizzy's probably sick of the word by now.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: To rebuild that. To reclaim that. Our successors are going to need the secrets of the past.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: And those secrets are in danger of slipping through our fingers forever.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: So far our Scribes have been tools to help protect our Knights and maintain our bases. That needs to change.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: The Brotherhood is going to be more than an armed fighting force, we're going to be guardians of civilization.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: So we have to grab every schematic, every holotape, every book, and every goddamned note that holds the building blocks of the Old World before it's too late.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Our Scribes will hold onto them, preserve them, perhaps even progress beyond them.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: And the Knights will protect them. Like a hard shell around a precious seed.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: One day, when the time is right, that seed will grow. And a new civilization will be born.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: This... This is why we were born, don't you see it?

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Helping your fellow man is a good goal, a soldier's goal.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But this... We will be the catalyst that changes the world.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: I'm sure you have questions, Paladin Taggerdy is fully briefed.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: I have every faith in you, Appalachia. Elder Maxson out.

items.name: Professor Greebley's Press Release
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Professor Greebly
transcript.text: People told me my theories weren't possible. They mocked me and called me a "foolish old man."

transcript.speaker: Professor Greebly
transcript.text: Well, I'm here to tell you that the possibility of time travel is not only real, but that it can be accomplished interdimensionally!

transcript.speaker: Professor Greebly
transcript.text: I've revolutionized this radical concept, a new way of thinking about skipping across timelines.

transcript.speaker: Professor Greebly
transcript.text: Instead of using the traditional and often clumsy use of gravity for time travel, I've discovered a way to punch a hole in the fabric of our reality.

transcript.speaker: Professor Greebly
transcript.text: By slipping through this fissure in time and space at a high rate of speed, it's my belief that instantaneous time travel will occur.

transcript.speaker: Professor Greebly
transcript.text: In a few weeks, I will be attempting to slipstream through dimensions using a monorail system as my chariot.

transcript.speaker: Professor Greebly
transcript.text: If you wish to attend this historic event, I will be at Pylon V-13 of the Appalachian Monorail System.

transcript.speaker: Professor Greebly
transcript.text: Be there and witness history!

items.name: Protestors
