items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Clifford
transcript.text: This is the third time this week I've seen protestors marching outside of Watoga.

transcript.speaker: Clifford
transcript.text: For the amount of money we're paying, I expect a certain level of security. How is anyone here safe with those mobs screaming at us all day?

items.name: Requiem for Kelley
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: We'd been wandering for weeks until we came across an old shantytown that was built before the war.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: I convinced Kelley that we both needed rest and this would be the perfect place.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: The radiation sickness she was suffering from was making her weak and I knew she was no longer fit to travel.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: With a roof over her head, I was finally confident enough to head out and look for supplies. Biggest mistake I've ever made.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: I scoured the area for most of the day until I finally stumbled across an old army outpost loaded with medical supplies.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: Excited, I rushed back to the shantytown and my dear Kelley.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: When I got there, I found her... she was dead... and her body was being... eaten by wild dogs.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: Killing the creatures made me feel better, but the feeling didn't last.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: This was my fault. I left her alone, left her to die. She depended on me, and I failed.

transcript.speaker: Parker
transcript.text: If you can hear me, Kelley, know that I will always love you and that I'm sorry. Sorry about this damn war, sorry about everything.

items.name: Retirement
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Officer Cecil
transcript.text: Twenty-five years on the force, and they're saying I won't be getting my retirement package. Say they can't afford it, anymore. Lucky them, they get to decide that.

transcript.speaker: Officer Cecil
transcript.text: I asked if maybe if I could be transferred to Watoga, take some kind of desk job, but they're not hiring. The robots are handling all the security, they told me.

items.name: Scribe Grant's Plea
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: If you're hearing this, stranger. I'm dead. The Brotherhood is dead.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: But I'm relieved. Relieved there is someone, anyone, alive.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: I honestly don't care if you're Chinese, American, or whatever. You're a human being.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: I don't have much time. But the Scorched are more of a threat than you can ever imagine.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: You have to find a way past the security I installed.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: If you're former military, all you need is your government issued military ID card.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: If not... find a way.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: I know, some... ghost... isn't probably very persuasive. But look past your own skin, and consider there's so much at stake.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: We did. And that's why I'm going out to die.

transcript.speaker: Grant McNamara
transcript.text: Ad victoriam. Scribe Grant signing out.

items.name: Sensor Module Specs
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Yes, they're mutated as all get out. But at their core, physiologically, they're bats.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: And as such they're constantly using ultrasound echolocation.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: For normal bats, Pre-War at least, echolocation is quite limited.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Ultrasound is absorbed by the atmosphere - detection beyond 20 to 30 meters isn't really practical.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: But the Scorchbeasts emit powerful ultrasound vibrations with an unparalleled range. Usually, this is to their advantage.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: However, we can use this against them.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: If the Scorchbeasts have a single colony and if you can set up a large scale detection network focused to the 103.4 kHz frequency you may be able to track down their source.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Enclosed are the schematics for a Sonic Scanning Module. It's range is still limited.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: You'll have to find some way of monitoring a larger area.

items.name: Sideshow Snallygaster - Part 1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Holotape
transcript.text: (Radio drama plays)

items.name: Sideshow Snallygaster - Part 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Holotape
transcript.text: (Radio drama plays)

items.name: Sight to See
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Mawmaw
transcript.text: That was a sight to see. Near a hundred cars slamming on together. What a sound.

transcript.speaker: Mawmaw
transcript.text: I had no idea things that heavy could fly like that. Was like watching dominos tossed by a toddler.

transcript.speaker: Mawmaw
transcript.text: When they hit the levee, I was sure I was gonna be washed away. But I'm still here. But everything's wrecked past fixing.

transcript.speaker: Mawmaw
transcript.text: I need to find a new place to stay. Those pumps don't got it in them.

transcript.speaker: Mawmaw
transcript.text: But I'll never forget that day. Not as long as I live. However long that is. Think I caught that skin thing people been getting. Can't stop itching.

items.name: Sign those permits
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Ross, if you don't sign those permits, I'm going to -- to - I don't know what. But I'll do something you don't like.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: The beaver population is on the verge of collapse.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: What are you talking about?! We had a family of beavers waltzing through our goddamn offices just last week! They are out of control!

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: That's because they've been displaced by your flagrant and continued disregard for their habitat. You never should have authorized that camping exhibition.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: You know those Scout masters are complete morons --

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Takes one to know one.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: - and those boys, don't get me started on how reckless and cruel those little psychopaths-in-training are.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: That's not fair. Hunting and trapping are important skills every boy should learn.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: They eat four course meals out of boxes their robot nannies pull out of nuclear powered microwaves!

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Just sign the damn hunting permits, Ross.

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: No.

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Wait - are your recording this?!

transcript.speaker: Ross
transcript.text: Maybe...

transcript.speaker: Simon
transcript.text: Damnit! Gimme that.

items.name: That boy
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Claudia
transcript.text: I don't want you hanging around that boy who moved in next door. He's a dirty hippy. I think I can even smell drugs on him!

transcript.speaker: Claudia
transcript.text: The ladies at the Society are beginning to talk about you. You have no idea how mean those ladies can be.

transcript.speaker: Claudia
transcript.text: I need you to comport yourself like the lady your father and I raised you to be.

items.name: The Nuclear Option
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Is this urgent, Lizzy?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Elder. I've read Scribe Takano's reports. I've talked with Grant a lot, too-

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Spit it out.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: The Sonic Generators work but there's just too many Sierra Bravos. This strategy of ours, it's just delaying the inevitable.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: You're not giving up on me?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: No. Of course not. But I think we may need something bigger. More final.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Go on.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: One of the squires on patrol found a nuclear silo. Still functional.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: What? Even you, Lizzy?

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Are you out of your god-damned mind? Look around. Look at everything.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: The death, the destruction, the End of the World. That came from the nukes.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: But if we don't deal with the Bravos once and for all, they could kill everyone.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: All life on this continent. That's what Takano said, right?

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: There will always be a reason to use a weapon. Always.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But nukes? Never again. I'd mothball the whole technology if I could.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Am I clear?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Yes, Elder.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: I consider this matter resolved. I don't want to talk about it again. Maxson out.

items.name: Tinkering
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Lisa Fields
transcript.text: It has come to the Board of Directors' attention that you have been tinkering with the "Voice of Watoga" project to give it the voice and personality of your late mother.

transcript.speaker: Lisa Fields
transcript.text: I understand that you two were close, and I know what it means to lose someone dear...

transcript.speaker: Lisa Fields
transcript.text: But we cannot allow this type of flagrant disregard for project specifications to continue without reprimand, no matter how sympathetic we may be to your personal loss.

transcript.speaker: Lisa Fields
transcript.text: If you do not cease your tinkering and remove all the related changes from the project program and data files, you will be let go without hesitation.

transcript.speaker: Lisa Fields
transcript.text: Thank you for your understanding and immediate compliance in this matter.

transcript.speaker: Agnes
transcript.text: I can't believe some of the riff-raff that's made it through the application process.

transcript.speaker: Agnes
transcript.text: I was told Watoga would be an exclusive neighborhood, but the caliber of some of the people they've allowed in. Hmph.

transcript.speaker: Agnes
transcript.text: They would never have been accepted if I was in charge, that's for sure.

items.name: Where Now?

transcript.speaker: Richard
transcript.text: Condemned. That's what they told me. Five generations lived under this roof, and now the government, my government, is taking it from us.

transcript.speaker: Richard
transcript.text: I asked the agent what they're going to do with it, and you know what he told me?

transcript.speaker: Richard
transcript.text: "Just buy an apartment up in Watoga. Ain't that supposed to be the city of the future?" Then he sneered at me and laughed.

transcript.speaker: Richard
transcript.text: We'll see who's laughing when they try to drag me out of here.

transcript.speaker: Madelyn
transcript.text: I mean, they're going to have to catch on sometime, right?

transcript.speaker: Madelyn
transcript.text: Which means we should probably make them lose sometimes, right? To keep it seeming on the regular?

transcript.speaker: Claudia

transcript.speaker: Claudia
transcript.text: It's not good for either of our reputations. And a good reputation is the only thing a lady can cling to in this world.

transcript.speaker: Claudia
transcript.text: And for the love of God, don't ever again use the word "sexy" in my presence!

transcript.text: A reminder to myself.

transcript.speaker: Responder

transcript.speaker: Responder
transcript.text: But things aren't good.

transcript.speaker: Responder
transcript.text: And stuff is getting worse.

transcript.speaker: Responder
transcript.text: Anyway, this is a reminder to myself.

transcript.speaker: Responder
transcript.text: A reminder that this gun. It's my insurance.

transcript.speaker: Responder
transcript.text: If things get real bad, if the food runs out or the water runs dry.

transcript.speaker: Responder
transcript.text: I get to decide how I leave this goddamn world.

transcript.speaker: Responder

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Gabe Ramses
transcript.text: Hi, this is Gabe Ramses and I'm leaving this message to inform the Parks and Rec Department of the horrible experience my family and I had this week at the Alpine River Cabins!

transcript.speaker: Gabe Ramses
transcript.text: We were all looking forward to a nice, weekend getaway in the wilderness, but between the constant shaking in the cabins, rodent swarms, and blood-curdling screams, I'm more stressed than I was before!

transcript.speaker: Gabe Ramses
transcript.text: My boys were so upset they swore they saw the picture frames spinning on the walls!

transcript.speaker: Gabe Ramses
transcript.text: My tax dollars pay your salaries, so I demand recompense or you can bet I'll do my darndest to make sure that money is in someone else's pockets next election!

transcript.speaker: Gabe Ramses
transcript.text: And one more thing! Maybe you could get off your lazy butts and pick up some of the garbage here. The place is filthy!

transcript.speaker: Gabe Ramses
transcript.text: I know all the recent hub-bub about atomic war, but that doesn't mean the place has to look like it was just hit with a nuclear bomb!

items.name: Anya's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Anya
transcript.text: Kelly, I got your message from the dead drop! I've been waiting up here for you but I'm starting to get kinda worried.

transcript.speaker: Anya
transcript.text: You're probably just hiding in the hedges from those robots, but I'm going to go look around for you just in case. If you get this, just stay here!

transcript.speaker: Anya
transcript.text: I ran into a few adults who used to live in the big houses here and they said that we can stay for as long as we like. I told the other kids and everyone is pretty sure they're cannibals.

transcript.speaker: Anya
transcript.text: I don't think it's true, but we should probably try to move on from here if the folks here are taking notice.

transcript.speaker: Anya
transcript.text: Oh hey, they you are now! So ... bye?

items.name: Arktos Pharma - Trapped Underground

location.text: Found at Arktos Pharma Biome Lab.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Christina Bryan
transcript.text: To anyone out there, this is Dr. Christina Bryan. I'm a botanist employed at a classified laboratory deep underneath the Arktos Pharma facility.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Christina Bryan
transcript.text: We were down here when the bombs fell. We held out as long as we could before sending people to the surface to find out what the hell happened.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Christina Bryan
transcript.text: That was a mistake. There was nothing up there except death, and these... ghoulish creatures. They got down here somehow and started taking us out, one by one.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Christina Bryan
transcript.text: Our last remaining technician tried to program the security force to recognize these creatures as a threat, but it seems he disabled their targeting parameters instead.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Christina Bryan
transcript.text: They... they started killing everything. Eight of us have locked ourselves in the lower generator room. If you hear this, please... come and save us. Before it's too late.

transcript.speaker: Carl

items.name: Charleston Herald Exclusive: The Motherlode

location.text: Found near Charleston Herald, Sugar Grove.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: I'm William Breyer, investigative reporter for the Charleston Herald.

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: I'm currently standing just outside the security fencing of one of several Hornwright Industrial sites that have cropped up around the area in recent months.

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: I'm here tonight to try and get some answers about what has become known in certain circles as "The Motherlode project."

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: Could this be the answer local mining families have been looking for? A series of new mining projects that could reinvigorate the local economy?

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: Or, as environmental groups have suggested, could these be a fresh set of toxic disposal sites, poisoning the ground beneath our feet?

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: At the very least, according to local experts, the area's recent increase in seismic events can almost certainly be tied to these sites.

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: And now I'm here to see for myself what's really going on.

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: I've just made my way up to a small gap in the first line of fencing. The security here is intense. Barbed wire. Armed guards. Feels like a warzone.

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: I'm making my way over a small ridge and I--

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: Mother of god... the ground's shaking and-- oh my god... what is that?

transcript.speaker: Hornwright Worker
transcript.text: Hey! You! This is private propert-- Shit, it's that reporter. Jesus! He's got a gun!

transcript.speaker: Bill Breyer
transcript.text: Gun? Wait, this isn't a --- ah! Ah....

items.name: Christmas Plans
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: Oh, sit down Tanner. I swear, you could talk the bark off a tree.

transcript.speaker: Tanner Holbrook
transcript.text: Stuff it, Abigale.

transcript.speaker: Tanner Holbrook
transcript.text: What is this nonsense about throwing a Christmas party? We are already rationing supplies and if we have another winter like '78...

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: Our people need this. They've been struggling on for years through the war, radiation, mutants, and raiders...

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: They need something normal. Something to give them hope that things will be better.

transcript.speaker: Tanner Holbrook
transcript.text: We don't have the supplies! We need to keep them for the war effort!

transcript.speaker: Tanner Holbrook
transcript.text: And waiting to hold the town hall till I was out meeting those Brotherhood rebels is beyond deceitful.

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: You think I'm some dumb hick, just on account o' the fact that you abandoned your people and your accent.

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: I know that you're trying to sway the vote next spring by letting your friends horde food.

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: I've checked the ledgers. Don't do in the dark what you don't want brought out in the light, Tanner.

transcript.speaker: Tanner Holbrook
transcript.text: I- You! Infuriating!

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: If you're fixin' to have a fit, best sit down before you bite your tongue clean off. Wouldn't want to ruin my carpet.

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: It's all gonna be donated food, and we'll only keep the lights on for a couple hours.

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: And if your sweet, I might even let you wear the Santa suit.

transcript.speaker: Tanner Holbrook
transcript.text: I. WILL. NEVER!!!

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: You forgot your Christmas present! It's bourbon! To remind you of where you come from!!

transcript.speaker: Abigale Poole
transcript.text: Good. Melody deserves this more anyway.

items.name: Clayton Ward - 20780415
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Candidate Clayton Ward. April 15, 2078.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Good evening, candidate Clayton Ward. I have been observing your routine of late and have noticed several aggressive occurrences.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Most recently, how you obtained residency in the luxury bedrooms by forcibly removing a resident from their room. Great initiative.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: These people here, they're like most of America; fat, lazy and only willing to do the minimum they can to survive.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Me? I'm a winner. Always have been. And I deserve to live like one.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Yes, you have the makings of the profession "executive." Although, records state that you were previously a... "plumber."

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Do plumbers usually do a lot of... "winning?"

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Uh, erm, that's right! One of the most competitive fields in America. I've never seen a clogged pipe I couldn't, uh, "plumb!"

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Understood. Were "clogged pipes" the reason you were recorded in the Server Room multiple times over the past week? To do... "plumbing?"

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Ah, well, yes! Important stuff in there, don't want it to, ah, ruin our servers, with, you know, water! Does bad stuff to computers, let me tell you!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Thank you. Your service is appreciated. However, access to the server rooms are prohibited to all vault dwellers except the Overseer.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: As a candidate you should do your... "plumbing" in other areas of the vault.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Oh, wow, gosh, I'm real sorry about that! Won't happen again!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Your cooperation is appreciated. Good night, candidate Clayton Ward.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Hey, did you guys get all that? Every word that thing says is solid gold but, sheesh, it gives me the creeps.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Why do they have that thing in a Vault? What's that thing got to do with survival!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: We should put that thing on the board and actually make a profit for once!

items.name: Colton Pickins's Police Report
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: This is Deputy D.B. Walton. Interview started at 3:35AM.

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: All right, Mr. Pickins. Tell me everything that happened by starting from the beginning.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: I was out behind my hotdog stand taking out the trash when I saw a light shining from the woods.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: At first I thought it was a hunter with a flashlight, but then the light started... changing.

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: Changing? How?

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: Well, the light started turning different colors.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: First it was blue, then green, then red, then back to blue. Or wait, maybe it was green, blue, red. No, actually, it's red, blue...

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: Yep, we get it. What happened next?

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: I suddenly got real dizzy, and I dropped the trash bag I was carrying. Next thing I knew, I was on the ground. .. I don't even remember falling.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: I looked up, and that's when... that's when I saw it.

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: "It?" Can you be more specific?

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: It was a man, but it also wasn't a man. It had gray skin and these huge black eyes. And, and it was wearing like a spacesuit or something.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: What was really weird was that it wasn't saying anything, but I could hear it anyway. In my mind.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: It told me to follow it onto its spaceship.

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: Sigh. "The Flatwoods Monster," again?

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: All right, I've heard enough. Colton Pickins, I'm arresting you for drunk and disorderly conduct and indecent exposure.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: Indecent what? What are talking about? I didn't do anything wrong!

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: Colton, we found you on the roof of your shack, buck naked, yelling at the top of your lungs.

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: Your blood alcohol was .23 and it took four deputies to get you into handcuffs.

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: We all go on a bender now and then, but you need to keep it at home.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: What? No! Come on! You have to believe me.

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: The monster MADE me drunk, it... it was experimenting on me! Controlling my mind!

transcript.speaker: Colton Pickins
transcript.text: When are you people going to do something about the Flatwoods Monster?! It needs to be killed!

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: I've had enough. Just get him out of here.

transcript.speaker: Officer Walton
transcript.text: This is Deputy D.B. Walton. Interview terminated.

items.name: Course Instructions
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Alright, settle down recruits.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: I know it looks hard, but the course ain't no hill for a climber.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Just follow the arrows and keep your head on a swivel.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Once you get down a piece, you'll see the capitol.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Give that button a whack and follow the course back on over here.

transcript.speaker: Firebreather Trainee
transcript.text: *Muttering*

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: What was that?

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: You got something to say, you spit it out.

transcript.speaker: Firebreather Trainee
transcript.text: I just don't see why we gotta go running through all that muck.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Now you listen to me before I smack both eyes into one.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: My husband is somewhere down in "that muck."

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: So's yer father. And her gran. And their sisters.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: We spent weeks crawling through "that muck" pulling people out.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Thousands of people died in the Christmas Flood.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: More still were never found. Drowned or buried alive.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: We pulled people out of there for a full year.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: So you show some respect.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: You got anything else to say?

transcript.speaker: Firebreather Trainee
transcript.text: No ma'am.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: What was that?!

transcript.speaker: Firebreather Trainee
transcript.text: No ma'am!

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Good!

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Alright Fire Breathers, get out there and run that course like your friends lives depend on it.

items.name: Dumb Street Kids
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Charles
transcript.text: The kids down there are so incredibly oblivious to the fact that windows exist.

transcript.speaker: Charles
transcript.text: We've sent scouting parties in the dead of night through different adjacent buildings.

transcript.speaker: Charles
transcript.text: They keep returning with more food, more ammo, it's nuts.

transcript.speaker: Charles
transcript.text: We're gonna outlast this siege for years.

transcript.speaker: Charles
transcript.text: The big problem though is RadAway. We're finding less and less of it every day, and people are starting to get sick.

transcript.speaker: Charles
transcript.text: I'm still certain that we'll be the victors after all is said and done. The rooftops and the monorail are our own personal highway, after all.

transcript.speaker: Charles
transcript.text: Those dumb street kids have no idea who they're messing with.

items.name: Elizabeth Chambers - 20771019
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Candidate Elizabeth Chambers, October 19, 2077.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Greetings. I am ZAX. Welcome to Vault 51. I will be assisting you however I can during your new life in the Vault.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: It is a pleasure to meet you, candidate Elizabeth Chambers.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Hello... ZAX is it? I'm sure you've been told about my husband & I as... "special guests" in the Vault.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: We've been told this place will be a little... different?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: But, of course, we're fully committed to whatever your "mission" is and excited to build a new future together!

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: What does the Overseer have planned for this place?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Currently, there is no Overseer of Vault 51. Would you like to be Overseer, candidate Elizabeth Chambers?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: No Overseer? But my secretary told me... you know what, it doesn't matter, I know the perfect man for the job.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: My husband, Senator Joel Chambers? He's already a serving politician, an all-star collegiate athlete and a born leader of men.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: He'd be perfect as Overseer! We've been the perfect team for years. Almost went to Washington, you know!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Intriguing. I will ask candidate Joel Chambers if he wants to be Overseer. He is currently in the lounge with candidate Carmen Greene. Please hold.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Wait, ZAX, what was that? He was WHERE with WHO?

items.name: Feeling Good, Looking Good
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Vault Designer
transcript.text: I have really started to feel much happier lately.

transcript.speaker: Vault Designer
transcript.text: I've got a great place with fantastic roommates. And I've got the job of my DREAMS!

transcript.speaker: Vault Designer
transcript.text: Working at VTU as an actual full-time Vault designer?! Research division. Full access. God, I've been dreaming about this my entire life.

transcript.speaker: Vault Designer
transcript.text: The creative freedom is unparalleled in this industry.

transcript.speaker: Vault Designer
transcript.text: My car runs great. My coworkers are great. The students, though I don't get to interact with them much, are really bright and remind me of myself.

transcript.speaker: Vault Designer
transcript.text: Morgantown is... not like Seattle, but I couldn't be happier doing my best work here.

transcript.speaker: Vault Designer
transcript.text: I think I'm going to have a really successful chapter here. I just can't wait for what the future holds.

items.name: Field Report: AVR Medical
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: Responders field report. Maria Chavez speaking.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: Being here at AVR Medical really brings back memories. My mother worked at this place for years as a nurse.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: When I was a child, back before the war, I got sick for days. Supply shortages had driven the price of medicine beyond what we could afford.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: Lucky for us, my mom wasn't just a nurse, but also a natural green thumb. We had a garden with all kinds of herbs and flowers.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: She treated me with home-made herbal remedies.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: Today, disease is rampant. There are countless viruses and bacterial infections out there, and we need a way to deal with them.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: I was hoping I might find something here to help treat all the sick and injured refugees we've got back at the airport.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: Unfortunately, the place has been picked pretty clean by now, and there isn't much left.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: So, having had basically no luck in this creepy abandoned hospital, I've decided to turn instead to my mother's wisdom.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: I've put together some herbal tea recipes that should mitigate the symptoms of the more common sicknesses. It's not a cure, but it's something.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: Well, I think I'll wrap this up.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: Guess I'm off to pick some flowers.

transcript.speaker: Dave Strauss

transcript.speaker: Sanjay Kumar
transcript.text: If the robots are a concern, go and deal with them. You're supposed to be my security escort, aren't you?

transcript.speaker: Sanjay Kumar

transcript.speaker: Dave Strauss

transcript.speaker: Sanjay Kumar
transcript.text: Pull yourself together, man! I swear, you're the most timid security volunteer I've ever met.

transcript.speaker: Sanjay Kumar

transcript.speaker: Sanjay Kumar

items.name: Final Initiation
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Pledge
transcript.text: *Sigh* It's been... hours? Days? Well, who the hell knows. Trapped... starving, thirsty. Since everyone drank that goddamned drink.

transcript.speaker: Pledge
transcript.text: This was our final initiation. Me and my buddy Max over there. Locked in here for the party and then we were golden. One last test...

transcript.speaker: Pledge
transcript.text: They passed out red cups at the end. To celebrate. Called it 'Nukashine'. I dumped it when they weren't looking. Max here... didn't.

transcript.speaker: Pledge
transcript.text: Everyone was fine at first... well, until they weren't. That sound... I'll never forget that damned sound. I... I can't... *Sigh*

transcript.speaker: Pledge
transcript.text: And now... now, I'm stuck here with no food, no water, and an old saw that won't cut through shit. Stuck here with ol' Max Posey.

transcript.speaker: Pledge
transcript.text: I... I gotta think of something soon. He's a swell guy but... I'm getting sick of his company.

items.name: First Day of School

transcript.speaker: Scott Warner
transcript.text: This is even better than I expected! Growing up in Welch, I never would have expected to get this opportunity! My dad said not to let the big city get to my head, but I can barely stand it I'm so excited!

transcript.speaker: Scott Warner
transcript.text: This list of courses is thrilling, and I'll be learning from some of the best. Dean Elliot is a legend, and Professor Blake literally wrote the book on psychology in confined situations.

transcript.speaker: Scott Warner
transcript.text: I know it's early, but I've been working on my Senior Thesis since I was in grade school, and I've got an appointment with Dean Elliot to go over it with him. I know it's a silly little idea, but I think it can be something real special with his help.

transcript.speaker: Scott Warner
transcript.text: Selective breeding is the toughest but to crack, but I think that the confines of a vault are a fantastic place to put these ideas to the test in a controlled environment. I've studied the history and I have an angle that no one has thought of.

items.name: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I'm leaving this audio log for my incompetent brothers and the esteemed members of the board at Clark, Clark, Clark & Associates.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: This is Harold K. Clark, Jr. and I am currently locked in Vault-Tec's Vault 51 in the Appalachia region of West Virginia.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Since no one else had the balls, I took it upon myself and came to this Vault, but I've been locked in.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: In here I'm known as "Clayton Ward," since someone was too stupid to show up - thanks for the free rent, moron!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I'm not sure what the situation is out there, but everything seemed fine before I got here...

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I don't know if anything could bomb as bad as our profits last year!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Nuclear war might actually help you fools - great job running my father's company into the ground, by the way!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I've taken a good look at this place, and, honestly? Not impressed.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Sure, it's big, but that's what you get when you're working on Uncle Sam's dime, robbing the American people blind.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: The Clarks built ourselves up from nothing and represent the actual American -- hard-working and not willing to quit!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: But seriously, this Vault? Incredible. Nothing the nerds at the lab could do!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Listen, if you eggheads could do your jobs... It's incredible. Amazing, even!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Get this: there's this giant computer here and it's running this whole show by itself! Nobody pulling the strings, does it all on it's own! Amazing!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Gonna learn more and report back whenever possible. Howard...

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I mean, Clayton Ward out.

items.name: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Hi, this is Harold. At this point, I expect I'm the only person on the board alive, otherwise someone... someone would have come for me.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: God knows I won't be for long. This place... this place is like nothing we would have expected.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: There was an explosion in here and it's like nothing ever happened.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I start digging around in ZAX's files just to see what's happening outside? Gone the next day. Gone. The files, the terminals, everything.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: That thing... it's not a computer, it's more like a goddamn wizard! A god!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: And, I just know it, ZAX has been pitting us against each other this whole time.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Thought no one would notice, that it was just some fun and games... then he started giving these maniacs guns!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: What in god's name was Vault-Tec planning? Was this a trap? Did Vault-Tec lure me here? Most of us are dead!
*distant screams*

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Clayton! Get out here! Oh, you're gonna pay for taking my room!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Oh god, that lunatic is coming for me... ZAX gave him a gun and now he's after me...

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: H, Hey, you! Get away from me!

items.name: Helen Marks & Reuben Gill - 20780803
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Candidates Helen Marks and Reuben Gill. August 03, 2078.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: ZAX, you're sure it's safe in here? I heard such a commotion and... oh my god.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Affirmative. This room is safe. All candidates in this room are deceased.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: Wow... Carmen, Matthew, the Chambers'... all dead... what happened in here?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Playing audio log.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: YOU HARLOT! Matty isn't yours he's mine! MINE!

transcript.speaker: Carmen
transcript.text: *choking*

transcript.speaker: Matthew
transcript.text: You psycho, get off her!

transcript.speaker: Matthew
transcript.text: Carmen, Carmen... wake up, baby. Please, wake up...

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Oh my god, Elizabeth... Hey, what are you doing with my Carmen!

transcript.speaker: Matthew
transcript.text: Get off me, just listen for a second... hey wait, put that down, don't-

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Oh Carmen... Beth... how did this happen... I can't...

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: OK, ZAX, that's enough. I can't listen to that any more.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Helen, you need any help... Jeez, what happened here?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Request processed. Playing audio log.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: No, ZAX, that's not necessary. Looks like a messed up case of a lover scorned.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Wow, I had no idea this was going on. The Chambers seemed so perfect together, too. That's more food for us, at least.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: That isn't funny, Reuben.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Candidate Reuben Gill is correct. Ration supply should be stable for the foreseeable future. Congratulations.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: You're horrible, both of you! These people just died! I can't be here anymore, someone needs to clean this up.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Wait, Helen! I'm sorry! Helen!

items.name: History of Morgantown: Vol. I
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: This is Alisha Parker speaking, valedictorian of the last graduating class of Vault-Tec University.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: I believe it is my duty to record the events of Morgantown's final days for future generations.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: With any luck, someday a dweller from 76 will find this and know what happened here.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: After the bombs, Morgantown was a hellhole. Everything was on fire or dead.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: I don't remember much to be honest. A few of us hid inside the University but rations forced us out after a few weeks.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: When we emerged, we found ourselves in the perfect real-world scenario for exercising all the training we acquired at VTU. Yeah. Lucky us.

items.name: History of Morgantown: Vol. II
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: Some of the kids with Overseer training took the lead. And a few of the Greek houses started communities.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: I don't even remember what they were called.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: The largest of them, Kappa something something, started absorbing the smaller houses and slowly expanding their territory.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: If the world wasn't over, I might have found it interesting how feudalism was reimagined against the backdrop of nuclear war.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: We lost a lot of students in the first year. Some to radiation poisoning. Others to typical things like hunger and thirst.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: One kid was attacked by a large rat in the VTU courtyard, but we never found it. But we mostly lost kids to the House wars.

items.name: History of Morgantown: Vol. III
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: The RadAway shortages were terrifying.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: Some guys were fighting over a cache they found in a nearby pharmacy, and things got heated. They drew their guns and fired.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: The first student death by a fellow peer was recorded. This was the new Morgantown.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: The two biggest houses are the Roof House and the Street House -- named after the territories they control.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: A great student war unfolded -- but this wasn't the cute kind of hazing ritual known by VTU students. This was life or death.

items.name: History of Morgantown: Vol. IV
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: Without RadAway, the effects of intense radiation were already taking their toll.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: Kids were falling over dead, their hair and skin were falling off.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: Only the most powerful student houses were able to keep order among their ranks.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: This was only possible by eradicating the smaller groups of student survivors and stealing their supplies.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: Every dose of RadAway kept the powerful elite at the top of the food chain.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: Even now, I'm in hiding. On a roof somewhere far away from most of the other kids.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: There's one guy on the roof next over that I sometimes talk to, but we usually keep to ourselves to not attract attention.

transcript.speaker: Alisha Parker
transcript.text: I think his name is Victor.

items.name: In Memory of Books

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: Oh, my books.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: My big, beautiful bound books filled with stories and knowledge and history.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: I love my books. I always will.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: But lately, I've been feeling like books are on their merry way to becoming antiques.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: Nobody reads from paper anymore.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: I saw some University kids in the store the other day just reading the covers and nothing more. Can you believe that?

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: Completely summarizing the contents of a published work by judging the cover?

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: Absolutely unbelievable.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: But now it's all holotape this, terminal that.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: Thank you, RobCo, for ushering in the death of books and, to be honest, our entire civilization while we're at it.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: And no, for anyone snooping in, the irony that I'm recording this rant is not lost on me.

transcript.speaker: Bookstore Owner
transcript.text: I can still mourn for the death of my favorite pastime without getting left behind in the past, thank you very much.

items.name: Interloper
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: There are other things in this world now that cannot be explained. The end of the world has awoken... something.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: We all know the Mothman is out there, stalking and watching us, but what of the unseen.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: There are things we can only glimpse in our minds, great entities, beyond our comprehension.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: The Mothman is a creature, more like us than the unknowable horrors in the peripheral vision of our subconscious minds.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: No longer just a false memory now... I have heard a tale... of this entity made real, deep in the earth.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: The story teller was mad by any reckoning, but his story no less true.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: My name is Jeff Lane, and I will lay bare this...watcher. No matter how deep I must go, I will come to know the true nature of the interloper.

items.name: Interrogation: Doe, Jane
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Interrogation of one, Jane Doe, sole captive raider in custody after a deadly attack here, at approximately 10:30 PM tonight, December 24, 2082.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Girl, you and yours've got some nerve! On Christmas Eve, no less! Now, I'll ask again, what is your name?

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: Fuck you! That's 'F' as in Frank, 'u' as in...

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: <Loud smack> Unghf!

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: If that's how we've gotta do this, then that's how we do it. Now, cut the crap or he'll hit ya again.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: <Rosalynn laughing>

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Oh that's rich, you think this is a joke? You killed a whole mess of people out there, and now you're gonna answer for it.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: David's gonna come for me, and when he gets here, he's gonna be mad. He'll kill every last one of you if he has to, so here's how it's gonna be.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: You're gonna let me walk right out of this cell.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: You'll send me off with a big bag of Christmas goodies to take home to my David. And maybe we'll forget any of this ever happened.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: David, huh? So we've got David Thorpe's what... girlfriend here?

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: You know he's the guy who killed two very brave and selfless Responders who went up to your... resort up there to offer help, way back when.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Well, well, gentlemen. I think I know how to finally draw our number one most wanted outlaw outta hiding.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: You wouldn't... you won't! He'll kill you, He'll kill you all!

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Keep her locked up. We'll worry about findin' a way to send a message up there tomorrow.

items.name: Joel & Elizabeth Chambers - 20780623
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Candidates Joel Chambers & Elizabeth Chambers. June 23, 2078.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Greetings, Joel Chambers. Good news. It appears there is only a minor fracture in your arm and it should heal quickly.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: You know, I don't consider this an injury, I consider this a stepping stone towards the future.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: If the American people know one thing, it's struggling. My father always said when "you suffer minor setbacks..."

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Minor setbacks? That's what you call showing off to that harlot?

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Now, honey, you know Carmen is just a loyal constituent and, in these troubled times, it's important to reward your loyal supporters and, I have to make sure that everyone that supported me on the outside understands they're still protected here.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Very good. Elizabeth Chambers, have you been unwell? Your health seems to have decreased since your last checkup.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I recommend additional health care. I would suggest you see candidate Matthew Johnston, he is a licensed personal trainer.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: I have been a little tense lately...

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: I think a personal trainer is a great idea for you honey! I mean, we haven't had much personal time since we've come here and you've been getting a little...you know, impressions are very important. You understand.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Yes, ZAX, sure. I'll go see him right now. If you'll excuse me, JOEL.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Honey, wait! You know, ZAX, sometimes it seems like you're working against me.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I am only concerned with selecting a suitable Overseer candidate.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: So why do you keep on bringing up Carmen? You know how Beth feels about her...Jesus...

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I do not know the extent of Elizabeth's feelings. I will ask her. Good night, candidate Joel Chambers.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Wait, ZAX, no, that's not what I meant!

items.name: Joel & Elizabeth Chambers - 20780803
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Candidates Joel Chambers and Elizabeth Chambers. August 3, 2078.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Jesus, Beth, what happened back there? Why didn't you pull the trigger? That woman was going to kill me! If Carmen wasn't there...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: What happened?! She was hungry, just like the rest of us! How could I kill someone in cold blood like that... this Vault has changed you, Joel.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Hello, Joel Chambers and Elizabeth Chambers. How are you this afternoon?

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: ZAX, what the hell is going on?! Are we running out of food? I thought we would be okay for years, it's only been 9 months!

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: And where did those guns come from?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Unfortunately, ration supply...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: I can't believe you. What happened to the man I married? Asking me to kill someone... you know, Matthew was right about you.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Always bringing up that meathead... what does he mean to you, anyway? You'd better not be messing around behind my back again, we've talked about this...

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Excessive population has negatively affected ration supply...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Oh, you're one to talk! I've seen you and that little whore sneaking off together, do you think I'm an idiot?

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Don't talk about Carmen like that! You don't know what I've been through, always in the spotlight... Carmen... at least she understands the pressures of fame!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Ration supply has decreased...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: FAME?! You were a STATE Senator, Joel, not President of the United States! Like you got yourself there anyway.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Life's a lot different when your father isn't around to fix all your problems!

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Wow, Beth. Always pointing the finger at me... Well, what about you? What about you, Elizabeth?

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Glad you called in those "favors" to get us stuck in here with these psychopaths!

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: I think I would have rather been blown to smithereens then spend the rest of my life in here with you!

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: ZAX, where's Carmen?! I cannot be stuck in here one more second with... HER!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Locating Carmen Greene. Candidate Carmen Greene is currently...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Glad to hear how you really feel, Joel. ZAX, where's Matt? Let him know I'm coming to see him.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Don't bother, I'm out of here! Good luck on your own, Elizabeth! Have a nice life!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: ARGH! That...you...that no good, cheating...Oh, he'll get what's coming to him, yes he will! ...ZAX, where's Matt?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Candidate Matthew Johnston is currently...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: You know what, forget it. I'll find him myself.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Goodbye.

items.name: Kelly's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: Hey Anya, I know we're just supposed to leave useful things in the dead drop so we don't take up a lot of space, but I wanted to tell you something.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: You're so practical and thoughtful, and you always notice the good stuff first and you always give me things so I can make it out here.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: You're really special to me. I'm sorry if this makes you mad to hear, you probably don't like me like that.

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: I know I was a grade behind you when the war happened. I guess we have to take chances now though, right?

transcript.speaker: Kelly
transcript.text: I'll wait for you in the big cabin where we stayed during the field trip and maybe we can talk about it, okay?

items.name: Last Day of School
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: Turned down by a potential boss once again. If you'd told me when I first got here that I would be anything other than the Overseer of a control vault, I wouldn't have believed you.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: Now that I'm here I'm a little more realistic about things. The Overseer at Vault 96, one of the hottest postings outside of 76, wouldn't even give me the time of day.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: The man sent me a form letter as a rejection for god's sake. At this rate, I'm going to end up shipped out to the west coast to work as a janitor in 29 with a bunch of obnoxious rich teenagers or something.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: It's pretty clear to me now that Vault Tec is a hive of nepotism and ass-kissing. You can't get ahead unless you attend every lecture and write every paper - there's no respect for passion!

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: Some of these kids, they just don't understand what Vault-Tec means! Meanwhile, I have to take my third run at a senior thesis. Should be entertaining to get rejected by Dean Elliot again.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: Anyways, cash is tight so I'm gonna take part in hopefully my last thesis project in the sim vault. This kid seems fine and his experiment is about food, so I get to eat well at least.

items.name: Lewis's Personal Log
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Lewis
transcript.text: Personal log, timestamp 1120761344. My special edition Nuka-Cola lamp arrived in satisfactory condition. After a few... modifications, I am greatly pleased.

transcript.speaker: Lewis
transcript.text: I clearly now have the greatest Nuka-Cola collection in the city, but I've pushed the capacity of this meager hovel to the limit.

transcript.speaker: Lewis
transcript.text: Solution - I need to procure a warehouse in Morgantown for further expansion. But first, I need the proper financial capital...

transcript.speaker: Lewis
transcript.text: I clearly need to strategize a successful commercial enterprise. University students are plentiful. But what do they want...

transcript.speaker: Lewis
transcript.text: Aha! Proposal - students love alcohol. And I love Nuka-Cola. I shall formulate a high-proof distilled spirit with Nuka-Cola. The perfect beverage!

transcript.speaker: Lewis
transcript.text: Hmmm... it just needs a name. Nukahol? Nukamash? Nukabrew? Ah, I'll get to that part later.

items.name: Light 'er Up
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Greg Harris
transcript.text: Ok gang, the boss wanted me to leave you some instructions.. since you apparently can't run this mine without me holding your hands.

transcript.speaker: Greg Harris
transcript.text: We're gonna light this place up today. The holes are drilled, so just get the dynamite packed in and wired up.

transcript.speaker: Greg Harris
transcript.text: Make sure everyone's a safe distance this time. Tommy, you DO NOT TOUCH the plungers, got it? You're the reason we're down two guys this month.

transcript.speaker: Greg Harris
transcript.text: Carl, you're in charge... Don't fuck this up.

items.name: Live-fire Training Exercise
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Dave Strauss
transcript.text: Sutton... I grew up here. Seems kind of quiet and lonely now.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Well it ain't as lonely as you think. This place crawls with ferals, an' ferals is why we're here, rook. It's time for some live-fire training.

transcript.speaker: Dave Strauss
transcript.text: Ferals?! Those things give me the willies! All that hissin' and raspin' and jumpin' around... but then you remember they used to be folks like us.

transcript.speaker: Dave Strauss
transcript.text: Oh no! What if some of them are my relations? Or, I mean, they used to be.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Hey! Get your head in the game, rook! Quit makin' these things out to be more than they are.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Well all come from around here, an' we all had families an' homes that we lost when the bombs fell. Sutton's just a place. The airport's home now.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Get ready. I'm going to make some noise an' draw them out. Just remember your trainin' an' you'll do fine.

transcript.speaker: Dave Strauss
transcript.text: Oh lord, please forgive me if any of these things is a cousin.

items.name: Lucky Hits! Lottery Recording
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: Dear Mr. and Ms. Bennett Orwell...

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: We, of the West Virginia "Lucky Hits!" Lottery Company, are pleased to inform you of the result for our November lottery game

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: held on the 10th of this month!

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: Your names are attached to "Lucky Hits!" lotto ticket '59-28-42-88'.

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: We are overjoyed to tell you that this ticket was November's lucky lottery winner!

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: It's the largest single-month game in 'Lucky Hits!' history!

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: You are hereby approved to receive an immediate cash payment, in the amount of 300,000 dollars!

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: Mr. and Ms. Orwell, CONGRATULATIONS!

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: A local "Lucky Hits!" prize representative will be arriving at your residence on November 30th - just a few short days away!

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: To avoid any unnecessary mix-ups, please contact our headquarters as soon as possible, to confirm your home address!

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: We advise that it's in your best interest to keep this news from the public's attention.

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: We value all of our "Lucky Hits!" customers, and we can't wait to hear from you!

transcript.speaker: Representative
transcript.text: Once again, CONGRATULATIONS, Mr. and Ms. Orwell: Winners of West Virginia's largest ever lottery game!

items.name: Lugnut's Vehicle Modifications
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Lugnut
transcript.text: So I finally found a super charger for Roper's Limo. I sent Dogbreath and his crew over to Gorge Junkyard and they hit the jackpot.

transcript.speaker: Lugnut
transcript.text: They even found an engine hoist, some big block double hump heads and pistons. The head gaskets are blown but that shouldn't be a problem, I'll know more when I start ripping it apart.

transcript.speaker: Lugnut
transcript.text: I'm also gonna take a shot at modifying the exhaust and suspension. The big rig is next on the list, though.

transcript.speaker: Lugnut
transcript.text: I'm having spikes welded on to the sides, that should save bullets when dealing with ghouls. I just finished up mounting a harpoon gun on the hood.

transcript.speaker: Lugnut
transcript.text: Can't wait to own some Settlers with that thing. The Radicals will rain hell on this earth once these vehicles hit the road.

items.name: Madigan Scouting Report - Garrahan
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: You don't mind if I record?

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: You're captain, Melody. Don't need my permission.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Hmph. So, how's it look out there, Hank?

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Well, I found some more survivors. Started shooting at me the second they saw me, like the rest.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Sounds about par for the course. Seems there's not a sane mind south of Mount Blair. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Ash is piling up faster than we expected.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: But going by the maps the earlier teams did, it at least doesn't seem to be spreading anymore.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: So we've only lost Welch, Beckley, Lewisburg and everything around 'em. Little blessings, I suppose.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Oh. And actual good news. Garrahan Mining.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Been a long time since I've heard "good news" and "Garrahan Mining" said back to back.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: No kidding. But that Excavator armor they made. Ruined the company? Rumor is it's tough as nails, and they've still got the plans on site.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Could you imagine what a patrol would be like if we could figure out how to make those things?

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Locals would hopefully be a lot less inclined to shoot first.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Bingo. You give me a day or two, I can head back down there, see what I can do.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: No. Garrahan can wait. You need rest. Head up to Morgantown. That Excavator armor'll still be there. Now go.

items.name: Magnus Westbrooke's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Magnus Westbrooke
transcript.text: When DuBois dropped me off at Bolton Greens, I was horrified.

transcript.speaker: Magnus Westbrooke
transcript.text: Fourth in line for the Westbrooke fortune, and Momsy and Pa-pa had the nerve to leave me at a glorified daycare center while they travel the world?

transcript.speaker: Magnus Westbrooke
transcript.text: Ridiculous.

transcript.speaker: Magnus Westbrooke
transcript.text: To make matters worse, I'm forced to hobnob with the other children, some of whom are mere... millionaires. Ugh, the thought makes my skin crawl.

transcript.speaker: Magnus Westbrooke
transcript.text: The only saving grace of this prison is that they employ a sommelier in the dining room.

transcript.speaker: Magnus Westbrooke
transcript.text: Well, it's time to go fox hunting again. Oh drat, I appear to have scuffed my ostrich jodhpur boots.

transcript.speaker: Magnus Westbrooke
transcript.text: I suppose I'll have to use the... ugh, calfskin ones instead.

items.name: Maria's Last Words
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: My name is Maria Chavez, and I am about to die.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: The Scorched have overrun our defenses. They're coming for us all. If you find this, please listen carefully.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: We were called the Responders. After the bombs fell, we tried to help people. Maybe I can still help you.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: The terminal nearby... if it's still there, use it. Learn about the inoculation project. It might just save your life.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: Shit... they're here. I'm out of time. Read the terminal. Learn about the Scorched. Remember us.

transcript.speaker: Maria Chavez
transcript.text: And... good luck.

items.name: Melody Larkin: Dispatch
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: It's been a helluva week, I tell ya. We lost more good people fightin' off those damn scorched things again.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Now I got Chavez tellin' me we're pickin' up a new radio signal. Someone askin' for help.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: She wants me to take my team and follow it 'til we find 'em. Can't be too far. Already tracked it gainin' strength South a' here.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: Problem is, we'd have to go straight on through Raider country to find 'em and I don't have the time or men to spare right now.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: So, I hate to say it, but I gotta tell her it ain't gonna happen. Not now.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: My team's the last line of defense, and if I take 'em on some wild goose chase, we're leavin' ourselves open for another Christmas Flood situation.

transcript.speaker: Melody Larkin
transcript.text: And, you can bet your ass I ain't gonna let that happen again, even if it means someone out there might need us. Man alive, times 've changed.

items.name: Message for Jeff
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Amy Kerry
transcript.text: Jeff, I really hope you got my message and my hint was clear enough to help you find this holotape.

transcript.speaker: Amy Kerry
transcript.text: I'm leaving the cabin. These Brotherhood of Steel guys haven't found out where I live yet, but they might.

transcript.speaker: Amy Kerry
transcript.text: I'm going to hide out in the place we had our first date. Come and meet me there when you can.

transcript.speaker: Amy Kerry
transcript.text: I locked out my environmental monitoring program with a password and I'd like you to have it.

transcript.speaker: Amy Kerry
transcript.text: After everything the Brotherhood has put us through, there's no way in hell they're getting my research.

transcript.speaker: Amy Kerry
transcript.text: I hope you can find me soon. Until then, be safe and... I love you. I should have told you much sooner, in person.

items.name: Message to Beckley
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: Testing... testing... This is Jay DeeDee. Hope this piece of junk is finally recording.

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: Can't believe I'm using one of these contraptions to send a simple message, but you asked for an update, Earnest. So here you go!

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: Gad is a goldmine! The town that was here may have been gone for ages...

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: ..but between what they left and the gear from the last batch of muck farmers, I could be here for a long while digging it up.

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: There's barely a trickle of water after the dam busted and there are riches poking out of the mud all over the place!

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: I've already built a home of my own. It isn't much, but I'm trying to claim my spot before scavengers show up looking to pounce on the goods.

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: That's why I need your help, Earnest.

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: I know you got guys looking for work over in Beckley. Heard about those machines taking jobs from hard working miners.

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: Tell whoever will listen that I am offering twice what they were making hauling coal to come up to New Gad and lend a hand.

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: Oh! And whatever digging or mining gear they've got would be great too.

transcript.speaker: JayDeedee
transcript.text: Might need to bring some protection as well. Someone built a shack only a stone's throw away and it's only going to get more crowded.

items.name: Monorail Maintenance Log #30045
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.
items.contents: A terminal holotape: load it into your Pip-Boy or a terminal to read it.

items.name: Morris Stevens' Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: Edie and I have been feeling a little extra hungry as of late, and the others are starting to ask questions.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: "Morris, how can you be hungry when you're still so fat?" Well, you know what I say to that?

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: I'm hungry because I'm the boss here! It takes a lot of effort to wrangle these useless idiots so we don't all starve, and that works up an appetite!

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: Honestly, it's been several days since we've come across any more food. The usual unsuspecting travelers have been harder to come by.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: I can only assume the damn Cutthroats have been scaring them all away, or not sharing their finds with us.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: The others won't like it, but we're going to have to go to plan B. Edie's on board with me.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: I've been thinking about Gregory. He's got a lot of meat on him, and he's been rather useless lately. No one will miss him.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: Well, maybe his wife. And his little girl, perhaps.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: But Vanessa will know what's good for her, and she's too much of a good fighter to eat just yet. And the kid... well, I'm not a monster.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: Besides, kids are too scrawny.

items.name: Negotiations
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: You've truly done it this time, Jonathan. This numeric obsession of yours will be our ruin.

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: You have reminded me multiple times it's the only house in the city with that number. But leveraging our only--

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: You what? Don't be a--

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: Fine. Skinner!

transcript.speaker: Skinner
transcript.text: Yes, Mr. Duncan?

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: My brother refuses to continue our discussion without his evening tea because he is a petulant child. Do fetch him some so we can be done with this.

transcript.speaker: Skinner
transcript.text: Mr. Duncan, I hardly mean to be rude, but where, exactly would you like me to bring this tea?

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: To my brother, you imbecile.

transcript.speaker: Skinner
transcript.text: Your brother? ...at the cemetery?

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: What on earth are you talking about? Go downstairs, make his tea, and bring it to the desk directly in front of you where he is seated.

transcript.speaker: Skinner
transcript.text: Sir... there's no one there.

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: You... you don't see him?

transcript.speaker: Skinner
transcript.text: No, sir.

transcript.speaker: James Duncan
transcript.text: Well... that simply won't do. Skinner, fetch my toolkit. You're clearly malfunctioning.

transcript.speaker: Skinner
transcript.text: ... very well... sir.

items.name: Old Nate's Farewell
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Old Nate
transcript.text: I should be sitting here, lying about how I sacrificed myself for my so and so's and I'm quietly fading off and blah blah. I know the drill.

transcript.speaker: Old Nate
transcript.text: But look, I didn't choose to sit out here and watch the bombs go off in my bathrobe like some venerable old peach. No, I was left here to die because I'm old and mean and that's fine by me.

transcript.speaker: Old Nate
transcript.text: I like things how I like them, and I am not going to change one bit for anyone. I recorded this just in case anyone saw my body and felt bad for me.

transcript.speaker: Old Nate
transcript.text: To hell with your sympathy. I'm going out on an IV full of painkillers and you're just jealous that you didn't think of it first. Sucker.

items.name: Order of Mysteries - Council Recording
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Shannon Rivers
transcript.text: All right. Let's keep this brief.

transcript.speaker: Shannon Rivers
transcript.text: Vanessa and Briana are missing. Given recent events, we should assume they've been ambushed.
