items.contents: A terminal holotape: load it into your Pip-Boy or a terminal to read it.

items.name: Morris's End
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: Edie, darling Edie... how delicious you were. the sweet taste of your flesh as... as it passed down my throat.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: The syrupy... warmth of your blood... as it filled my stomach.

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: Wait... what... what have I done? No! Edie, she's dead! I killed her! I ATE her. Oh no, no no...

transcript.speaker: Morris Stevens
transcript.text: But... but, I had to. I must eat... so hungry, starving. Need more... more flesh, more blood. Need more... find... more...

items.name: Movie Pitch #5

location.text: Found near Red Rocket Mega Stop.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Wilma
transcript.text: Movie idea: Robot Rebellion. A Red Rocket Mega Stop tale of terror.

transcript.speaker: Wilma
transcript.text: With all services automated, who do you turn to when the robots are programmed to kill?

transcript.speaker: Wilma
transcript.text: Eh, last part needs some work, but I'll get Carly to spice it up. Maybe this trip wasn't such a waste after all.

items.name: New Meat

location.text: Found near Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Toxic Larry
transcript.text: I smell... new meat. Warm blood. Strong muscles. A stench like it's been around for centuries, hiding in my lands, feeding on my prey...

transcript.speaker: Toxic Larry
transcript.text: Well not anymore it don't. I've caught the creature's scent. *long inhale* And it's near tonight.

transcript.speaker: Toxic Larry
transcript.text: Some dumb kids lit a campfire down the hill... but I won't let them ruin my hunt. I'll take care of them... *long inhale* Won't I, little beastie?

transcript.speaker: Toxic Larry
transcript.text: Then you can come on by and let me have a taste of you.

items.name: NIRA Site Doctor's Report

location.text: Found near National Isolated Radio Array.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Jensen
transcript.text: I had another patient visit my office complaining of intermittent headaches this week.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Jensen
transcript.text: I'm certain the root cause is the same as other similar cases, dielectric heating caused by the site's EM field.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Jensen
transcript.text: As usual, I've prescribed some painkillers and a hood to assist with insulation.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Jensen
transcript.text: I've asked the site director if we could reduce the array's output to a tolerable level until we have shielding installed throughout the facility.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Jensen
transcript.text: Unfortunately, our schedule at NIRA is tight, and it appears the director is unwilling to accommodate my request.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Jensen
transcript.text: Apparently, he considers the project much more important than the health and welfare of our personnel.

items.name: One Last Toast
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: All right, all right, settle down.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: I know the last few weeks have been a shock. We all hoped we could stay here forever.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: But when you stop and think about it, we've been blessed. So many people have had it so much worse.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: For the past year, The Whitespring has been our home. A shelter from the storm just outside the gates.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: It's time for us to face that storm.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: But we're ready. Ready, like none of us was on that day.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: We've had time to plan, to prepare, to stock up. To find friends to share the road ahead.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: The Whitespring bought us that time. Let's make the most of it.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: Ladies and Gentlemen, one last toast. To The Whitespring.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Mountainside
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: *cough* Overseer's log... Somewhere in the mountains...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: *labored breathing* Ooohhhh... Not good, not good, not good.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Just-just trying not... Trying to focus. But the pain is unreal. So bad... Want to do this now while I can... I'm... I'm afraid I might... pass out.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Was attacked... Some kind of... I think it was wearing a gas mask... a heavy coat... But-but not human... Not human...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: No stimpaks left. Funny joke in here about... practicing what you preach... This is... this is... the Overseer. Signing off. Hopefully not for the last time...

items.name: Overseer's Log - Nuke Launch

location.text: Found near Site Alpha, near Radiant Hills.

routes.name: near Site Alpha, near Radiant Hills

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I had a directive from Vault-Tec: secure the region's three nuclear missile silos. I... WE... had to make sure they didn't fall into the wrong hands.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I knew I couldn't do it alone, so I asked you -- my Vault 76 family -- for help. And what did you do?

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: My God... Why? How could you do this? We were supposed to take control of the nukes. Not engage in an Appalachian arms race!

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Please, stop this madness. The cycle of destruction has to stop.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I... I haven't lost faith in you. I know you are GOOD people, and will do the right thing. If anything I've... lost my faith in Vault-Tec.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: They gave me a mission I could never accomplish on my own. They must have known I'd need your help.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Did they also know what you'd do? It's just so hard not to feel... manipulated.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Site Alpha
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Alpha.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: No one's here. Not even any military survivors. That might be for the best. I don't think Vault-Tec asserting jurisdiction over the nukes would've gone over well.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: But, that also means I'm locked out. Access is restricted to the highest ranking officers. It's not going to be easy to fool.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: If we can't secure these sites... My god... the automated factory in the silo... Just how many nukes can it make?

items.name: Overseer's Log - Site Bravo
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Bravo.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The security systems are still operational, just like at site Alpha. My guess is that site Charlie will be the same story, but I need to be sure.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Still have no idea how I'm going to get the military credentials to gain access.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: My hope, my fear, is that some other group of survivors tried to figure this out as well. We just have to keep looking.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Site Charlie
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Charlie.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I've now verified that all three missile silos still have fully operational security.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: No way inside, yet, but I'll scour all of Appalachia if I have to.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Top of the World

location.text: Found near Top of the World.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Top of the World.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: There's someone in control of this old ski resort, and if I ever find her, I'm going wash her mouth out with the first thing vaguely resembling soap I can get my hands on. *exasperated grunt of disgust*

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Selfish. That's the word. Maybe that's why she's alone. Maybe that's why she's survived. But the only way she'll tell me what she knows is if I help her first.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: All the good people I've learned about who've died, and it's the sociopath who still gets to live...

items.name: Paige's Journal, Entry 1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Well, we arrived. We're finally here. It's a damn sight better than the Pitt.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Hopefully we can make a better go of things, now that folks won't be afraid to start families.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Some of us forgot what green, living things looked like after the war.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: The only green we saw was the poison lingering in the air of the Capital, when we left on the last train out of Union Station.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: There's so much energy to build when you finally think things might be able to last. It's a home, a real home, finally!

items.name: Paige's Journal, Entry 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Whenever we get someone new to Foundation, I take the time to meet them. I ask them their name, their story, take their measure. For posterity, sorta.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: More so I don't forget, if I'm being honest. So today I'm talking to Doctor Penelope Hornwright. Are you willing to tell me about yourself, doctor?

transcript.speaker: Penelope Hornwright
transcript.text: Sure. I was born before the war, around here. My father was something of a well known industrialist.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Of course, Daniel Hornwright. I read the papers. Back when we ... had papers to read. So you're a scientist?

transcript.speaker: Penelope Hornwright
transcript.text: Yes, a geochemist.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Uh huh. Not much of a job market these days, huh?

transcript.speaker: Penelope Hornwright
transcript.text: *laughs* I still use it, your farmers will appreciate the soil sample tests that I'm working on.

transcript.speaker: Penelope Hornwright
transcript.text: But yes, mostly these days, I work with robots. I'm not an expert by pre-war standards, but around here I'm like Merlin.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: I don't want to make you uncomfortable, but you're the first ghoul to join our community. We haven't had the chance to talk to many ghouls. How'd it happen?

transcript.speaker: Penelope Hornwright
transcript.text: Most communities have a shoot first policy, because of the ferals. As you can see, some of us do retain our essential personhood despite the physical changes.

transcript.speaker: Penelope Hornwright
transcript.text: I was exposed to a large dose of radiation. I negotiated entry for my child in exchange for fixing a Vault's door.

transcript.speaker: Penelope Hornwright
transcript.text: I knew I was going to get stuck outside, that I'd get dosed. I was the only one who could fix it, though. That was a long time ago. My daughter's nearly twenty now.

transcript.speaker: Penelope Hornwright
transcript.text: Oh! Would it be alright if we got back to this later? My experiment timer is about to go off.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Oh, sure. No rush, I'll be here when you want to talk some more.

items.name: Paige's Journal, Entry 3
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: I'm worried about Jen. That last mission was rough for her. Who'd have thought her mother was alive and in some kinda underground communist pyramid?

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Certainly not me, I'm not into speculative fiction anymore.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Maybe there's something we can do to raise her spirits. Spaghetti night, or hell, maybe some campfire songs and moonshine.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: *snaps his fingers* Scavenger run into Watoga's comic shop, that's the way. Maybe the good doctor can lend a hand with all the killer robots.

items.name: Paige's Journal, Entry 4
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Hell, Fields finally brought his people into the fold. Took him long enough.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: I guess for those three, coming here was about trying to find another unit to join. When that unit ended up being dead, they didn't know where else they belonged.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Well, Foundation's community will do them some good. Do us some good too.

items.name: Paige's Journal, Entry 5
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Well, it's done. We raided the Vault, found a bunch of actual, living secret service goons there. Who could've anticipated that?

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Things have been set in motion to maybe change things around here for the better.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Timeline's iffy though, we'll have to build up some scratch before we're welcome at the table. Then, maybe we can think about expanding around here.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: We've got a lot of newcomers who'll want to put down homesteads, work with Foundation to secure this area against the growing threat of Crater.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: We can do this. We've got to do this.

items.name: Paige's Journal, Entry 5
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Well, we did it! Hopefully that's the hard work done. This is just a huge step forward for our community, and for Appalachia as a whole.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: I know those raiders can't be too happy, but honestly ... what did they expect? Their philosophy for life is pure hubris.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: It's not freedom to let people just shoot each other up, or steal with no consequences. It's pure chaos.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Anyway, if they come looking to cause trouble, we ought to be ready. I'd tell Ward to double the guard for a bit, but he likely already has.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Next thing we need to do is discuss how we can expand, we have a lot of folks just starting out who need homes, farms, businesses.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Time to start drawing up plans. We don't want to rush into anything without thinking about sustaining this place, protecting the people here. Better call a meeting with Ward and such.

items.name: Paige's Journal, Entry 5
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Well, it's done and over with. I guess I understand the desire to divide things up evenly between the folks in Crater and us in Foundation. ...

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: I'm not sure I see any scenario where they use their funds in a way that's good for the overall community of Appalachia, but maybe I'm missing something.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Anyway, we need to focus on making the best of things here for our people. Protecting everybody here and enriching their lives with what we've got.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: I'll have to have a meeting with Ward and some of the others to figure out our plans for expansion, homesteads, and so on.

transcript.speaker: Paige
transcript.text: Not sure how much we can expand and still protect our own, so it's going to have to be planned thoroughly before we do anything. I want to believe we can.

items.name: Pillars of Transcendence

location.text: Found near Palace of the Winding Path.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Pleasant greetings, friend. Thank you for your purchase of our take-home meditation session.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: This recorded meditation will guide you on a spiritual journey towards transcendence.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: We will begin shortly. Take a moment to appreciate your surroundings. And remember, your generous donations make this spiritual journey possible.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Are you ready? Close your eyes. Take a deep breath. Inhale 2... 3... Hold 2... 3... Exhale 2... 3... 4.... Good. And repeat.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Imagine your path to enlightenment as three transcendent pillars, rising towards the sky.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Now, imagine orbs of sublime energy around you. Reach out and gather them. Bring them to your pillars. This is how we will attain transcendence.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: As you build your Pillars of Transcendence, you may find yourself surrounded by Discordant Forces that seek to hinder your spiritual enlightenment.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Banish them using whatever positive affirmations you wish, and do not let them tear down your pillars.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: You are strong. You can overcome this and any other negativity.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Sometimes, the Discordant Forces prove to be too difficult to keep out and your Pillars of Transcendence may falter.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Take solace, for the Holistic Light shines bright when you need it the most. Bathe in its glow until you feel it reinvigorate your pillars.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Now that you have everything visualized, I will begin a series of positive affirmations while you act to achieve Transcendence.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Punish any discordant forces that stand in your way. Do not let them harm you spiritually.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: If you feel your physical self reacting to their presence, that's okay, but please be aware of your surroundings and do not damage our property.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Maintain a sense of tranquility. Push aside any internal strife. It's important to transcend your physical boundaries while at peace with yourself.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Your existence on this world is merely temporary, the Palace of the Winding Path will help you ascend beyond that limitation.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Align your spiritual aura with the Pillars of Transcendence. Draw in energy from the outside, attune it to your spirit, and pass it through.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Free your mind from all distractions and worries. Focus on the Pillars of Transcendence. Focus on keeping out the discordant forces.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Follow my voice. Listen to my meditations. Let them calm you, let me guide you to a place of peace and tranquility.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Gather that sublime energy and let it flow into the pillars.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Let the warmth it provides guide your spirit toward a new plane of existence beyond the physical.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Empty your mind of all your troubles. Leave them behind you as you ascend to your new spiritual existence.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Discordant forces may leave lasting physical harm if you let them damage your spiritual self.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Discordant forces may also be drawn in by spiritual incense, seeking its blissful embrace.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Believe in yourself. Believe in the powers of others like you.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: You can attain enlightenment together and reap the rewards of a higher state of consciousness.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Peer at yourself through the lens of your mind's eye. See yourself as others see you. Examine yourself from a short distance at all angles.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: You may find you gain a new perspective on life.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: You're feeling so relaxed right now.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Feel the sublime energy surround you. Embrace it, feed it into your pillars, and allow it to lead you along your path to transcendental bliss.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: The outside world has no meaning while you focus on your inner self.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Imagine you are floating along in a cloud of pure emotional bliss. If the cloud is mauve colored, chant a calming phrase until it is not.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Discordant Forces form in response to our fears, doubts, and insecurities. Gather your courage and confront them head-on.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Feel the warm relaxing energy flow into your body. You can feel it flow into your arms. Into your legs. Into your fingers and toes.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: This sensation brings with it a wave of tranquility and deep relaxation.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: The light in your mind, body, and soul grows as you build the pillars of Transcendence. Open your heart to it and feel its peaceful embrace.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: You feel as if you are one with nature, with the universe, with everything.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Only through complete transcendence, will you attain true enlightenment and exceed your physical bounds.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: After you transcend, it is completely normal to feel a need to abandon your material wealth. Seek one of our gurus if you wish for help with that.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Breathe in deeply through your nose... hold it... and let it out through your mouth.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Your transcendental journey may be long, but patience is key to spiritual well-being.

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: Be sure to book your next stay with us now and save ten percent off a future spiritual aura cleansing

transcript.speaker: Guided Meditation
transcript.text: This concludes our Guided Meditation session.

items.name: Presidential Cottage Security Recording

location.text: Found near The Whitespring North Entrance.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.text: *door creaks*

transcript.speaker: Young Woman
transcript.text: Brody?

transcript.speaker: Brody
transcript.text: Hey.
*kiss*

transcript.speaker: Young Woman
transcript.text: You're late.

transcript.speaker: Brody
transcript.text: I know, I know. Sorry. This is Blackwater territory - we've had issues with them lately.

transcript.speaker: Young Woman
transcript.text: Spare me. Any news?

transcript.speaker: Brody
transcript.text: The last two raids have gone well. We lost a couple of guys, but nothing like before.

transcript.speaker: Brody
transcript.text: The boss said he'd take your deal.

transcript.speaker: Young Woman
transcript.text: Finally.

transcript.speaker: Brody
transcript.text: I can't believe it. Babe, you and I are moving up in the world.

transcript.speaker: Brody
transcript.text: Do you have the tape?

transcript.speaker: Young Woman
transcript.text: Not yet. I found the program I need. Meet me here next week, and I'll have it for you.

transcript.speaker: Young Woman
transcript.text: Until then, I've got another ambush site picked out. You think you can do this?

transcript.speaker: Brody
transcript.text: Hmm. Lewisburg? Yeah, Kerry's gang is down that way.

transcript.speaker: Young Woman
transcript.text: All right, I'll set it up. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Brody
transcript.text: No, we're good. See you next week.
*footsteps, door closes*

transcript.speaker: Young Woman
transcript.text: Idiot.

items.name: Radio Log: Aug 29 2077
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Trying band.. uhhh... AH-13. *sigh*

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Lieutenant! I got something!

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: I can't make anything out.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Sorry. Working on it.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: ... Maxson to Appalachia. I repeated, this is Captain Roger Maxson.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Give that to me.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Seeking any-

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Lieutenant Taggerdy here. Captain? It's you?

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Lizzy? Damn, it's good to hear a friendly voice.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Captain. I heard... I heard you're a traitor.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Traitor? If disobeying unconscionable orders makes you a traitor, then I suppose I am.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Lizzy, I'm glad you're alive but I need to find someone in Appalachia. Someone dependable.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: That's where I am. The Thunder was running war games against some jarheads.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: They still in one piece? By god, Lizzy. This... This is good news.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Roger, you're a traitor. I could be court-martialed even talking to you.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Look around, Lizzy. The Army's gone. America's fallen.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: I know you have questions, but we need to talk. There are things I learned at Mariposa.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: I got a scientist with me... Doctor Takano. We'll set up a secure channel.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: I'll answer all your questions, then.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Captain...

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Lizzy, you know me. We need to talk.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: We'll monitor this band. Taggerdy out.

items.name: Reginald Stone's Journal, entry 712
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Regs
transcript.text: All the gold is safely stored and accounted for.

transcript.speaker: Regs
transcript.text: Two years of back breaking work schlepping those heavy bars.

transcript.speaker: Regs
transcript.text: We had a little celebration, but then its back to the grind.

transcript.speaker: Regs
transcript.text: The paperwork won't fill itself out. Nobody else seems to think its important, but am I the only one who knows that it is?

transcript.speaker: Regs
transcript.text: When the government comes looking for their gold, I don't want there to be any issues.

items.name: Return to Appalachia
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: Personal Log, Doctor Edgar Blackburn. Return to Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: After all these years, I have come back. Back to Appalachia. To West Virginia. To the home of my greatest personal and scientific failure.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: Academic research was a dead end; the world was descending into riots and ruin, food shortages were increasing...

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: Generating papers in a university lab to attempt to secure tenure seemed pointless. It felt irresponsible in the face of everything happening.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: West Tek approached me about joining the Greenhouse Initiative. Genetic engineering to produce new crops and multiply production.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: It swept away my concerns about joining the private sector. Here was a chance to be on the cutting edge and solve real problems at the same time.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: Doctor Dumont described the goals of the Pan-Immunity Virion and the Greenhouse Initiative in terms that set my mind ablaze.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: There was satisfaction to be had there. Doing the best work, advancing humanity, making the world better than it was.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: Then the funding vanished. The research staff was being cut, with no explanation, simply "a shift in priorities".

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: Dumont begged me to stay, promising the new work would be vital and challenging. To my everlasting shame, I did.

transcript.speaker: Doctor Blackburn
transcript.text: End log.

items.name: Rory's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Rory
transcript.text: I found the mother lode, baby. Some bunker tucked away in the swamp. I bet it's got supplies for at least a couple years stashed away inside.

transcript.speaker: Rory
transcript.text: Now it's just a matter of breaking in, but that damn girl holed up in there's got some sort of terminal controlling the locks on the door.

transcript.speaker: Rory
transcript.text: If I didn't suck at hacking I'd be in there by now. Four tries and you're locked out. It's bullshit. But I ain't gonna let anyone else know.

transcript.speaker: Rory
transcript.text: That place and everything inside is all mine. No sharing here! Just a matter of getting that damn password.

transcript.speaker: Rory
transcript.text: I just gotta wait for that Abbie chick to leave and come back. Then I sneak in the door behind her, and BAM. She's dead, and I'm living the dream.

items.name: Rosalynn and David's Ski Trip

location.text: Found near Top of the World.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: David Thorpe
transcript.text: Hey, turn it off. Do you want my wife to find out about this?

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: Aw c'mon! I wanna make a recording of us! You said you were gonna ditch that old hag when we got back, anyway.

transcript.speaker: David Thorpe
transcript.text: Hmph. Fine. But it goes with you when we leave, and you need to promise to destroy it if word ever gets out about us.

transcript.speaker: David Thorpe
transcript.text: I have too much to lose in a divorce and leaving evidence like that laying around will only make it worse.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: Oh don't be an ol' stick in the mud. No one's gonna find out. Pinky swear!

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: Hey, you got any more of those chems with you?

transcript.speaker: David Thorpe
transcript.text: Yeah, what do you want, Daytripper? Help yourself, just don't take too much. Don't, uh... get addicted.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: Yes sir. Input received, sir. Awaiting orders.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: <Rosalynn popping pills>

transcript.speaker: David Thorpe
transcript.text: Okay, I get it, you're not a robot. I know you don't like it when I order you around like that.

transcript.speaker: David Thorpe
transcript.text: You're my darling Rose. I just don't want anything bad to happen to you.

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: Aww, baby! You goin' all soft on me now? Haha! You know I love ya! <kiss>

transcript.speaker: Rosalynn Jeffries
transcript.text: Hey, you wanna hit the slopes, or do you maybe have something else in mind?

transcript.speaker: David Thorpe
transcript.text: All right, you little minx, now you really have to turn off the recorder.

items.name: Springhill Feedback

location.text: Found near The Whitespring North Entrance.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: Mr. Ainsley. I wanted to remark upon the fascinating design of your new Springhill golf course.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: You appear to have seven holes. Seven. What a curious number.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: Nine, I could understand. Or perhaps six, played thrice. But... seven.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: Most courses put ever so much effort into varying their holes. You appear to have liked your third so much, you repeated it immediately.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: Or take the cart paths. One normally takes such little note of them.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: I had a wonderful chance to reflect on that during the three-mile drive from the fifth hole to the sixth.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: And then, seven. Ah, seven. Such a slope. It would make a fabulous ski run.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: Not that teeing off with a four hundred yard putt wasn't a unique experience.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: I confess, when I heard you had carved up your championship golf course for housing tracts, I was concerned it might have impacted the quality a little.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: Clearly, I underestimated the scope of your ambition.

transcript.speaker: Henrietta Winchester
transcript.text: Cordially yours. Henrietta Winchester.

items.name: Subject K-117M Interview

location.text: Found at West Tek Research Center.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Technician Stone
transcript.text: Okay, K-117M. In your own words, please describe how you feel.

transcript.speaker: Subject K-117M
transcript.text: I... feel different... like my mind is not my own...

transcript.speaker: Technician Stone
transcript.text: Do you remember who you were?

transcript.speaker: Subject K-117M
transcript.text: Yes, I was... Billy Seevers... a man living in... in...

transcript.speaker: Technician Stone
transcript.text: You don't remember where you're from?

transcript.speaker: Subject K-117M
transcript.text: No... I... what's happening to me? Can you... make me better?

transcript.speaker: Technician Stone
transcript.text: I'm asking the questions, K-117M. If you're patient, I'll help you. Okay?

transcript.speaker: Subject K-117M
transcript.text: Yes, I... understand.

transcript.speaker: Technician Stone
transcript.text: Good, good. You're doing really well, K-117M. Now, one more question.

transcript.speaker: Technician Stone
transcript.text: If we asked you to help us, would you do exactly as we command?

transcript.speaker: Subject K-117M
transcript.text: Yes... anything. I just want to... go home... home... wife? Where's my wife!?

transcript.speaker: Technician Stone
transcript.text: Uh, she's fine K-117M. Calm down please.

transcript.speaker: Subject K-117M
transcript.text: No! What have you done to my wife?! Bring her to me, now! I'll kill all of you!

transcript.speaker: Technician Stone
transcript.text: Code red in Interrogation Room B, I repeat, code red!

items.name: Subject K-120F Personal Recording

location.text: Found at West Tek Research Center.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Subject K-120F
transcript.text: When they took me from Huntersville, I thought I was being taken to a hospital.

transcript.speaker: Subject K-120F
transcript.text: I've been sick for days, but no one at this place seems to care.

transcript.speaker: Subject K-120F
transcript.text: This room they've left me in looks more like a cell. They keep the door locked at all times.

transcript.speaker: Subject K-120F
transcript.text: The nurse that visits me is the only other person I've seen since I've gotten here, and he won't talk to me.

transcript.speaker: Subject K-120F
transcript.text: He keeps giving me injections, but I don't feel any better.

transcript.speaker: Subject K-120F
transcript.text: What's happening to me? Why is my skin changing color? Do I have a disease? No one will tell me anything!

transcript.speaker: Subject K-120F
transcript.text: I can't stand this anymore. I just want to get out of this place and go home.

items.name: Taking a Chance
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text: I had just gotten back from my pre-dawn hunt when the bomb hit. I could see the mushroom cloud from the front window of the house.

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text: The way the window framed the explosion was strange, almost like it wasn't really happening. It was too perfect, too... beautiful.

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text: Luckily Johnson's Acre was too remote to be damaged, but I'm betting it won't be long before I start feeling the effects of the radiation.

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text: Whether I want to or not, I'm going to have to travel into Charleston to try and gather supplies before they're all gone.

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text: Damn it, if I'd only brought more than a weekend's worth of food, I could have stayed here where it's safe.

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text: If you're listening to this message, that probably means I found somewhere else to lay low... or I never made it at all.

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text: Maybe having a roof over your head for the night will give you hope, god knows we can all use a little bit of that right now.

items.name: The Chosen
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: The Interloper is here, I can feel it clearly. Last night, in visions more real than the senses it called to me.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: And I go to it now. Signs are all around that I am not the only one to hear the call.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: Though where they have failed, I will not, for it summons me alone in the end.

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: Before I go deeper, for the truth revealed changes all by its very nature...

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: Let it be known, in this world, the Interloper has chosen Jeff Lane as the conduit of the unknowable...

transcript.speaker: Jeff Lane
transcript.text: Together the hidden reality becomes manifest at long last.

items.name: The Decadent Metal Dome
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: It's a long hike to the Metal Dome. Jagged paths up the cliffs above Monongah are the only feasible way for pilgrims to reach this shrine to violence.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: You have to be a certain kind of lunatic to make the journey. One wrong move and you're dashed upon the rocks below, fodder for rabid wolves and mutant lizards.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Not to mention that your future hosts - the engineers of death that call themselves the Rust Eagles - are less than welcoming to outsiders.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Luckily, I am anything but sane. I climbed the mountain to witness with my own two eyes the bloody spectacle these brutal raiders were only too eager to display.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I knew what I was walking into - or thought I knew - but still I was unprepared for what I was about to witness, and for the feelings it stirred inside me.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: The first thing to reach you is the sound of it. From half a mile away the shriek of steel cutting steel reassures you that you haven't come all this way for nothing.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: But what really sticks with you is the stench. The rot of decaying corpses, the smell of searing flesh, and the stink of oil that pervades every inch of the place.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Fumes that drive the Rusties into an ecstatic frenzy whenever one of their bots extinguishes a human life.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: You settle in to witness the action in the arena, and the worst part is you can't look away.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: You get so sucked in that you forget all about the last shred of humanity you used to have.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: You tell yourself you want the gladiators to win as the carnage unfolds below. It's the only way to justify your sheer captivation.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Yet you acknowledge that it grips you like you never thought possible.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: No matter what else you've seen in this godforsaken world, there's simply nothing like the thrill of it.

items.name: The Huntersville Incident
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.text: (Pounding on door - as if heard from inside a house)

transcript.speaker: Darlene Sherman
transcript.text: Who is it?

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Taybert
transcript.text: U.S. Army, ma'am. Open up, please.

transcript.speaker: Darlene Sherman
transcript.text: What do you want?

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Taybert
transcript.text: Just open the door, Ms. Sherman.
(Sound of deadbolt sliding open and door opening)

transcript.speaker: Darlene Sherman
transcript.text: Y-Yes?

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Taybert
transcript.text: On behalf of the U.S. Army and West-Tek, you're hereby ordered to hand over custody of your child, "Dalton Sherman," over to us immediately.

transcript.speaker: Darlene Sherman
transcript.text: What? Over my dead body! He's sick, he's not going anywhere!

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Taybert
transcript.text: You have no choice. Where is he ma'am?

transcript.speaker: Darlene Sherman
transcript.text: The hell I don't have a choice! You're not moving that child one inch or so help me I'll...

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Taybert
transcript.text: Ma'am! If you don't move aside right now, we'll move you ourselves. Do you understand?
(Sound of a knife being lifted from a table)

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Taybert
transcript.text: Put down the knife, Ms. Sherman. I won't ask again.

transcript.speaker: Darlene Sherman
transcript.text: No! Get out of my house! Dalton is only sick! He'll get better! You people can't take him like you took the others! You can't! I won't let you!
(Sound of a single gunshot and then a body dropping to the ground)

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Taybert
transcript.text: Goddamn it.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Taybert
transcript.text: Corporal Gibbons, put her in a body bag. Private Zeleski, go find the kid.

items.name: The Whitespring Staff Meeting, 12.27.79
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: And... recording. All right. What are we looking at?

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: I've got nothing.

transcript.speaker: Paula Hamilton
transcript.text: Really, Lew? Really? You set up the damn things. Don't tell me you don't know how to hack them.

transcript.speaker: Paula Hamilton
transcript.text: Can't you just shut them off? Or keep them from turning on us? There has to be a way.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: Paula-

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: No. Really, no. I'm sorry, Paula. We've tried everything.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: Not just me, every guest who can work a terminal. We've been locked out. We're getting kicked out. And there's nothing we can do.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: Paula, how's the training going?

transcript.speaker: Paula Hamilton
transcript.text: Friedrich's classes are a joke, but the guests have been pitching in.

transcript.speaker: Paula Hamilton
transcript.text: The Warrens picked up a few things on safari. Sgt. Tommelson's been teaching marksmanship.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: Tommelson? That crank who thinks the communists are bugging his room?

transcript.speaker: Paula Hamilton
transcript.text: Yeah. Best we got.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: God.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: At least people have been stocking up. The 'All-You-Can-Carry' Shopping Spree was a hit. No one turned that down.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: Anyone have anything else? Robert, how're things?

transcript.speaker: Robert Mitchell
transcript.text: Keepin' on.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: Good. The Gala's on Sunday, so this may be our last staff meeting.

transcript.speaker: Joyce Easton
transcript.text: Whatever happens... we did all we could, this past year. I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.

items.name: They're Coming

location.text: Found near The Whitespring Golf Club.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: They keep coming. They, they just keep coming.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: Rob. Rob saw them first. Three. Just, just three, out on the Seventh. Easy shots from up here.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: At first, we thought it was fun. Tried to see who could, who could pick them off. Extra points for the head.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: Then, then Rob went missing. Went down to the range. Wasn't far. Wasn't, wasn't back by dark.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: Then Ted. Zack. Zack, Phil, Mark. God, Mark. They dragged him. I can, can still hear him screaming.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: Now we're three. Just, just three. Can't run. Can't hold. Can't.

transcript.speaker: Lew Palmest
transcript.text: They're, they're coming. They're coming!

items.name: Trappers' Warning
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: Thorpe, we got a bit of a situation here I want to report. Gonna send this here holotape with a runner to ya, soon as I can.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: Me and the other Trappers set up this camp here near Devil's Backbone just like we all agreed on, and it's been workin' out for us.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: Plenty of game to catch, plenty of unlucky saps wanderin' in from the East still.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: But uh... You know how we said stay out of Huntersville, and don't drink the water near there?

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: We thought it was just some sort of quarantine zone full of sick people, so we made sure not to poke at it.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: We started hearin' some noises comin' from the town a bit back, so I done reckoned we'd better send someone to check it out.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: Well he come back talking 'bout some big 'ol green 'uns stalkin' around. tryin' to rip up the fence 'round town, and bustin' up stuff real good.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: First I heard. So I get him to show me, and I don't believe my eyes. These... big green fellers were in there, looked like, ransacking the town.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: Next thing you know, them Brotherhood of Steel folks are marchin' on it and clashin' with the other guys, and they ain't doing to well against 'em.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: Soon as it looked like the armored goons were losin' the fight, we hauled ass back here, and that's where we're at.

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: Fightin's still goin' on, and we'll keep an eye on the situation, but if things go belly up...

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: <Gunfire and shouting>

transcript.speaker: Walter Griswold
transcript.text: Aw shit! It's those green bastards and they've got guns!

items.name: Vault 96 Biology Log #280
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: Molly Cooper, Biology. Log, um, 280.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: What is this?

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: The specimen record is blank. No vitals, no measurements, no source data. Just an ID: 'X-001'.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: The cellular structure is unlike anything I've ever seen. I can't even identify the organelles.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: I ran it through the DNA sequencer. Twice. But... nothing. Nothing at all.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: I talked it over with Nina, and she's going to try splicing into some of the cellular structures at random, just to see what happens.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: It's a longshot, but we have a quota to meet. Fucking Vault-Tec.

items.name: Vault 96 Community Meeting
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: All right, calm down. We've all...

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: Calm down? Erik, what kind of a scam is this?

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: I know this isn't what you expected. I'm still trying to process it all, too.

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: Bullshit. You worked for Vault-Tec! You had to know!

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Jeanette, I already told you-
*bangs fist*

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: So. The door has sealed. There is no way for us to reopen it.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Apparently not.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: And it's just the five of us in here?

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: That's right.

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: That's crazy. You could fit an entire town in here!

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: I want to know about the experiments. Are there really ten thousand creatures in cryo here?

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: And instead of preserving them, you want us to experiment on them. Induce mutations. Optimize for lethality.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Those are our orders. You will all have weekly research quotas to meet.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: And if we refuse? Or fall short?

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Anyone failing to meet their quota, or otherwise trying to rebel, will be... eliminated.

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: You can't be serious.
*footsteps*
Sir.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: I'm afraid so.

items.name: Vault 96 Genetics Log #100
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Genetic Research Log, Week 100. Retrospective.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Our first mutations were simple enough. Venom. Regeneration. Electrogenesis. Natural phenomena with well-understood biochemical processes.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Despite my initial misgivings, developing, adapting, and enhancing general-purpose mutagenic sequences has been a fascinating challenge.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: So much so that I fear we have set the bar too high.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Erik's quotas are ever more aggressive, even as potential research targets grow increasingly elusive.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Molly and I have moved on to more speculative mutations. Chameleonization. Pyrokinesis. Cryokinesis.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: But after that... I am less certain. This pace is maddening. How much longer can we maintain it?

items.name: Vault 96 Genetics Log #142
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Genetic Research Log, Week 142.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Specimen X-001 has been a most remarkable success.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: I confess, I was skeptical when Molly showed me her analysis. There was little to work with, given its... unique biology.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: As an initial bench test, I spliced each of our extant stable mutations into separate samples.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: They all worked. Flawlessly. As if we had spent months adapting them.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: And then the mutations... spread.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: They somehow shifted from one sealed petri dish to the next, until all of the samples exhibited all of the mutations. Fascinating.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: I wanted to proceed to live subject testing immediately, but all of our attempts to resuscitate a specimen have been blocked.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Hans is looking into it. In the meantime, this transference capability merits further investigation.

items.name: Vault 96 Genetics Log #143
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Genetic Log, Week... 148? 148.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: There is little progress to report. Too little.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: The Shifting mutation is still unstable. When stressed, subjects will shift or... or phase, or...

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: ...whatever it is. It works. But it's inconsistent. Uncontrollable.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: Without some understanding of the underlying physics or biology, there is little I can do to stabilize or improve on it.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: If I could study the original specimen, perhaps I could make some progress.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: But there is, apparently, only one subject, in a secured cryonics bay, with military access controls.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: I've no doubt Erik could get in, but he has refused.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: I have put everything into this research. I'm out of time.

transcript.speaker: Nina Valaya
transcript.text: I will not make my quota. Forgive me, Molly.

items.name: Vault 96 Mainframe Lab Recording
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: And... down. Go, go, go.
*Running*

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Robotics control failure in: the Mainframe Wing. Activating Emergency Fabrication Protocol FS-401.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Jeanette. Circuits 10, 18, 57.

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: Got it.

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Fabrication system: offline. Activating Emergency Repair Protocol CR-889.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: 889, that's... Hans, we need a reactor brownout.

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: All right, give me a minute.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: 109's next. Jeanette?

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: Ready on the detonator.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Molly, are you in?

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: Sorry, sorry, just a-

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: Brownout in 3, 2, 1...
*Power failure*

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Power fluctuations detected in: the Engineering Wing. Activating Emergency Stabilization Protocol ES-109.
*Explosion*

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Detonation in: the Cryogenics Wing.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: That should do it.

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Activating Superceding Protocol Omega.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: Erik?

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: That's not in the database. What...?

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Protocol confirmed. All exits have sealed to prevent a containment breach.

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Calculating optimal process to exterminate all personnel in the Vault. ...done. All remaining personnel may now be terminated.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: I'm locked out!

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Here, I got it. Cover the door!
*Fighting*

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Damn it, almost...

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Data upload from compromised system detected. Suspect data stream has been quarantined.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: What? Bypass, bypass!

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Gah!

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: All residents have been terminated. Operation: successful. Have a nice day.

items.name: Vault 96 Orientation Session
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: *sobs*

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Get ahold of yourself.

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: Bastard. Nina's dead, Erik! Dead! All because of your damn quotas. If you can't show a little compassion, shut the hell up.

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: Hey, now.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: I regret what happened to Nina. I truly do. But we're wasting time.
*click*

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: What?

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: There. That should disable the sensors. Listen carefully.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: They aren't 'my' quotas. They never have been. They're set by the Mainframe. Look, here are next week's numbers.

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: God. There's no way...

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: Why didn't you tell us?

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: It's on a hair trigger. If it detects anything, any word of conspiracy or sedition, it will kill us. I had to be sure.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: The only way we survive the next week is to take it out.

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: You want us to fight our way out?

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: We don't have to. For the past two years, I've been working on a virus. SERAPH.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Upload it into the Mainframe, and it can take over, shut down the system, the experiments, everything. It can let us out.

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: The EMS-

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: -won't be a problem. I designed that system. My students wrote the damn protocols. I can beat it.

transcript.speaker: Molly Cooper
transcript.text: We can't go on like this. I'm... I'm in. For Nina.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Jeanette? Hans?

transcript.speaker: Hans Memling
transcript.text: I... all right.

transcript.speaker: Jeanette Higgins
transcript.text: What the hell. Sure.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Here's what I need from you. We move on Saturday, just before the quota check. Be ready.

transcript.speaker: Vault Mainframe
transcript.text: Sensor discrepancy detected in: the Overseer's Office. Applying cancellation algorithm... done.

transcript.speaker: Erik DeMarcos
transcript.text: Have a good week, everyone. Dismissed.

items.name: Vox Interpreter Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: System Voice
transcript.text: Welcome Dr. Harrison. The Vox Interpreter Program is now running. Stand by for today's data assignments. Valid Vox interpretation banks loaded.

transcript.speaker: System Voice
transcript.text: Ensure you maintain the minimum transmission distance from the dart while you collect the requisite amount of Vox data per sample. Happy hunting!

items.name: War Games
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: We're in the mission boundary, right, Weber?

transcript.speaker: Gary Weber
transcript.text: Uh, we're at... Spruce Knob. Uh. Two clicks. We're two clicks from the edge.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: So we hug the line, move hard, move fast. And we may catch the marines with their pants down.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: LT, you may want to listen to this?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: What is it, Moreno?

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: The comm. The chatter's weird. Let me...
"Confirmed nuclear strike on New York. Shit. Shit."
"Oh god, it's the end... The end!"
"Keep all the-" *static*

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: The whole channel's been... blocked? Not sure how they're doing that.

transcript.speaker: Gary Weber
transcript.text: Man, the brass has gone all out. Is this part of the war game, Lieutenant?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: In the event of a nuclear exchange, we are to immediately seek orders from a superior.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: For the purpose of these war games, however, we are completely on our own. Cut off from command.

transcript.speaker: Ted Wilson
transcript.text: Any standing orders we can fall back on, Lieutenant?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: None that I know of-

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Whoa. Did you...?

transcript.speaker: Gary Weber
transcript.text: There's one over there, too.

transcript.speaker: Ted Wilson
transcript.text: Mother of...

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Uh, this isn't no war game?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Turn that off.

items.name: Weapon Demonstration
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Settler
transcript.text: Alright, everyone gather 'round. Ward wanted us to record some instructions on how to use these things... Where's Mike?

transcript.speaker: Settler
transcript.text: Hey... Mike! Stop messing around with that terminal and grab one of those rocket launchers.

transcript.speaker: Mike Tiller
transcript.text: O-oh! Sorry, I wanted to lock the terminal first. Let me put this in my bag really quick.

transcript.speaker: Settler
transcript.text: Give it up, Mike, that could be decades old. Just grab one of them and come here... Wait, Mike, I told you not to pick it up like that!

transcript.speaker: Settler
transcript.text: (Explosion)

transcript.speaker: Mike Tiller
transcript.text: Oh god... What have I done?

items.name: Welcome to the Freak Show
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Freak Show Owner
transcript.text: "Welcome... to the Freak Show!"

transcript.speaker: Freak Show Owner
transcript.text: No, that's not right. Take two. *clears throat*

transcript.speaker: Freak Show Owner
transcript.text: "Welcome to the FREAK show!"

transcript.speaker: Freak Show Owner
transcript.text: Too much emphasis in the middle there.

transcript.speaker: Freak Show Owner
transcript.text: "Welcome to the Freak Show! T-The Freak Show!"

transcript.speaker: Freak Show Owner
transcript.text: No no no no no. No.

transcript.speaker: Freak Show Owner
transcript.text: Uh. Feast? Feast. Uh. "F-Feast your eyes... ON THE FREAK SHOW!"

transcript.speaker: Freak Show Owner
transcript.text: I'll take a break.

items.name: Wendigo Cave - Soldier's Story
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Soldier
transcript.text: The world is over. I think that's the first time I've said it out loud. It sounds... strange.

transcript.speaker: Soldier
transcript.text: After the bombs hit, people kept looking to us for answers. And I'd tell them, "Don't worry, help is on the way!" It's clear to me now that there's nobody left.

transcript.speaker: Soldier
transcript.text: Winter has been brutal. It started a few weeks after the bombs hit and shows no signs of letting up. Hell, maybe Winter is all that's left now.

transcript.speaker: Soldier
transcript.text: I remembered this cave from grade school. Kids called it the Wendigo Cave. I was scared of it then, absolutely terrified. Now it's the only thing keeping us alive.

transcript.speaker: Soldier
transcript.text: We'll stay here to survive the cold, then we'll get back out there. The men trust me to keep them alive, and I haven't let them down yet. Here's hoping that record holds.

items.name: Magellan's Log #1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: All right, my pretties! It is time for rehearsal! Let's get into our positions now, please!

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: *Overgrown gurgling* Allistaire, please. You can be a diva after you make it big. Until then, you do as I say. Are we clear?

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: *Overgrown growls* Okay then! We're going to start off with a performance from Violetta. Violetta, please sing the last refrain in E minor.

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: *Floater noises* Gah! Stop that at once! I've never heard a more tone-deaf singer in my life!

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: Oh God, what am I going to do?! These Overgrown are talentless hacks!

items.name: Magellan's Log #2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: This Eastern American tour of mine is already falling apart.

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: I originally planned for us to stop and perform in Pittsburgh for several weeks, but we've put the kibosh on that plan for sure now.

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: The whole city is covered in this disgusting smog. Geiger counters sing the opera even on the city lines.

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: If there's anyone left in there, I'm not sure they even have eyes nor ears to witness our show.

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: We'll have to reroute, possibly through the country. By George, just the thought of smelling some unwashed yokels terrifies me.

transcript.speaker: Magellan
transcript.text: Yet, I have no choice. Damn you Salvatore Sticky Fingers! DAMN YOU!!

items.name: US Government Supply Requisition

location.text: Found at Vault 63 Engineering Sector, near Slumber Mill Motel, Vault 63 Meteorology Sector, near Sons of Dane Compound and 8 more places.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.
items.contents: A terminal holotape: load it into your Pip-Boy or a terminal to read it.

items.name: A Safe Haven
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Unidentified Ghoul
transcript.text: I don't know if I'm sick, or I'm dying, but my body has changed.

transcript.speaker: Unidentified Ghoul
transcript.text: I've sought help, but people laugh at my appearance or turn me away.

transcript.speaker: Unidentified Ghoul
transcript.text: I'm what people are calling a "ghoul," a name that sickens me to my stomach.

transcript.speaker: Unidentified Ghoul
transcript.text: I've been chased out of my own home, and now I'm running from place to place hiding like a criminal.

transcript.speaker: Unidentified Ghoul
transcript.text: A week ago, I was begging for food and was almost shot by someone who didn't want me near them. Well, I've had enough.

transcript.speaker: Unidentified Ghoul
transcript.text: I found a note from someone named Lucy Harwick. She claims to run a place where people like me can go to live their life without being afraid.

transcript.speaker: Unidentified Ghoul
transcript.text: I'm going to head out to Valley Galleria to see if it's true. I hope to god that it is, because I don't know how much more of this I can take.

items.name: About the Brotherhood
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Thank you, Captain. It's just us.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Lizzy. What's on your mind?

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: A Brotherhood of Steel? What's that even mean? The men over here are confused.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: We need to do something bold.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: We can't just stay the US Army.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: What's going to happen, and this is only a matter of time, is some general, or some goddamned politician is going to exit a Vault and start ordering us around.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: And worse they'll order some grunt to start the whole damned cycle again.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Another wave of nuclear death. And if that's not enough they'll do it again.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: You know they will, Lizzy. It ends with us. We won't let them.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: I... I understand. But a Brotherhood? Knights? I'm supposed to call you, what, Elder?

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Words have power, Lizzy. They build identity. They take on a meaning if you keep using them, even if it didn't exist to begin with.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: It was the Knights and Scribes after the fall of Rome that protected what was left of Western civilization.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: So we are the new Knights and our role is similar.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But we'll need more than names. We'll need new traditions, our own, well, mythology.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Something people can believe to their core.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Is this necessary?

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: What else can I do? Declare myself President? Make you a Senator?

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Look around. Something's killing us more than the rads and freaks out there.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Depression. People have lost everyone. Every goddam soul. Wives, kids, loved ones, heck even the mailman.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: We need to replace it with something otherwise people's souls will wither. We'll be little more than walking dead men.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: I'll do my best to see the orders carried out, sir.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Give it time, Lizzy. People have a hunger to believe in something. Just let them work their way to it.

items.name: Captain's Log #1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Captain Raymond Clark
transcript.text: Ever since I washed up on these shores, my mind's felt more and more adrift. I'm hopin' this might be a way to keep me anchored.

transcript.speaker: Captain Raymond Clark
transcript.text: My name is Captain Raymond Clark. My father was a bosun and so was his father before him.

transcript.speaker: Captain Raymond Clark
transcript.text: My mother's name was Deidre and she had long, flaxen hair. Ah, this is foolish. How do I stop this thing? *grumble*

items.name: Captain's Log #2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Captain Raymond Clark
transcript.text: It's been a few weeks, or months, since I recorded one of these. Whole seasons seem to go by without my noticing.

transcript.speaker: Captain Raymond Clark
transcript.text: My head's been so clouded, I can barely keep track of what state we're in. Come on Raymond, hold it together.

transcript.speaker: Captain Raymond Clark
transcript.text: My name is Captain Raymond Clark. My father was a bosun. My mother's name was... was... Ah confound it!

items.name: Captain's Log #3
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Captain Raymond Clark
transcript.text: My name is Captain... Captain... I'm a Captain. It's my job to, to fish? To catch as many fish as we can. My father was a fish, and my mother...

items.name: Dear Riley
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Becca
transcript.text: Hey Riley, it's mom! Just wanted to send you this holotape you can play in case you miss us.

transcript.speaker: Becca
transcript.text: We're so proud of you going on your first big adventure! You're going to have so much fun with all your friends!

transcript.speaker: Becca
transcript.text: I want you to be sure to listen to everything the scout masters and rangers tell you.

transcript.speaker: Becca
transcript.text: Remember, most of them are real people, so you can't throw things at them them like your Ms. Nanny.

transcript.speaker: Becca
transcript.text: So I don't want to hear any bad reports or get any phone calls in the middle of the night.

transcript.speaker: Becca
transcript.text: Mommy and daddy are on vacation, too, okay?

transcript.speaker: Becca
transcript.text: We love you very much, and miss you every day! And remember... Best behavior!

items.name: Discarded Introduction Recording
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Howdy stranger! Er... oh god, I can't believe I said that. This is stupid.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: You're all alone. No one to hear, no one judging... and you can't say a simple line. Great.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Hey there...! Survivor? Bleh, equally terrible.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Welcome to my humble bunker where we're all dead! By the way, how about you do a crap ton of super dangerous work that I promise you is worth it?

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: You're on board, right? Of course you are, because the fate of humanity depends on it!

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: And my work here is done!

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Ok, I can do this. I can do this. It's for them, not for you. I can do it for them. I can do this.

items.name: Discarded Scenario Recording
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Scenario 5. A worst case. This recording means my bunker is running on auxiliary power.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: You have... ideally four hours, potentially less, to somehow restore power and save this system!

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Let's see. Generator manual is here. Spare parts at Thunder Mountain, that would be fun. Tools...

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Forget it. There's about a million reasons here, and I seriously can't cover them all.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Maybe the bunker is sinking. Maybe one of those beavers on buffout chewed through the power lines. Maybe the generator just gave up on life.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Can't win 'em all, Abbie! Moving on... Another holotape for the trash.

items.name: Ella's Log: Harpers Ferry
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: May 2, 2080. Jesus I'm tired. Ever since we agreed to help rebuild Harpers, it's just been non-stop work.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: These people are in some bad shape. Some are improving, but it pains me to see our supplies dwindle.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: It's just that logical knowledge of knowing you packed for four and then suddenly you need to provide for eight.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: On the bright side, we met a guy named Derek the other day who said he's with a group of people called the Responders.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: They seem to have realized what we knew all along... that the government wasn't going to lift a finger to help clean up this mess.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: The Responders have been at it from the start with no sign of order, so they took it upon themselves to organize and help those in need.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: It's also a relief to no longer be the only one with a real medical background and training.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: Derek said he can bring back some supplies and help out a bit. At least until we're more settled.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: Lucy's been a great help, but her training as an aesthetician can only go so far.

items.name: Ella's Log: The Mire
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: July 15, 2079. Wow. Who would've thought a little radiation would turn this world upside down?

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: We were down in those bunkers for what, a couple years? There's no way radiation did all this all by itself in that amount of time.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: I mean, first off, this place is crawling with these orange-red vines, the likes of which there is no precedent for.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: I saw a toad that wouldn't fit in a bathtub, a 12 point with two heads, be still my heart, and insects you don't even want to know about.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: I've started taking samples for analysis. Hopefully, the plants can still be used for some good old holistic treatments.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: Raleigh's getting to work on a series of tests for the water and soil. I guess we can count ourselves lucky the air's breathable.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: But this place... I grew up here and I barely recognize it. There's no way we were prepared for this.
