transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text: Toxicity levels, slight mutations, yes. But I'm telling you, Darwin would lose his mind out here.

items.name: Everyone Is Gone
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Dear holotape. I'm pretty sure... that everyone I know is dead.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: If we hadn't bothered with this stupid, stupid system... they'd all still be here.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Well, guess what? If you all die, that kinda defeats the purpose!

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: Why couldn't we just... stay in our bunkers? Why'd we even have to go out there?

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: I'd rather eat Cram every day and never see the sun again then be stuck here... alone.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: I miss my mom... and my dad. You guys are supposed to be here.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: You took me away from my friends and my life all on your stupid promise that things were going to be fine! That this was best!

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: And is it? I can't do this on my own. I don't want to do this on my own.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: I just want things back the way they were.

items.name: Family and So-Called Friends
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: It's been... two weeks since I lost Trish and Marty.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Two weeks since we lost Harpers to those... things... those Scorched and that... nightmare.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Two weeks of keeping it together for Mike and Megan... and all the others.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Sam, where the hell are you? I could really use my best friend right now.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: This was our thing, you know. We were in this together.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Then you started in with the secrets, the no shows... You practically shoved Emily out the door, and now you're doing it to me?

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: I was your best friend for over forty years. I trusted you to help me see this through...

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: If you acted like you gave a half a damn about anything besides yourself you could've helped me.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Maybe I never would've made the decision rebuild Harpers Ferry. Maybe half my family would still be alive...

items.name: For Maude
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Hello, 'Maudy'. Hopefully you're still alive to hear this after my... modifications to the bot targeting parameters.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: If you are, you have probably noticed that all the exits topside are sealed shut and you are... *laughs*... so screwed!

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: I get it, Maude. You thought you were safe. You thought you built a home for all those helpless saps down here and refused to give way to how the world really works now.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Yeah... That's how I knew you'd pull some dumb shit like this.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Before you and your crew ran off into the tunnels like a bunch of rats, you asked me why I was doing all of this.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Now, the reasoning is... it's pretty simple: the mean guys always win, Maude.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Things are no different now than before the bombs. Hell, it's the reason most of us landed down here in the first place!

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: I just figured I may as well be the one to mean up before somebody else beat me to it.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: *Laughs* Sorry, I was just thinking how my daddy would be so proud of me. You know, that his boy followed in his footsteps in 'waste management'. I will see you in hell, Maude.

items.name: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Hailey Takano
transcript.text: Appalachia online, Captain.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: I know most of you love America.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: The good old red, white, and blue.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But those of us that served at Mariposa know something.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: America failed.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Not because its citizens, who lived clean lives filled with hardship in a never ending war.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: And certainly not because of its fighting men and women. God bless them.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: No, its leaders failed us. Senators, Generals, Presidents, all those bastards.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Their failure almost destroyed all mankind.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But I look around here and I see survivors.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: People too stubborn, too damned ornery to die.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: We've fought and we've endured and finally we have a small patch of safety.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But having a home isn't enough. We need something more.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: What we need is... purpose.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: But we cannot look to the America of old for that purpose.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: We have to build our own.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: So tonight, as we break bread together, let us forge together something new. Something strong.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Something we can be proud of. Something we can build upon.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: We'll preserve what's best of what's come before and use it. And one day, we will reclaim what was lost.

transcript.speaker: Roger Maxson
transcript.text: Let us forge a Brotherhood of Steel.

items.name: Harpers Ferry Proposal
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: I was approached today by Miranda Vox.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Yep, the same woman who told me to shove my "movement" where the sun don't shine and get the hell out of "her" town.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: She may be mayor of Harpers Ferry, or what's left of it, but I'm the one who's lived there all my life.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Grudges aside, she came asking for help.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Long story short, the town is a mess. People are dying. They need our "expertise," which I just took to mean help, supplies, you name it.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: So I grabbed Marty and went out there to have a look, and yeah. It's bad.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Maybe... Had I only gone alone, maybe I could keep this hidden from everyone... But Marty couldn't hold back her tears for those folks.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Having said all this out loud, I think I've finally come to a decision.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Now it's just going to be a matter of persuading the others that it's a good idea.

items.name: Jacob's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: God dammit, Ella... What the hell... What the shit HELL am I doing here?

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: Breathe dammit. You can do this.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: This is Jacob Lerner. Probably soon to be deceased on account of some crazy, whack-job scientist, chasing after some goddamned plants.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: If anyone finds this, this here's my last will and testament. I want my baseball and mitt to go to Scott.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: All my smokes and liquor are for you, Karly. Let's see here...

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: My snack cakes, those are for Charlie... no strike that, and screw you, Charlie! You're half the reason I'm in this mess to begin with!

items.name: Jacob's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: This is Jacob again. That's right. Still alive. Still stuck in the fucking Valley Galleria!

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: There's ghouls all over this place, and I. Am. Screwed.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: I ain't got a bullet to my name, and I lost my machete in the last ghoul that wanted to tussle.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: You know, the more I think about it, this is all Charlie's fault. I never should have listened to that bastard.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: He's got a thing for Ella, and I'm pretty sure he just wanted me out of the way.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: He's the one that sent me here after those damn flowers.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: He planned this... I swear, if I get out of here, he's a dead man.

items.name: Jacob's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: Somehow, I survived the night. Not sure how those things haven't' found me yet, but I won't complain.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: Lucky me, I found some old candy bars and a Nu'Cola. I can't tell if Life's toying with me or not.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: 'Cause if it's going to keep me fed just to throw me to the wolves, me and God are gonna have words when I get to them pearly gates.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: I did some reflecting last night. Thought about how stupid it is I'm in this situation on account of some girl. Just stupid.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: But Ella... She's smart. Smarter than I'll ever be. And nice. I never did meet a girl that'd give me the time of day. Karly don't count, she's kin.

transcript.speaker: Jacob
transcript.text: But to think all I wanted was to get Ella those flowers she wanted for experiments... not worth dying over, no siree.

items.name: Jesus Sunday's Holotape - Part 1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: When my brother JD & I answered the call to head into Harpers Ferry, we expected to find an organized Free States stronghold.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Now that we're here, it's obvious that no one knows what the hell they're doing.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: The other Free States families are wasting precious resources trying to restore Harpers Ferry and create a safe haven for survivors.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Instead, they should be turning the town into a fort and stockpiling supplies to prep for the long haul.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: We'll still pitch in, but we don't plan on sticking around long to see what happens.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: We don't think that Harpers Ferry will ever be safe, so we're going to use our share of the supplies to reinforce the bunker at our cabin.

items.name: Jesus Sunday's Holotape - Part 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: For the past few years, my brother's been bummed out - like really sad, you know?

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Personally, I don't think he's ever recovered from watching the world end. Hell, I don't think any of us have.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: I tried to talk to him about it, but he kept pushing me away and changing the subject.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: But after JD met Brianna Hawke in Harpers Ferry, things turned around. I guess she helped him out by giving him a different shoulder to cry on.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Why JD's more comfortable with her than his own brother, I'll never know.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Yeah, I'm kind of angry, maybe even a little jealous, but I'm going to let it go for his sake.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Still, there's something about Brianna that bugs me, so I'm going to keep an eye on her.

items.name: Jesus Sunday's Holotape - Part 3
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: We were at our bunker when the Scorchbeasts attacked Harpers Ferry. It took them less than an hour to burn the place down.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: When the attack was over, I thought Brianna was dead and that JD would return to his old self. When he didn't, I became suspicious.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Then Brianna shows up at our cabin with a small group of survivors and everything became clear.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: She had conned JD, played him this entire time, pretending to love him to give herself and her friends an invite to our bunker.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Well, there was no way I was going to let that happen. I told her she could march right back to her cave and find her own place to survive.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: When JD tried to stop me, I had to knock him out. That's when Brianna's people pushed back, and I fired some shots into the air to scare them away.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Now I have to deal with JD, and damn is he going to be pissed.

items.name: Jesus Sunday's Holotape - Part 4
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: It's been weeks since I chased off Brianna Hawke, and I feel like I've wasted all of it trying to convince JD that he was better off without her.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: I finally thought I was getting through, until I was cleaning up our cabin and found the goddamn notes they'd been passing to each other.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: Instead of heading out to hunt, that hijo de perra's been stabbing me in the back by giving Brianna some of our supplies!

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: After everything I've sacrificed for our family, how could he do this to me?!

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: When he gets back from today's "hunt" we're going to have a little chat about Brianna Hawke. And this time, I'm not going to just look the other way.

items.name: Madigan Encounter
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Is it recording? Make sure it's recording.

transcript.speaker: Abbie
transcript.text: I got it, Eddie, it's recording... Jesus.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: All right, Madigan, you want to explain why we found you out there tampering with our stuff?

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Hey, you guys are always holed up in your bunkers, how else can I get your attention?

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Besides, a crazy contraption like that? Of course I'm gonna try to figure it out.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: And by the way you guys came out fully armed and ready to fight, I'm guessing it's pretty big.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: What you nearly broke was a Scorchbeast lure. It's the best defense we have against them.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Whoa, you're telling me you're luring those things down? You've got some balls, Free States.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Even with your numbers, taking on a beast is no easy task.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: It doesn't just lure them down. We found some research and tech at one of the Brotherhood's old outposts.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Ella realized if we can blast a Scorchbeast with a certain frequency, it disorients it long enough for us to go in and take it out.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Niraj and Abbie started work on the tech. We tested it. And it works.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: This is a real game changer, Raleigh... if what you say is true.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: It's true, Hank. And this system would be done if it weren't for those damn Raiders.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Look, if this is as big as you think it is, the Fire Breathers can handle any Raiders.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: But I need to know how this system works and see it in action first.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: If you think we're just going to reveal our work to an ex-Brotherhood member, think again.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: You want to see how this system works, then you've got some serious trust to earn.

items.name: Marcus' Speech
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Alright people, settle in, settle in. Alright. Now, I asked that all the Burrows folk gather here today because I'm making a little announcement.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: As of right now, the Burrows Boys are withdrawing from our little alliance and claiming ownership over these tunnels.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Now... for some of you that is probably confusing. Maybe you're asking yourself "Marcus, what's that mean for the Burrows? What's it mean for me?"

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Well friends, it's really pretty damn simple. It means that as of now, I own everything in these tunnels!

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: The rats you eat, the mold growing on your mattress, the bricks you are standing on. They're all mine.
*Crowd Murmuring*

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: But, not to worry. I will be a kind and fair ruler. I will let you continue using my facilities if you obey one very simple rule.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: And that is to follow my every order to a T! I tell you to do something, you do it. I need something, you get it.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: I ask you for the moon? You figure out how to pull that SOB out of the sky and bring it right down here to me.

transcript.speaker: Trish
transcript.text: And if we refuse?

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Well you could do that... you could. But you'd be more screwed than you already are. Look around, Trish.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: My boys are the only ones here with guns, and the only ones that know anything about fighting! None of you can touch us. You wouldn't stand a chance.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: I understand you folks have gotten used to the chummy, love-your-neighbor bullshit, but the new world order is here.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Now, I get it. That is some bitter medicine to swallow. But if I need to help you force it down, just know that I am more than happy to oblige.

items.name: Message to Marge 1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Marge. I keep recording these. Hoping one day I can make it home.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: I found these Brotherhood of Steel guys outside of Grafton.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Heard about them. Some weird military cult.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Seeing them in action... made me... I remember when my unit would roll in like that. All shock and awe.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: I'll tell you what, these Grafton raiders didn't stand a chance.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: One of them, Knight Moreno, noticed me. Came over and chatted.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Nice guy. Really made me rethink the stuff I've been told.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: It came out I was in the cavalry at Anchorage, he said they had a place for me.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Marge, I'm sorry. I've made it maybe 400 miles since the bombs.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: At this rate Texas might as well be a million miles further.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: I need... a unit. A place to belong. I feel like the Brotherhood may be it.

items.name: Message to Marge 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Marge. It's been a couple weeks.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: I've had three squares, showers, working lights... Camp Venture's got power, proper power, Marge.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: I'd feel almost human if it weren't for the Senior Knight and the training.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: I graduated basic easy back in the day, and I know I may be a bit softer... but...

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Wilson's an Army Ranger, or well, was one. And the drills they're making us do.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: But as beat up and worn out as I feel, that first time getting back into the 51b.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: You can call yourself Knight, Paladin, Grand Poobah of the Roman Empire, I don't care.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Just don't take my power armor away.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: They're rushing training. A big battle with Super Mutants happening.

transcript.speaker: "Tex" Rogers
transcript.text: Good. I got some aggression I need to unleash.

items.name: Neverending Missions
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: I feel like it's been non-stop missions for a while now.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Gather supplies, head out, take a beating, set up a thing, take a few more beatings, come home, heal up... rinse and repeat.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Most days, I'm not even sure how we're still alive.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: We've been working on this detection system for so long now, I feel like we'll never see the end of it.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Detectors, lures, uplinks. I think I'd rather die then head back to another relay tower at this rate.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: But Raleigh and Niraj say it's worth it, and I believe them.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Those Scorched are nasty business...

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: And if I had the means to let people know they're coming, and better yet, maybe take a Scorchbeast out along the way?

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Hell yeah, I'd say that's worth it.

items.name: Niraj's Confession
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: To my dearest Abigayle and Calvin.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: I've instructed Ella to give you this holotape on the event of my death. Please don't blame anything you're about to hear on her.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: These are my wishes. Ella has respected them, and I expect you to as well.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: I've been diagnosed with Parkinson's. I've still got plenty of time to live a normal life... well as normal as can be expected...

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: But the time will come where my health will deteriorate and I can no longer care for myself.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: I love you both tremendously, and you know that... but I will not be a burden to you, my children. Especially in these dark times.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: If everything has gone according to plan, hopefully my death has meant something.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: Please understand why I chose not to tell you. Abbie, you are smart enough to see our work through till the end.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: Calvin, you're turning into such a fine young man. Your mother would've been proud, but not as proud as me.

transcript.speaker: Niraj
transcript.text: You two take care of each other. You're going to make it through this. I know it.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Camp Venture
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Camp Venture.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Just who was this Brotherhood of Steel? Survivalists? Former Army personnel? They took their training and their call signs seriously, that's for certain.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Organized, efficient, access to hardware. You'd think they'd be ruling West Virginia by now, but they're gone.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: If they're following military logic, then they'll have a fortified headquarters somewhere. And a leader. Someone who knew what they were planning.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Free States
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Free States Bunker.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Sam Blackwell and Raleigh Clay. Those damn traitors and their secessionists turned their backs on America to form their "Free States."

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Concrete bunkers. You'd never get that past a Vault-Tec Radiation Proofing inspection, that's for sure.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Sounds like they let go of their paranoia long enough to seek out help from the other survivors.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Just have to hack this terminal. See what they left behind in there, and what they wanted to do.

items.name: Protecting Our Own
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: I think it's time we claimed the Armory as our own territory.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: I'll need to get Eddie and Niraj to help out with some security measures.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Survivors are gonna hate it, but we gotta protect our own, especially against the damn Brotherhood.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Derek told us they've been hitting up the Responders for manpower and supplies and not taking no for an answer.

transcript.speaker: Raleigh
transcript.text: Well, they've got another thing coming if they try that over here, and we need to be ready.

items.name: Restoring Order
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Things are finally starting to shape up around here at Harpers Ferry.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: We got a lot of defenses up and running, a real perimeter, and people taking lookout shifts.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Niraj is working on some new contraption to help with these brutal storms that sweep through. He said they could filter the air or something.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: And Ella's got a decent clinic set up with the help of the Responders.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: It makes me feel like maybe Raleigh was right, and we can have a real go at this.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Some of these survivors proved they aren't completely worthless, too.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: One guy, Duncan, turned out to be a decent hunter, and another gal, Kendyll, she's a better shot than me.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Still, you look at these people struggling here and just think... You bastards had your chance.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: We practically spelled it out for you and you just turned up your noses and called us crazy.

transcript.speaker: Eddie Hayes
transcript.text: Bunch of idiots...

items.name: Scope Out The Crash
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Larry Richardson
transcript.text: Hey, Seth and I took off to find some dinner. Why don't you clean up around camp and then go check out that plane crash we saw a while back.

transcript.speaker: Larry Richardson
transcript.text: We should be here when you get back and you can tell us what you found.

transcript.speaker: Larry Richardson
transcript.text: By the way, learn how to read so I don't have to record one of these stupid things every time I want to leave you a message. Don't die out there.

items.name: Thanks Lenny
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.
items.contents: Transcript not found in the game files.

items.name: Tossed the Stash
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Chris Fatur
transcript.text: Hey Matt, I made it back to the safe house... but you probably guessed that.

transcript.speaker: Chris Fatur
transcript.text: Stupid, you're so stupid! He knows you made it to the safe house, you idiot! YOU IDIOT!

transcript.speaker: Chris Fatur
transcript.text: Umm... unfortunately, I had to stash the duffle on the way because I was being chased. I'm sorry, I'm really sorry, Matt.

transcript.speaker: Chris Fatur
transcript.text: Idiot! You stupid IDIOT!

transcript.speaker: Chris Fatur
transcript.text: So, yeah... I tossed it under the porch in the Southwest corner of the white hotel, the one up on the cliff.

transcript.speaker: Chris Fatur
transcript.text: Anyway... I'm gonna take off, Matt. It's too dangerous around here. I'm gonna head back into the mountains, I think. Farewell.

transcript.speaker: Chris Fatur
transcript.text: What the fu... farewell? Nobody says that. You're so stupid, you idiot. Stupid IDIOT!

items.name: Warning For Dylan
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Trish
transcript.text: Dylan, I hope you find this when you get back. I need you to listen to me. We can't stay here anymore.

transcript.speaker: Trish
transcript.text: Marcus, that son of a bitch. I should've known he'd... *sigh*. The point is, you need to grab your things and leave as soon as possible.

transcript.speaker: Trish
transcript.text: Just don't try to leave through the central chamber. One of his goons will just hold you up and give you shit. I'm heading to Mosstown now. I love you and... I hope I see you soon.

items.name: We're Coming For You
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Harper Rosiak
transcript.text: 9 AM - Degenerative Neurological Conditions, Room 121.

transcript.speaker: Harper Rosiak
transcript.text: 10:30 Radiation Therapy Training, Lab 206.

transcript.speaker: Harper Rosiak
transcript.text: Noon. Family Medicine rotation, Vault-Tec U Free Clinic.

transcript.speaker: Harper Rosiak
transcript.text: Keeps going like that. Your daughter Judy's a busy woman, Senator. But not hard to find.

transcript.speaker: Harper Rosiak
transcript.text: You've been sticking your nose where it doesn't belong, Samuel. And now you've gone too far.

transcript.speaker: Harper Rosiak
transcript.text: We're coming for you. And your family. This was your warning.

items.name: Runner's Log 03: Too Much
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I'm Bella Gerber, a Runner for the Union. Or at least I used to be. To tell you the truth, I think we're alone out here.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Haven't heard from headquarters in months, and they haven't heard from us.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: The Union... we're all trying our best to help everyone, but there's just too many people to help, too much to do, too many hazards in the way.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: We're running low on supplies. I spend every daylight hour scavenging, but it's not enough. I need help. And we're not getting any.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Some of the survivors volunteered to go out scavenging with me. Young ones. The last partner I had out here was boiled alive in a radpit.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: If even he couldn't... (deep breath) I can't let them risk their lives, not after I promised them safety.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I'm gonna start going out at night too. Maybe then I can gather enough.

items.name: Runner's Log 04: Lambs to the Slaughter
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: This is Bella Gerber. Used to be a Union Runner. Now I'm a prisoner.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: The Fanatics found us. They took over the Sanctum. Everyone I promised safety... I delivered them straight into the hands of the Fanatics.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I was so arrogant. So stupid. Forgot that I wasn't the only person capable of navigating the Trench, of learning how to navigate it.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Pat always told me I needed to learn to trust others, to stop taking the weight of the world upon myself. (sad laugh) But he's the same way.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I hadn't mentioned it before, but I... I have a husband. Pat Gerber. We promised to meet up after our work for the Union was done.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: But it will never be done, will it, Pat? Things will only get worse and worse.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I don't think I'll make it out of here. But I could at least give the others a chance.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: The others I condemned, bringing them here with the promise of safety. I have to give them a chance, Pat.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: This will be my final log. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: And Pat, if you ever find that monster you were looking for... Don't go alone.

items.name: Striker's Log 01: Mission Brief
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: This is Pat Gerber, Striker for the Union. Formerly the 42, now with our command up in the 29. Mission log: taking care of unfinished business.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Used to get reports back in the day of something -- some kind of mutant or monster -- lurking beneath the Foundry.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Disappearances, attacks, one or two mangled corpses... nasty stuff. Thought it was Fanatic raids myself, but panic ensued, so I got put on the case.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Of course, losing the Foundry changed our priorities a bit, but now that we're re-settled, I've come home to take a look.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Can't say I'm not a bit curious... Don't get to monster hunting very often.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Will be a change of pace from rooting out spies and Fanatic guerillas, if indeed it is something new on our plates.

items.name: Striker's Log 02: Pursuit
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Pat Gerber, Union Striker, Local 29. Mission log: in pursuit of a beast. Strange to be back in my old stomping grounds after so long away.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: So much has changed. The streets... well, they've been filthy since the War, of course, but we always used to keep them up as best we could.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Now you can barely move without tripping over old rebar or slipping in a pool of spilled waste... The Fanatics did a number on this place.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Met up with the new Local leader, a woman who goes by Hex.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Guess they've had run-ins with the creatures I'm looking for, so there goes my "Fanatic raider" theory.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: She showed me the body of one of these things... No wonder they had folks running scared.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Going toe-to-toe with these troglodytes would put the fear into anybody. It's a wonder the 42 is still standing.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Best info we have on where they're coming from hasn't changed, though.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Seems disturbances in the Foundry -- raids against the Fanatics -- always stir them up and bring them out of hiding.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Will be quite the task to get in there unnoticed by the enemy, but that's what Strikers are for.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: I know an old route, back door type situation. Should work... If it doesn't, you know where to find my body.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: And send my regards to the rest of the 29. If nothing else, you know I'll take some Fanatics down with me on the way.

items.name: Striker's Log 03: Lion's Den
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Pat Gerber, Union Striker with the Local 29. Mission log: things are getting uncomfortable.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Found a way past the patrols and made it to the tunnels beneath the Foundry.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Place is like a maze, it's no wonder we never scouted the whole thing when we owned this place. And there's evidence of our mutant friends everywhere.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Human bones littered here and there, stripped of all the flesh and muscle... I've got a strong stomach, but it's hard to take.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Must've been dragging folks down here for as long as we suspected. Can't help but think of the friends I've lost...

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: I want to exterminate the whole lot of these creatures.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: The going is getting tougher. No natural light, of course, or artificial for that matter. But more than that, the rads get worse the deeper I go.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: I can feel my body heating up; feel my skin crawling. Stomach is starting to churn, I still haven't found the bastards...

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Pounded some Rad-X, but it's hardly helping. I should know better, but I want to press on.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Maybe a few levels deeper before I turn back and rethink my strategy. Maybe steal a hazmat suit from somewhere, if I'm lucky.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: My damn head's starting to swim... Hope the damage isn't done already.

items.name: Striker's Log 04: Failure
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Pat-- Pat Gerber, uh, Striker with the Union Local... 29. Mission log: pretty sure I fucked up good.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Got a little farther down and came face-to-face with my "prey." Damn thing was hideous... Was limping along, really feeling the rads at this point.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Didn't feel up to a fight, was pretty sure I was a goner. But it didn't pounce, didn't strike. The thing just... stared. It stared at me.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: It... It knew me, I-I could feel it. How that's possible, I-I don't know, but... sent a chill down my spine.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Its eyes... called to me. Felt like an eternity, but after a minute or two it just, just turned around and left. And so did I.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: I made it back topside. Lucky to be alive, honestly, but all I feel is... is an anger.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: It's swelling up inside me, I'm just, so mad. Mad I didn't kill the thing, mad it didn't kill me. It doesn't make any sense.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Don't-- don't think I'm going back to the 29 any time soon. Need-- need to wait for these urges to subside.

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Don't want to hurt anyone. Shouldn't be near other people right now...

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: God, it's so damn bright up here. Was it always so blinding?

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Need to find a little corner, out of the light. Someplace warm. I don't know why it's gotten so cold, either. Too used to the rads, maybe...

transcript.speaker: Pat Gerber
transcript.text: Gerber out.

items.name: Battle of Huntersville Speech
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Civilization.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: The Brotherhood and Responders together have paid a high price to make that word mean something in Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Despite all the changes, farmers have worked the land, people have learned new skills, and we've built a new world.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: And the Super Mutants threaten all of that.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: I'm a soldier, a Paladin, and I tell you that this is our moment.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: We will never be stronger, and the Super Mutant's never weaker.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: If you are thinking in the heat of battle to run, live to fight another day, know this.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: There is no other day. We win here, now, Responders and Brotherhood together... or we will die.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: So look to your left, look to your right. Promise to give your all to protect them, and they will protect you.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Make no mistake, this will be the toughest fight of our lives.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: But we will win, because we're fighting for something. For each other, for our children, for civilization.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth Taggerdy
transcript.text: Now let's show these Muties what we're made of.

items.name: Cooper Lu's journal
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Cooper Lu
transcript.text: The holotape machine is on it's last legs, so I'm recording this for whoever comes along that might find a working one.

transcript.speaker: Cooper Lu
transcript.text: My name is Cooper Lu. I'm the last survivor of Clarksburg. After everything fell apart, a lot of them left for Morgantown.

transcript.speaker: Cooper Lu
transcript.text: There was some arguing over who got the guns from the shooting range, but a few warning shots settled that.

transcript.speaker: Cooper Lu
transcript.text: A while later a bunch of us got sick when the water turned funny colors. It took them a long time to die.

transcript.speaker: Cooper Lu
transcript.text: That just left me, Jill and Ande. Some god damn mutated bear thing got them. Now it's just me.

transcript.speaker: Cooper Lu
transcript.text: I'm going to head out east and see if I can find people. Anyone listening to this should do the same. Goodbye, probably forever.

items.name: Darius Angler's Manifesto, part 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: They killed my brother! Those bastards at the Grafton Steel Mill killed Billy.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: Mandatory overtime they called it. He should never have been on those catwalks.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: I can't even bury him. When you fall into a vat of molten steel there's nothing left of you.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: I'll get them for this. I'll show those bastards.

items.name: Darius Angler's Manifesto, part 3
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: I've uncovered a conspiracy between the government and Grafton Steel. Kickbacks, wink and nod inspections, bribes, you name it.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: There's no telling how big this is. I think they bugged my house, so I've moved to a cabin in the woods where nobody can find me.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: Yesterday I had to shoot a woman. She claimed she was just hiking, but I know she was an agent sent to spy on me.

items.name: Darius Angler's Manifesto, part 4
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: I've booby trapped my cabin. They're attaching listening devices to the raccoons to spy on me.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: But I'm too smart for them. They can't get past my traps.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: I saw a fox look funny at me today. They might be using them too. If I see another one come around, that will prove it.

items.name: Darius Angler's Manifesto, part 6
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: The air raid sirens. The ground shaking. It's Billy. He's telling me it's time. Everyone is thinking about the bombs. They won't notice me.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: All I have to do is sneak in to Grafton Steel and use my secret formula. Then their smoke stacks will begin spewing toxic dust all over the valley.

transcript.speaker: Darius Angler
transcript.text: Then they'll be sorry they hurt Billy. They'll be sorry and dead.

items.name: First Day of Command
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: So I got my own command now. Bet you never thought that would happen, right?

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: But with all the new blood Sarge is training... I mean Knight. Senior Knight.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Met up with a representative of the Responders.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: I told him our mission: to escort trade caravans, keep the freaks from the Savage Divide away from civilization, and maybe get the Dam operational again.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: She was so grateful, it was almost embarrassing.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Day one complete and so far so good.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: But I miss you. And the hot shower! But mostly you.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: The old rules about fraternization... I don't know if they apply in the Brotherhood.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Maybe we can just come clean and tell Paladin Taggerdy about us?

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: I know you'd like kids one day, too, and we're not getting any younger.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Promise you'll think about it.

transcript.speaker: Johnny Moreno
transcript.text: Love you!

items.name: George Smith's memo
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: George N. Smith
transcript.text: This is Director George N. Smith recording what may be my final memo.

transcript.speaker: George N. Smith
transcript.text: The earthquakes that followed the nukes cracked the dam somewhere.

transcript.speaker: George N. Smith
transcript.text: I can't see the rupture, but the lake level has dropped dramatically.

transcript.speaker: George N. Smith
transcript.text: The Pioneer Scout Camp got it worse though. Some sort of underground sink hole dropped most of it to below the normal lake water level.

transcript.speaker: George N. Smith
transcript.text: Ironically it's now at the new beach front level. If the reservoir were full, it would be totally submerged.

transcript.speaker: George N. Smith
transcript.text: I'm heading out now to see if anyone out there needs help. I don't know what I'll find. This is George N. Smith signing off.

items.name: Homecoming
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.text: Appalachia. I thought it was going to be in the rear view forever. Coming back... is weird.
The Gourmands freaks are all gone. Even those gun-toting maniac Cutthroats.
Leaving was humiliating, but Meg called it. And now she'll neeeever let us forget it.

items.name: Isabel Smith-Waltz's journal
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Isabel Smith-Waltz
transcript.text: It's my first day here. Oh, this is Isabel Smith-Waltz. Can't forget introductions.

transcript.speaker: Isabel Smith-Waltz
transcript.text: The rangers are all so friendly, but this place is kind of weird.

transcript.speaker: Isabel Smith-Waltz
transcript.text: So this fort was supposed to be a rebuilt frontier fort, but the railroad went through the place where it really used to be, so they had to put it here.

transcript.speaker: Isabel Smith-Waltz
transcript.text: Then they found out the guy who wrote the book that described the fort made most of it up. Crazy, right?

transcript.speaker: Isabel Smith-Waltz
transcript.text: So it doesn't even look like the real one. We call it a 'representational frontier fort.'

transcript.speaker: Isabel Smith-Waltz
transcript.text: Now they want to start running civil war battle recreations here. But that never happened either. But they say it will bring in lots of money.

transcript.speaker: Isabel Smith-Waltz
transcript.text: Some people just to appreciate real history.

items.name: James Waltz's notes
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: James Waltz
transcript.text: Some days I wish I had never inherited Hemlock Holes.

transcript.speaker: James Waltz
transcript.text: Who names a golf course after a poison? My father, that's who.

transcript.speaker: James Waltz
transcript.text: And, to top it all off, we're stuck out here in the ass-end of the country.

transcript.speaker: James Waltz
transcript.text: I've bought one of those fancy Mr. Handy chefs. Maybe some community cookouts will drum up more business.

items.name: John Bunton's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: Damn it, is this thing... Okay. Okay, it's recording. Ol' JB here. And you would not believe what I'm seein' right now!

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: I'm sittin' here drivin' this truck, and what do I see ahead, but a sky full of... well there's these streaks of light like nothin' I ever seen.

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: Boy howdy, it's majestic. Like shootin' stars in the early mornin' light, only I ain't never seen 'em in the mornin' like this.

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: It's like a rocket streakin' through the blue sky, or like a... oh... oh shit. It's a nuclear...

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: <Faint nuclear explosion in the distance>

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: Aw shit, it exploded. I was starin' right at it, and I... I can't see! I... I'm going to...

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: <Sound of a truck running off the road, metal screeching, and glass breaking>

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: <Nuclear blast shockwave hitting>

transcript.speaker: John Bunton
transcript.text: <Sound of something large pounding on the metal walls of the truck's trailer and ripping the door off the back>

items.name: Mary Tinley's Recording

location.text: Found near Wavy Willard's Water Park.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Mary Tinley
transcript.text: I win!

transcript.speaker: Chelsea Wesley
transcript.text: Again? Ugh. You always beat me.

transcript.speaker: Mary Tinley
transcript.text: Aha, that's right. Come on, let's go wading! It doesn't look deep.

transcript.speaker: Chelsea Wesley
transcript.text: Fine. I'm tired of board games anyway.

transcript.speaker: Mary Tinley
transcript.text: Be careful. The rocks are slippery.

transcript.speaker: Chelsea Wesley
transcript.text: Ahh! Please stop!

transcript.speaker: Mary Tinley
transcript.text: Stop struggling!

transcript.speaker: Chelsea Wesley
transcript.text: Help!

transcript.speaker: Mary Tinley
transcript.text: You're just making this harder. I've almost got you.

transcript.speaker: Mary Tinley
transcript.text: Chelsea? Chelsea?

items.name: Mayor Mudge's private memo
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Richard Mudge
transcript.text: Just got back from a town council meeting. Bunch of pansies. No vision. No brains. No balls.

transcript.speaker: Richard Mudge
transcript.text: I'm going to drag the lot of them into the 22nd century if it's the last thing I do.

transcript.speaker: Richard Mudge
transcript.text: Since I have dirt on most of those yellow belly piss ants, they won't have much of a choice.

transcript.speaker: Richard Mudge
transcript.text: Tourism! That's what this place needs. Bunch of wide-eyed marks wandering around spending their cash on shit they don't need.

transcript.speaker: Richard Mudge
transcript.text: Grafton steel is the past. Water parks and shooting ranges are the future.

transcript.speaker: Richard Mudge
transcript.text: But I have to be careful. Grafton Steel is a big campaign contributor. Can't let them think I don't have their backs.

transcript.speaker: Richard Mudge
transcript.text: At least not until I stab them there.

items.name: Meg Sucks
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.text: She talks such a big game, but what do we actually do?
We pick away at stragglers. We try not to rock the boat.
These settlers are on my land. Hell, there's a family living in my old house
Lev. Lev's the solution. Meg's gotta be retired. One way or the other.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Grafton
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Grafton.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The "mayor" of Grafton used to be the automated assistant, and it's gone completely mad. Still trying to run the town. Even holds elections for itself.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: We built these machines to do things without us... and they have. It might be useful if I played along.

items.name: Repair Plan
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: I dunno what all they put in the furnace, but it's gaumed it up but good.

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: Wouldn't have been so bad if ya'll had just shut damned thing down for a few weeks and cleaned out the blast.

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: But at this point? Whatever it is, at this point it's fused with every damned part from the Furnace to the Smelter and the Mills.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor Fortney
transcript.text: Look Mason, I don't need to hear it. Can you keep it running or not?

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: Ain't gonna be easy. Whatever's going on chemically, it's pretty toxic and corrosive at that.

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: You're gonna have to keep making near constant repairs. I can mark the areas, but that's not gonna stop the ash...

transcript.speaker: Supervisor Fortney
transcript.text: Foreman doesn't give a damn about the ash. The workers brought it on themselves, now they get to live with it.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor Fortney
transcript.text: Besides, the bots don't give a damn. All the more reason to continue the workforce change over.

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: So that's it then? Just... keep replacing bots and machinery. Let the plant destroy the valley and break up the strikers?

transcript.speaker: Supervisor Fortney
transcript.text: If you've got a problem with that, we can cancel payment.

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: It's just...

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: Aw, shit. Just get me in the van and get me out of here before anyone sees me.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor Fortney
transcript.text: Pleasure doing business with you. We'll recommend you to our friends.

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: Don't. Don't ever contact me again after this.

transcript.speaker: Donna Mason
transcript.text: And erase my name off that holotape. I went over the needed repairs, that's enough.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor Fortney
transcript.text: Fine.

items.name: The Addington's Dangerous Game
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Carl Addington
transcript.text: Well, another hunting season comes to a close. I guess we should start packing up the lodge.

transcript.speaker: Westley Addington
transcript.text: Yes, I suppose we should.

transcript.speaker: Carl Addington
transcript.text: What's the problem? This was a great season.

transcript.speaker: Westley Addington
transcript.text: I know. It's just, well, it's getting quite boring. We hunt the same thing, every year.

transcript.speaker: Carl Addington
transcript.text: Oh my god, then what do you want? If you have something to say, then spit it out already!

transcript.speaker: Westley Addington
transcript.text: All right. Before you judge, hear me out.

transcript.speaker: Westley Addington
transcript.text: What if we hunted something new? Something that was a real challenge for a change. Something that could fight back.

transcript.speaker: Westley Addington
transcript.text: We circulate an advertisement offering a free weekend at the lodge. People will have no idea what they're really getting into. It's perfect!

transcript.speaker: Carl Addington
transcript.text: Wait. Are you talking about hunting... humans?

transcript.speaker: Westley Addington
transcript.text: Oh, don't act so surprised. You know it makes sense. I can see it on your face.

transcript.speaker: Carl Addington
transcript.text: Do you really think we can get away with it?

transcript.speaker: Westley Addington
transcript.text: With our wealth, dear brother, we can get away with anything.

items.name: The Beast of Grafton - Part 1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Holotape
transcript.text: (Radio drama plays)

items.name: The Beast of Grafton - Part 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Holotape
transcript.text: (Radio drama plays)

items.name: The Foundation Plan
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Raider
transcript.text: So C backed out. I swear, I'm losing more people than recruiting.

transcript.speaker: Raider
transcript.text: If we could just crack Foundation, we'd be rich. And we'd own Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: Raider
transcript.text: But the damned walls, and they've got numbers, too.

transcript.speaker: Raider
transcript.text: I'd go with explosives but Lou won't have anything to do with my "cockamamey plan."

transcript.speaker: Raider
transcript.text: *sigh* I could try the Blood Eagles...? Who am I kidding, they'd just lynch me. Damned Foundation.

items.name: Thomas Brennan's Announcement
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: Attention, inmates. This is Warden Brennan speaking.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: This morning, you were fitted with what the guards told you was a "Prisoner Collar."

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: This collar is an explosive device that will detonate if you attempt to leave Eastern Regional.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: Now, before some of you panic and try to remove the collar, I feel it's important to advise you that doing so will also detonate the device.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: Please don't think of these collars as a punishment, think of them as a benefit.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: You will no longer be under scrutiny by guards, and you will no longer be forced to sit in your tiny cells as punishment for your crimes.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: If you stay within the confines of this facility, you're free to roam about and do what you please.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: However, if any of you choose to abuse this newly-found freedom, know that I will not hesitate to manually detonate your collar.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: Provided we understand each other, I am certain that the rest of your sentence at Eastern Regional will pass quietly and comfortably.

transcript.speaker: Warden Brennan
transcript.text: Your cell doors are now unlocked. Enjoy your new life without bars, inmates.

items.name: Algorithm Reset Test
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... begin algorithm configuration reset procedure ... ... filling primary soil containment chambers ...

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... request auxiliary soil containment chamber access ...... filling auxiliary soil containment chambers ...

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... begin automated barrier repositioning ... ... engaging barrier hydraulic systems ...

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... begin exhumation... error codes are filling the screen, hold on ...

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... something's jammed in the excavation pipes ... have the engineers check on it ...... looks like ventilation shaft F... R... 9... 2...

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... huh, didn't this happen a few months ago in the same area? ...... report: we got a code red ...

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... a body is being exhumed from ventilation shaft F-R-9-2 ...

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... looks like we finally found out what happened to the intern ...... ha ha ha ha ...

transcript.speaker: Engineer
transcript.text: ... disengage algorithm configuration reset procedure ...

items.name: Anne's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Anne Litzinger
transcript.text: It's funny how things work out. Sometimes it seems like life's got a cruel sense of humor.

transcript.speaker: Anne Litzinger
transcript.text: When I came out here from San Fran to go to school at VTU, I thought this place was antiquated, filled with ignorant hillbillies. I hated it.

transcript.speaker: Anne Litzinger
transcript.text: Eventually, I guess I got over myself. It turns out, people are people. Brains aren't regional and our birthplace doesn't define us.

transcript.speaker: Anne Litzinger
transcript.text: I decided that once I graduated, I'd really explore West Virginia. I'd go out there and be a photojournalist, just like I've always dreamed.

transcript.speaker: Anne Litzinger
transcript.text: I made a list of all the places I wanted to see, but then the bombs fell and I guess now it's a bucket list, because I don't think I've got much time left..

transcript.speaker: Anne Litzinger
transcript.text: Pretty sure the radiation will kill me before I get very far, but I'm going to try. And if I don't make it, well, maybe someone can finish the list for me.

items.name: Ansel's Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Ansel Abrahms
transcript.text: Well, here we are, Dorothea. West Virginia. Just like you always wanted. I wish more than anything you were here to see it.

transcript.speaker: Ansel Abrahms
transcript.text: Maybe it's better that the Leukemia took you when you were still so young. You were spared the horrors of this war. I take some comfort in that.

transcript.speaker: Ansel Abrahms
transcript.text: But I made you a promise, and a grandpa keeps his word. That list we made of all the places you wanted to see? Well, I'm going to visit them all!

transcript.speaker: Ansel Abrahms
transcript.text: It's all for you, Dorothea. I know you're up there with the angels, and before this world's completely ruined, I'm going to make you proud.

transcript.speaker: Ansel Abrahms
transcript.text: I've got that old camera you used to love and... damn, someone's coming. Hope it's not those looters again. We'll finish this later.

items.name: Apologies to Lou

location.text: Found at Poseidon Energy Plant Expansion.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Fisher
transcript.text: Hey Lou. Not sure you'll ever get this, but I needed to get something off my chest.

transcript.speaker: Fisher
transcript.text: I know I had once called you friend. It may not mean much, but I am genuinely sorry for what I had to do to you.

transcript.speaker: Fisher
transcript.text: But you have to understand, I had no other choice. Meg is a terrible leader. I questioned why Lev would ever join her.

transcript.speaker: Fisher
transcript.text: He always intended to take over one day, but she kept bringing on new people, building loyalty, making it more difficult for him to mutiny.

transcript.speaker: Fisher
transcript.text: When Meg decided to go on this foolish gold hunt with that vault dweller from seventy-six, it was time to act. She was going to lead us all to ruin.

transcript.speaker: Fisher
transcript.text: And it was too late for me to reach you, because you were already involved. I couldn't risk the operation if you said anything to Meg.

transcript.speaker: Fisher
transcript.text: Well I uh... hope your luck holds out and you survive long enough to hear that I'm sorry for all this.

items.name: Bless Y'all's Hearts

location.text: Found at Poseidon Energy Plant Expansion.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Surge
transcript.text: Hey y'all. Lev wanted us to leave behind some messages to all of you Crater folks who we're leavin' behind.

transcript.speaker: Surge
transcript.text: Guess it's like a final 'fuck you,' to y'all or something. I dunno. I just do what he says.

transcript.speaker: Surge
transcript.text: So yeah, I know I won't miss y'all cheatin' at cards. I'm lookin' at you, Johnny.

transcript.speaker: Surge
transcript.text: I can target a chipmunk's nuts at two thousand yards with my fifty cal, and y'all don't think I see you slippin' that ace outta your sleeve? Please!

transcript.speaker: Surge
transcript.text: I will not miss sharin' a home with a walkin' corpse, and a green-skinned monster.

transcript.speaker: Surge
transcript.text: Most of all, I won't miss Meg takin' in all the unnatural freaks of the Wasteland.

transcript.speaker: Surge
transcript.text: Like Lev says, only a matter of time 'fore one of 'em snaps and kills y'all.

transcript.speaker: Surge
transcript.text: Heh, I will miss Molly and her supply of good booze. I ain't lookin' forward to doin' without, I tell ya that.

items.name: Charleston Herald Interview - Juliana Wheatley

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

transcript.speaker: Juliana Wheatley
transcript.text: What do I think about how things are going in Welch? Well, it can't get much worse.

transcript.speaker: Juliana Wheatley
transcript.text: Earthquakes every other day, lawless thugs walking right down main street, and we're practically swimming in every kind of drug known to man!

transcript.speaker: Juliana Wheatley
transcript.text: If I didn't care about this place so much, I'd be on the first bus to Watoga.

transcript.speaker: Juliana Wheatley
transcript.text: But I'll stick it out. I'll try to make things better. Someone has to.

transcript.speaker: Juliana Wheatley
transcript.text: If we're going to pull through this, it's going to take nothing less than bullheaded determination to put us back on the right path.

transcript.speaker: Juliana Wheatley
transcript.text: Who needs money when you've got stubbornness?

transcript.speaker: Dara Gibson

transcript.speaker: Dara Gibson

transcript.speaker: Dara Gibson

items.name: Goodbye My Love
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: My love... when you hear this... remember that I will always love you. And... remember the me in this recording, not the me I will become.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: We lost so many to this... disease... a-and I can feel myself slipping each day. I know my fate and I have come to terms with it.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: *Chuckle* Hey, remember how we met? New Orleans, my father's gala, one starry night.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: It started with the usual pleasantries, but blossomed into a heated debate on the legacy we leave behind. When we stopped, it was already morning.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: Despite your sight, you have a vision unlike any man I have ever met. I was... always drawn to your keen intellect and unique insight.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: *Sigh* My only regret looking back is that I never was much of a mother... but Audrey is our legacy.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: You must carry on to keep her from my fate. Promise me this.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: After all, I learned over our many wonderful years together, if Hugo Stolz wants something, he makes it happen.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: Hey, do you remember the first night we met? At my father's gala? We- Oh, wait, I... just said that. *Sigh*

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: Goodbye my love. Remember me fondly.

items.name: Harold Frost's R&D Holotape
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: I can't believe we lost.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: We had one chance to prove that our Excavator Power Armor could beat the Hornwright Auto-Miner, and we blew it.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: Why Vivian came up with her ridiculous challenge is beyond me.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: She never even consulted with us first, just rolled it out there like a prize fight.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: Then the newspapers got a hold of it, and everything blew out of proportion. Now we're the laughingstock of the mining industry.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: Who in their right mind would buy any products from us after that? No one.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: So here I am, staring at the phone, waiting for the inevitable call to shut the R&D department down.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: Vivian betted all our chips on this project, and Garrahan Mining has wiped out.

transcript.speaker: Harold Frost
transcript.text: I wonder if Hornwright is hiring.

items.name: Lewisburg Basket Festival Opening

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: Hey all, thanks for coming out today. I'm Dave Jones, President of the Appalachia Arts Foundation.

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: I'd like to welcome you all to Lewisburg for another year of our outstanding Annual Basket Festival.

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: I'd like to thank everyone for helping to put this together... as you all know, it's a little smaller this year.

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: Good quality wicker is a bit harder to come by these days, but I'm proud of what we've been able to organize.

transcript.speaker: Cyrus Pickens
transcript.text: We're spendin' time on baskets when the whole world's gone to hell in one! When are we gonna get serious about things?

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: Folks, Cyrus Pickens... Cyrus, I do believe we had this discussion at the last Foundation meeting.

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: We took a vote on it, and we all agreed that just like we always have, Lewisburg Presses On.
And what about that pack of crazy dogs come through last spring? We need to do less talking, and more fortifying our homes in case trouble comes looking for us!

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: Heh, I'm sorry about this, folks... Cyrus, please, this isn't really the forum...

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: Okay, look. We've got the Crafts Festival next month and then the Painting exhibition the month after that.

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: Now maybe some time after those are done, we can circle back around afterwards and give it another discussion.

transcript.speaker: Glen Atkinson
transcript.text: Okay folks, let's get out there and enjoy ourselves! Don't forget to keep your gas masks handy in case the weather takes a turn, and most important of all, have fun!

items.name: Lewisburg Wine Festival Opening

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: Welcome, Ladies and Gentlemen, to the Lewisburg Wine and Music Festival. I'm Clara Davis, the newly-elected President of the Appalachia Arts Foundation.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: Before we begin, I'd like to take a moment to thank you all for your kinds words about our prior President, Mr. Glen Atkinson.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: Glen was a wonderful man, and his passing was unfortunate, if not entirely unexpected given his declining health over the last year.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: But as we all know, Lewisburg Presses On, don't we folks?

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: I'd also like to thank everyone for being so flexible, and managing to reschedule so much around that unfortunate storm.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: The weather's definitely a bit more unpredictable these days, and none of us quite expected the storm to last three whole weeks.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: Here we are now, though... all together, and I'm hoping we can enjoy a bit of... of, uhh...

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: Mr. Pickens, I see your hand raised, and I would just like to remind you that this is neither the place nor the time.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: You have repeatedly raised your concerns to the Foundation, and we have obligingly listened for years now. We'd like to keep a positive outlook on things.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: Maybe you could too, sir, and spend some time preparing for next month's Garden Festival.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: I'm sorry, Ladies and Gentlemen. Please do enjoy the day.

transcript.speaker: Clara Davis
transcript.text: I'm very proud we were able to find three musicians to perform for us this year, and we've verified no less than 4 wines that are 100 percent safe to drink.
