items.name: Message from Hank Madigan
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: This is Hank Madigan. Message to any Fire Breathers running through here after me.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Had to dodge more robots and turrets than I can count, but I found what we were looking for.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Atomic Mining Services were the barons of Ultracite. Had a lab right here in this office. I think they might have found a way to help us out. Even if they didn't know it.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Turns out once all the fuel is spent, there's a hunk of material left behind. This depleted Ultracite doesn't play nice with the normal stuff. Turns corrosive.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: AMS was thinking disposal and containment. I'm thinking weapon.

transcript.speaker: Hank Madigan
transcript.text: Scorched walk around with chunks of Ultracite stuck in them. We modify some guns to fire depleted Ultracite. See if that makes those assholes melt.

items.name: Mine Recorder Tape - 10.23.77

location.text: Found at Abandoned Mine Shaft Kittery.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Luann
transcript.text: George. George! You hear that? Listen.

transcript.speaker: George
transcript.text: I don't hear anything.

transcript.speaker: System Voice
transcript.text: Attention citizens. Nuclear strike imminent. Please exit the area at your earliest convenience. Thank you for your cooperation.

transcript.speaker: Luann
transcript.text: What'd it say?

transcript.speaker: George
transcript.text: Something about "convenience." Probably just an ad for Red Rocket, we get 'em all the---

transcript.speaker: George
transcript.text: What the hell was that? Was that a...

transcript.speaker: Luann
transcript.text: Nuclear strike. It said nuclear strike.

transcript.speaker: George
transcript.text: No. No. No. No. Jesus Christ. We need to get out of here.

transcript.speaker: Luann
transcript.text: Out of here? Are you crazy? We need shelter. This is shelter.

transcript.speaker: George
transcript.text: This isn't a vault, Luann! We don't know if this place will hold!

transcript.speaker: Luann
transcript.text: You don't have the slightest idea what's happening up there!

transcript.speaker: George
transcript.text: Get off me, Luann! I'm leaving.

transcript.speaker: Luann
transcript.text: Jesus, George. Don't ... fuck. George! Come back!

transcript.speaker: System Voice
transcript.text: Attention citizens. Nuclear strike imminent. Please exit the area at your earliest convenience. Thank you for your cooperation.

transcript.speaker: Luann
transcript.text: Oh god. Oh my god.

items.name: Mort's Edu-Tape #04: Mutations!

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Welcome back, faithful students to the latest of Headmaster Mort's Edu-Tapes! In this segment, the item actively festering in so many of us: mutations.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Prolonged or extreme exposure to radiation can affect the human body in a plethora of different ways:

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Skeletal degeneration, growths where you didn't have growths before...

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: ... your outer layer of skin leaving you like it's some kind of scumbag ex, Jessica. *clears throat*

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Sorry.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Occasionally, however, these mutations will also unlock previously unknown potential inside their recipients.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Your very own Headmaster Mort is now completely immune to further radiation exposure thanks to his mutation.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: We at the Mort Institute have also heard reports of increased mental cognition and empathy, heighted strength...

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: ... and even the development of defensive electrical discharge? What? Seriously, Duchess? I think someone was pulling your leg.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Whatever. Now, I know what you're thinking.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Headmaster, having my own pair of razor sharp talons is great, but what if I just want to live like a normal human being again?

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Well, luckily, there's a clear solution: good, old-fashioned Rad-Away.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Consuming a Rad-Away or two will usually clear up any mutation symptoms, allowing you to return to your previous, dull, unmutated self.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Now, there's a question that may cross your mind once you've acquired a mutation: Mort, does this make me a monster?

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: And let me be definitive here: no, you're not a monster because of your mutation. We're all so much more than what's inflicted on us, mutant or otherwise.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: All of us have experienced loss, desperation, regret just to be alive today. Those things can change us as much as hugging an open reactor core can.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: But what we do with those challenges, with the lives we've all had thrust upon us... that's where humanity lies.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: You only become a monster if you let the world make you one...

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: And with that, we conclude today's lesson on mutations. Tune in again soon for Headmaster Mort's next thrilling edu-venture. Thanks again for listening.

items.name: Not My Morgantown
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Apartment Renter
transcript.text: I tell ya, those filthy rich college kids are ruining everything.

transcript.speaker: Apartment Renter
transcript.text: Rent's going up another hundred dollars this year. Monorail rates? They almost doubled since I moved in.

transcript.speaker: Apartment Renter
transcript.text: The landlord is even thinking about billing us for maintenance requests. I'm not sure that's even legal.

transcript.speaker: Apartment Renter
transcript.text: Oh, and to top it all off, yeah, they're actually building another Slocum's Joe downtown.

transcript.speaker: Apartment Renter
transcript.text: I mean, seriously, do we really need more donut shops? This is getting ridiculous!

transcript.speaker: Apartment Renter
transcript.text: I'll tell ya, this is not my Morgantown.

items.name: Nukashine: What a trip!
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I've taken every drug in the Wasteland. Daddy-O, Mentats, Day Tripper, they each have their ups and downs, but Nukashine took me on a ride.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I didn't expect it, not from a swig of Appalachian hooch. I grew up on that stuff... Kentucky will do that to you.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: It was almost like a betrayal. The first sip had the same familiar burn, then it kicked you in the head like a two ton Brahmin, and it was all downhill from there.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Colors that I didn't know existed flashed before my eyes. The trees around me morphed into ravenous ghouls.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Beset on all sides, I reached for my gun and pulled a tato from the holster. Useless thing! I shouted.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: By then the ghouls had me, there was little I could do. I took off my shoe and beat them with it, to no avail.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I decided to succumb. Just devour me, I thought. What's the use in struggling at this point?

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Maybe some lucky cannibal will happen upon my scraps and get a free meal. At least that would give my death some meaning.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I let my mind wander as my body ceased to be. A cool breeze on the Florida coast. The splashing of the Mississippi.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: The green hills of Appalachia, a violent storm in the distance. I drifted from one to the next as my flesh broke into a thousand tiny pieces of ghoul fodder.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Suddenly, sunlight. I sat up. I was whole, on the temporal plane. Far too pleasant a place to be hell...

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Appalachia, the green hills from my vision. The crisis was over. I was still alive, with an empty jug of Nukashine by my side.

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 1

location.text: Found at Vault-Tec Ag Research Center.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's... let's call these personal journals. Not an official log. Just... something for me.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The Agricultural Center. One of my first posts with Vault-Tec. I was so excited because I used to come to this same farm when I was a kid.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I remember one year... at the Autumn Festival. Me running through the corn maze. Going every which way. Mom and dad yelling after me to slow down. Ha! Wasn't going to happen.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I guess I was always hitting life fast. Couldn't just be a Pioneer Scout, I had to make troupe leader. Couldn't just be a good student, I had to have straight A's.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: God, I miss those early days. Just... being a kid. The three of us. Our simple life. Our simple house. I wonder if it's still standing...

items.name: Potential cryptid sighting in Monongah

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: Raymond, I'll mail you a list of things I need tomorrow. But I wanted to tell you what I found, first hand. This is big.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: This is the real deal. I found a dead bear, shredded by... something, I don't know. I met a woman in Beckley who said there is a pale monster up here. The Beast, she said.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: Listen, this thing... if it is half as weird as it sounds... it could be a gold mine. Crazy Calvin would pay out the nose for it!

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: Raymond, this is a game changer. We could finally buy the shop outright... or we could get a new truck, or hire some help.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: Ok, please bring those supplies to my old fishing camp near the pond north of Beckley. This is where I caught that two-headed fish, remember?

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: There's probably a map to my hunting camp in my old truck by the shop. So drive down here and come look for my camp. Park near my car on the road.

transcript.speaker: Janelle
transcript.text: Ok... oh and um, Raymond - I'm sorry I've been on the hunt for almost two weeks. I know it's taken longer than usual... but baby I really think it'll be worth it this time!

items.name: President's Eyes ONLY
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: This here is James Addison, of the Whitespring Resort staff. I tell ya, they never thought I was telling the truth but I found it.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: I swear by all that is holy, I found it. I knew it was there all along, see, it started with the rumbling.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: We had some minor earthquakes, you heard me right, earthquakes of all things in this neck of the woods.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: I knew somethin' wasn't right, and I was gonna prove 'em all wrong. All the other people at the Resort just laughing at me, well, who's laughin' now?

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: I just discovered a fuckin' underground spaceship! And the rocket fuel leakin' off of that thing?

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: Hell, it's making even the rocks glow! I gotta tell the President if it's the last thing I do!

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: I'll be an American hero! Get the Medal of Honor, I bet! All right, 'nuff talkin'.

transcript.speaker: James
transcript.text: Time to swim back to home, to glory, and to wipin' that damn smirk off Robbie's face! James out!

items.name: Rocco and Lev's Deal

location.text: Found at Poseidon Energy Plant Expansion.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: Meg, I know you will find this tape. Also know we will be gone long time when you find it.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: I know this because you are weak, ineffective leader. You could not lead gang out of wet paper bag. Too weak. Too stupid. Too cowardly.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: When I hear you invite in that cockroach, and want to go off on some ridiculous vault heist to find gold, I call that last straw.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: Surge and Fisher know how stupid plan is, and how terrible leader you are, so they come with me. Leave you behind with freaks and losers.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: Know this. We will gain more men. We will come back, powerful. Then we will wipe you, and all your freaks off map. Sleep tight, blyat.

items.name: Runner's Log 01: Career Change
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: This is Bella Gerber, Union Runner. I used to run supplies between Union outposts. Now I run civilians to places they might survive.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: People are fleeing their homes to get away from the Fanatics, finding themselves in dangerous places they don't recognize anymore.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Places like the Trench. I kept encountering them on my runs: people trapped under fallen rubble; broken families; lost wanderers, wasting away.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I thought, "These people need shelter more than the 42 needs bullets."

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: So I started taking them with me, to the Sanctum. The last bastion of hope we have in this awful, gaping chasm.

items.name: Runner's Log 02: White Lies
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Bella Gerber, Union Runner, continuing my self-appointed route between the Sanctum and the Trench.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: It's getting harder to navigate; the terrain changes every day. If something happens to me, I worry that the people sheltered here will be stranded.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: I need to get back to headquarters and update someone on what's happening here. But at this point... (sigh) I don't know if I can find my way back.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: Today a little boy asked me if he would ever get to go back home. I didn't have the heart to tell him.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: That I... That his home... probably doesn't exist anymore. That I wouldn't be able to guide him there, even if it did.

transcript.speaker: Bella Gerber
transcript.text: All I could do was smile and promise that we'd take care of him here, at the Sanctum.

items.name: Senior Executive Exam Updates
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Daniel Hornwright
transcript.text: Hanover. This is Daniel Hornwright.

transcript.speaker: Daniel Hornwright
transcript.text: I presume you've seen to it that the Technology Support group has updated the Senior Executive exam with my clarified answers.

transcript.speaker: Daniel Hornwright
transcript.text: I'm growing... weary of the spineless ... "executives" you've been sending me.

transcript.speaker: Daniel Hornwright
transcript.text: You find me some candidates with the wherewithal to survive here or else I'll find someone who will.

items.name: Something's Up

location.text: Found at Radio Astronomy Research Center.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jonathan Wajowski
transcript.text: There's some weird shit going on here, man.
What are you talking about?

transcript.speaker: Jonathan Wajowski
transcript.text: I know we just started our internship here, but I can already tell there's something off about this place.
Like what?

transcript.speaker: Jonathan Wajowski
transcript.text: I heard a couple of the full-timers talking about some off-the-wall stuff, and... wait, are you recording this? What the fuck, man? What's going on?
You were told to keep your head down and do your research, Jonathan.

transcript.speaker: Jonathan Wajowski
transcript.text: Wait, who are they?
We need you to come with us, Jonathan.

items.name: Stuck
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: Stuck. Again.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: Carmen thinks I should document when this happens so we can sue the company.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: I don't know about all that, it's not really their fault, but there's not all that much to do while I'm in here, so here goes.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: It wasn't easy reaching the recorder, but I think I got it turned on.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: At least this time I'm in a section you can see from the hallway, so I shouldn't have to wait long. What luck there's -
<Muffled sounds of banging on the other side of glass>
Michael?! Not again. You okay in there?!

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: Yeah! I mean - it's getting a little hot in here - but yeah, I guess I'm okay!

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: *sigh* So embarrassing...
What's that buddy? Didn't hear you!

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: Nothing! Forget it!
I'm calling maintenance right now. Hang in there, Michael!

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: <Sound of rushing air and a small pneumatic "ca-thunk">

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: Great. There goes another hair piece.

items.name: Succession
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Quentino Lombardi
transcript.text: *groans*

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: C'mon, Tino. You can do it. Let me help you up.

transcript.speaker: Quentino Lombardi
transcript.text: I can do it myself! *coughs* I don't need your help. You're only after one thing.

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: One thing?! Who has sat by your bedside waiting on you hand and foot? Who has covered for you dutifully while you waste away on your own product?!

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: Antonio sure didn't. Neither did the other caporegimes! I have done everything you ever asked of me for nothing in return.

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: Why can't you see that? Why can't you look at me the same way you look at them? Why can't you-?

transcript.speaker: Quentino Lombardi
transcript.text: This is exactly why I can't! *coughs* You are weak, emotional. You are stuck in your own head.

transcript.speaker: Quentino Lombardi
transcript.text: You think you're special because you're my sister. I'll tell you what, Concerta. Without me, you'd be nothing. You're not special!

transcript.speaker: Quentino Lombardi
transcript.text: You know the rules, and you aren't above them. Tony will be my heir, and he'll do a fine job as godfather.

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: How can you say that?! I built this empire! I was there, telling YOU what to do all along!

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: I never overstepped, I never betrayed you. I played my part. But now, we both know that the inevitable is just around the corner.

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: Please, just hear me out. Just tell them-

transcript.speaker: Quentino Lombardi
transcript.text: Enough! *wheezes* I've been crystal clear already. You expect the impossible, and then act surprised when you're told no.

transcript.speaker: Quentino Lombardi
transcript.text: I shouldn't have to tell you what your place is. You already know. It ain't gonna change after I croak.

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: Yes, you're right. I went too far. For that, I'm sorry. Antonio is your heir. I need to respect that.

transcript.speaker: Concerta Lombardi
transcript.text: You two won't be apart for long, I wager.

items.name: The Beckley Informant

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.text: We got them on the run, Sally. Beckley's ours!

transcript.speaker: Old Woman
transcript.text: I got 'em for you. But... What if no one comes?
The governor's got to give in, the whole town's unified.

transcript.speaker: Old Woman
transcript.text: Even if the marshals don't break us up, all they have to do is sit... Starve us out.
What's gotten into you? Our families' been mining here for generations.

transcript.speaker: Old Woman
transcript.text: I just-
What? What's that?

transcript.speaker: Old Woman
transcript.text: Nothing, nothing-
Are you wearing a wire? A goddamn wire?

transcript.speaker: Old Woman
transcript.text: Oww, oww.
Get her. Get her!
Listen up, Governor Evans, your paid lackeys can't stop us. Beckley. Is. Ours!

items.name: The End of America

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Chinese Spy
transcript.text: The capitalists disgust me.

transcript.speaker: Chinese Spy
transcript.text: Look around? The Americans are so haughty - claiming their precious democracy is better.

transcript.speaker: Chinese Spy
transcript.text: But I see the ruins all around me. The time of judgment will come.

transcript.speaker: Chinese Spy
transcript.text: I must admit, though, the spaghetti is quite good. Damn them.

items.name: The Fairgrounds' New Sponsor

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Mark Kinser
transcript.text: You know, Tal, everyone's gonna claim you sold out.

transcript.speaker: Talbot
transcript.text: Well, they won't be wrong. This absolutely qualifies. It is, in fact, the definition of selling out.

transcript.speaker: Mark Kinser
transcript.text: Doesn't it bother you? Nuka-Cola coming in here and plastering logos all over the place, putting in knock-off rides... taking over?

transcript.speaker: Talbot
transcript.text: Of course it bothers me! This fair's been run by my family for 30-odd years now! But I don't have a choice. Can't manage another season on my own.

transcript.speaker: Mark Kinser
transcript.text: Maybe if we did like a community fundraiser or something...

transcript.speaker: Talbot
transcript.text: Oh, please. You know well as I do that won't cut it. Nuka-Cola, big corporation like that, they've got cash to burn.

transcript.speaker: Mark Kinser
transcript.text: So... how did you make out?

transcript.speaker: Talbot
transcript.text: You know damn well I am not giving you a number.

transcript.speaker: Mark Kinser
transcript.text: We've been friends 15 years now, and you won't tell me?

transcript.speaker: Talbot
transcript.text: Let's just say my family's gonna be taken care of for a good, long time. That's all that matters to me.

items.name: The Government's Plan
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Kora
transcript.text: Raleigh gave the all clear. Not sure what I expected, but it definitely wasn't this.

transcript.speaker: Kora
transcript.text: I knew the government would get us nuked. Easy population control that you can just blame on the Chinese.

transcript.speaker: Kora
transcript.text: Get rid of the unwanted lower class, cherry pick the middle. Leave the government and military to restore whatever order they want.

transcript.speaker: Kora
transcript.text: But look at this place. Have fun restoring this infected, mess of a world, you dipshits!

items.name: To Meg and Crater Freaks

location.text: Found at Spruce Knob Boat Rental.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: What are you doing? No need for tape.

transcript.speaker: Rocco
transcript.text: Just a little insurance, in case you need a reminder about the terms of our agreement here.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: Whatever. You do what you want. Is worthless anyway. Now, go on. Let us talk payment.

transcript.speaker: Rocco
transcript.text: S... sure. Like I said, I'll give you all the guns, ammo, and other supplies I took and hid away from Foundation.

transcript.speaker: Rocco
transcript.text: If, and only if you ruin any chances of your people breaking into that vault.

transcript.speaker: Rocco
transcript.text: You get it all once you get me that detonator, so I can break in myself and bring the goods back to Foundation. They'll have to let me back in, then.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: Yes, yes. I get location of gun stash, you get to go on foolish endeavor.

transcript.speaker: Rocco
transcript.text: You know, you and your crew could always help me break in, get a nice cut of the treasure, right?

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: No. Vault gold is useless. You will see. Ammo, weapons. That is new world currency. To hell with gold.

transcript.speaker: Rocco
transcript.text: You're missing out, but I guess we'll agree to disagree.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: Look. As long as you pay up after job is done, I won't regret not killing you when we found you.

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: Can always come back to that if you are lying about stash.

transcript.speaker: Rocco
transcript.text: N...n...No lie, no sir! Understood. We got ourselfes an agreement then. Pleasure doing business with you, uh...

transcript.speaker: Lev
transcript.text: Lev. Now put recorder away. You have alcohol in this shithole? We will drink to seal deal.

items.name: Trainyard Supervisor's Report

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.
items.contents: Transcript not found in the game files.

items.name: Vault Life
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: Well life has taken an unexpected turn. I miss simpler times where all I worried about were our corporate interests, and the odd gala or fundraiser.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: Now it's all about managing resources, people and the Vault projects. All beside my Hugo, at the end of the world no less.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: I shudder to think what would have happened if we didn't manage to secure a place on Vault-Tec's board of directors.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: Considering Anchorage... it was just a matter of time before the bombs.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: We knew it would be a long shot also convincing the board to make Hugo an Overseer, but luckily the potential he offered was just too promising.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: *Sigh* I do wish father and the rest didn't decline Hugo's invitation to the Vault. One day... maybe I'll find out if they made it out there.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: Saying that, it wasn't ideal moving into the Vault while still under construction. At least the workers were still here to finish what they started.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: We generously allowed them to stay in return for their flexibility with all of Hugo's on-going... requests and redesigns.

transcript.speaker: Cassidy Stolz
transcript.text: Perhaps they didn't realize that meant signing up for menial maintenance and custodial duties too, but surviving underground is no vacation, now is it?

items.name: Watoga Municipal Courtroom Recording

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: ...and the total for your parking tickets, Mr. Phillips, is $1567.32. All outstanding fines are payable by cash or credit.

transcript.speaker: Mr. Phillips
transcript.text: I've told you three times, I'm not paying your illegal fines! Look, I want to speak to a real person. Where's the judge? I want to talk to him!

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: By Executive Order, the position of [JUDGE] has been automated.

transcript.speaker: Mr. Phillips
transcript.text: Unbelievable! I'm going back there, and I am going to find an actual human.

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: Sir, recording devices are not allowed in the courtroom and immediate vicinity.

transcript.speaker: Mr. Phillips
transcript.text: I am documenting this travesty of justice... Excuse me, you are blocking my freedom of movement! You're violating my rights here!

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: Sir, your recording device is not permitted...

transcript.speaker: Mr. Phillips
transcript.text: Yeah, well, you're not permitted! Step aside, I am going back there!

transcript.speaker: Protectron
transcript.text: Warnings issued. Deploying taser.
*taser being deployed*

transcript.speaker: Mr. Phillips
transcript.text: ...Free Watoga....

items.name: Wiretap Evidence - Quentin Arlen

location.text: Counts towards the holotape challenge, but the game files don't show where it is placed. Location not added yet.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Quentin Arlen
transcript.text: I hate it when you talk like I'm a criminal, Ma.

transcript.speaker: Quentin Arlen
transcript.text: I'm a businessman. People demand things, and I supply them. Capitalism at its finest, right?

transcript.speaker: Quentin Arlen
transcript.text: While back I was doing a little run for the Duchess, and found out just how much this city loves me.

transcript.speaker: Quentin Arlen
transcript.text: Picked up the goods, and had the usual uneventful trip most of the way back. Hit the outskirts of Welch, and whad'ya know - the local sheriff is waiting for me.

transcript.speaker: Quentin Arlen
transcript.text: I'm just about to pull my weapon and make things "interesting", when a group of old coal men show up. They start hollering about how those Auto-Miners have gone topsy-turvy, and are causing all kinds of mayhem back in Mine Shaft Elaine!

transcript.speaker: Quentin Arlen
transcript.text: The lawman bails, I pay the boys a little distraction fee, and everyone's happy. The people understand me. The people need me! And I'm pleased to provide.

items.name: A Lead at Last
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Dr. G... I hope this message finds you well. I'm closing in on my target, a big man called Little Rob.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: They say he lives somewhere in the mountains. In some kind of hideout.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: You might wonder who 'they' are... I'm talking about people in the know. Squatters, prospectors, gold diggers. They say they've had run ins with the target.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I met them in a shack in the hills, up near a golf course that's seen better days. But I wasn't there for the greens...

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: We met up and made merry. Don't judge me! You're a merrymaker yourself, you know. They said they could take me to Rob.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I decided to follow. Dangerous, I know, but you have to take some risks if you're gonna get the big score. That's just how it is in this business.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I'll see you on the other side. Hunter out.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 01
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Okay folks, we've finally got the results back from the consumer surveys! These ones were to gauge attitudes towards the Abraxodyne Chemical brand.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: We did good, but the board thinks we can do better. They've asked for a full rebranding campaign that focuses on cementing a "family-friendly" image.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: I want us all to put our heads together on this one and come up with some standout ideas. Don't hold back - think big, think bold!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: What about a new mascot? I-I'm thinking an anthropomorphic bubble named "Squeaky" who teaches kids good hygiene and traditional values.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: A what? No, Martin, get it together, for Pete's sake!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about a commercial? We have the brand recognition and the budget to make something memorable. Lots of the big brands are doing it!

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: A commercial... I like it. We'll need a catchy slogan to go with it too, of course. Something to really sell the "wholesome" angle.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Say no more, say no more, I have got it! "We're soft on fabrics, but hard on Communism!" Not bad, eh? Tell me that's not our pièce de résistance.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Ugh, Martin...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about we pick something that showcases our values?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, I've got one. "Abraxodyne Chemical: For families who put clean living first."

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: That's perfect, they'll eat that "family first" baloney right up. Nice work Janice.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: All right, good work everybody. Now that's out of the way, let's discuss next quarter's recruitment strategies.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 02
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Our Marketing, P.R. and R&D departments have all been hard at work this quarter crafting our new employee instructional video.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: As requested, we've covered the major areas of concern that have been "problematic" in recent years. So, let's see what you think. Roll the tape.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Welcome, employee. Whether this is your first time donning the Abraxodyne Chemical overalls or the hundredth, this training video is for you!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: By following these simple steps and adhering to our new mandatory safety protocols, you'll be keeping yourself, and the company, out of harm's way.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Employees are expected to take full, personal responsibility for their own actions and for the safety of their team. Remember: safety is no accident!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Deviation from our chemical handling procedures can have serious consequences; for you, and for the lab.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: *Scream*

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Oops! That's gotta sting. Remember folks, follow the safety procedures outlined in the employee handbook or face the consequences.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Our patented cleaning formula should be tough on grime, not tough on you. Report to a supervisor immediately if you encounter any infractions.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Here at Abraxodyne Chemical, we like to keep things spotless. But, did you know that cleanliness starts with what you say?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: That's right. Gossip and rumors leave a nasty stain on you and the company. Best to steer clear of the grapevine and avoid the unwanted repercussions.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: When you signed your contract with us, you joined something bigger than yourself. Bigger than detergent. You joined a family.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: And as family, we ask only for the loyalty, commitment, and trust that we've invested into you. Please read your contracts for more details.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: So don't forget, the success of Abraxodyne Chemical lies with you. Stick to these guidelines and we'll all shine!

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 03
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: *Sigh*

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Something on your mind, Ms. Amrita?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: No, no. Just another lousy meeting where I'm asked to achieve the impossible.

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: That so? Was it as bad as the one last week?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hah! Worse, in fact. You don't know the half of it Moses.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: You know, sometimes I wonder how we keep getting into these screw-ups, especially after Pittsburgh. I'm always the one left to pick up the pieces.

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: You're a hard worker, Ms. Amrita. Why, I always see you running around here, busy as a one-legged man in a butt-kicking contest!

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Dealing with the bumps in the road ain't easy, but I'm sure the fine folks here appreciate your efforts.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I really wish I believed you, but sometimes I feel like I'm one bad P.R. statement away from being thrown under the bus.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I've got to start looking into ways to protect myself a bit more... We've all got to cover our backs right?

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 04
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Here you go, ma'am, you can call the number on the back to find more details about Abraxodyne's newest-

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Terry... Terry!

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: What? I'm with a customer right now. Apologies, ma'am, that flyer should have all the info you need. C'mon man, you're distracting me!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Some guy was just asking me the weirdest questions!

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Yeah, so? People are meant to come and ask us questions, that's why we're here.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Here we are sir, let us know if you'd like any more information.

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Yeah, but this guy was crazy. Get a load of this: He was asking me questions about all the "incidents" the company's had in the last few years and-

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: For the love of God, Ronny! Tell me you didn't give him any details, you're gonna get us both fired!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Relax, will ya? I'm not an idiot. I remember what they told us in the briefing.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: There we go, ma'am. Come by the booth again, if you have questions.

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Anyways, I tell him to get bent 'cause I'm not gonna accidentally spill the beans to some undercover reporter looking for a scoop.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Oh great, so now we're gonna get written up for insulting the public!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Take it easy will ya? I did it all professional-like! He told me that he was with the military and that they're interested in our product's potential.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Interested? Interested how?

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: I'm not sure. But, it smells like a bonus if we can take it up the chain.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Yeah... Yeah, maybe you're right. Okay, well what are we waiting for? Let's go find him!

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 05
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Come on Martin, you're one good idea away from getting that promotion, I can feel it!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: The others might laugh at me now, but they won't once I'm in charge, that's for sure.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I just need something that will grab the board's attention, something that will really blow their socks off...

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ooo! What about a special edition of Abraxo called "Atomic Sparkle" with trace elements of Uranium. "Your clothes will come out glowing... literally!"

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: No, that will never get through the safety tests! Definitely not after our last whoopsie with radioactive ingredients.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Perhaps we take a different approach? How about an actual soap opera named "Suds Galore"? Where the laundry is clean but the drama is anything but!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: We could even have a talking washing machine voiced by a celebrity to plug our latest products and deal bonanzas.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: No... Far too whimsical, and may give children nightmares.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I've got it! A line of air fresheners dedicated to American presidents.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: We could have Teddy Roosevelt Tang: Raw, musky, slightly peppery. Smells like gunpowder and moustache wax.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Or-or Truman Spice: Sharp, direct, strong. A smell that isn't afraid to make hard decisions or send the Communists packing!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Voila, it's perfect, I've cracked it! If the board doesn't like this one, I'll eat my hat!

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 06
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: I've told you before, I don't feel comfortable getting in front of any cameras until we've had a proper review of our lab safety requirements!

transcript.speaker: Sheila
transcript.text: And that's been duly noted, Julius. We appreciate you bringing it to our attention, again. Your concern for your fellow lab techs is commendable.

transcript.speaker: Sheila
transcript.text: However, the board has stated several times that they want our lead researcher to be present in this new commercial to add credibility.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: If the board wants credibility then they need to put their money where their mouth is, and start listening to our concerns.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Not spending the budget on flashy commercials instead of the proper safety equipment I've had on the docket for over six months!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Your equipment requests have been received and are currently being reviewed by our finance team for validity.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Validity? My guys are burning through a respirator a day with the old kits! We need stronger equipment if you want us to work on this type of stuff.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: That's enough, Julius. Or do you need reminding of the confidentiality agreement you signed?

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: We need you in the new advertisement, simple as that. Anyhow, you're obligated to perform certain public appearances. Check your contract.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It won't be too strenuous Julius. You'll be fully prepared beforehand and I'll personally see to it that you get your equipment. How does that sound?

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Fine! I'll give you one afternoon, but no more. Someone needs to be supervising the lab techs, given the situation.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Well, I'm glad that's finally sorted. Why the sudden need for stronger respirators though? Our standard equipment has served us fine for years, no?

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Probably best to leave those details to the experts for now. Thanks for your help today, Amrita. I'll send you the shooting schedule for the ad soon.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 07
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: I mean, how do they expect us to work in these conditions?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: You said it, pal. Complete joke, if you ask me.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Just a little louder, come on...

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: It's bad enough that they won't give us any of the new hazmat suits, but not replacing clearly broken equipment?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: It's downright dangerous if you ask me. And with the wages we're earning, it's hardly worth the risk.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Ugh, I can barely hear them. Maybe it was a mistake hiding in here.

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: Jake's the third person working this shift who's gone off sick in a month. Now don't tell me that's a coincidence, 'cause I ain't stupid!

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: Hey, at least you weren't the one who inherited his mop. Look at this thing - what was he mopping up with it? Lava?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: You can't use that mangled piece of crap. You'd be better off using a wad of paper towels at this rate. Let me grab my spare from the store cupboard.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh shi-

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 08
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Hmm, note to self: Check with R&D boys about investigating an edible detergent. A tasty snack that delights the mind and cleans the stomach!

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Oh, it's you...

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ah, Kerry, hello! I was just looking for you actually. I have another brilliant idea; I think you're going to really like this one.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: What is it this time, Martin?

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I call it "shower-in-a-can": It's an aerosol spray that eliminates the need for bathing. Convenient for the modern go-getter!

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Yeah, okay, that's great and all, but listen - I have some actual work for you to do. We have a new... product that we need a company codename for.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ah excellent, I'm quite a wunderkind at that sort of thing. So, what's the new product? I'll be able to whip up a name for you, tout de suite.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Don't worry about what it is, that's classified information. Just make sure it sounds appealing and, uh... clean. Have it on my desk by five.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Right, think Martin, you can do this. Needs to be something fresh, something invigorating. "Spring Clean"? No, too obvious.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Nature... purity; something delicate-sounding that won't overstay its welcome, like a polite dinner guest. Meadow-something, perhaps?

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: "Meadow Glade"? Hm, no-no, not quite. "Meadow Whisper" maybe? No, too sultry. Ah, what about "Meadow Breeze"!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Yes, that's it! "Meadow Breeze"! Gentle, yet exciting. Fragrant, yet sophisticated. It screams business but with a delightful je ne sais quoi.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: God, I'm good! Note to self: Ask Kerry for a raise.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 09
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: All right everybody, quiet on set please. Roll sound, roll camera. Take 1. And... action!

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Here at Abraxodyne Chemical, we're pioneering the latest and greatest in cleaning products, engineered to brighten your whites and your day... We-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Cut, CUT! Listen buddy, I know you're probably used to being down in the lab all day and whatnot, but I'm gonna need a little bit more verve, okay?

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: It's hard to be enthusiastic when you're making me read this drivel! Whoever wrote this should spend a hot minute in my lab, then-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Okay folks, let's take five and give the "talent" time to blow off some... steam.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Julius, I know this might feel like baloney to you, but we're just trying to go for the most family-friendly vibe we can.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Family-friendly? Amrita, I know you're in charge of the P.R. here, but I didn't think you'd fall for that line yourself!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: All right, back to positions everybody. Let's take it from the second scene. And here we go!

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Don't forget to collect your "Abraxo-bucks", found in all eligible Abraxodyne products, for your chance to win a year's supply of premium detergent.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: For all your cleaning needs, think Abraxodyne Chemical: For families who put clean living first... Really? Is that what we're going with?

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: CUT!

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 10
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I'm recording this to say, that enough is enough. This... This is getting out of hand now and somebody has to do... something.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It started out with keeping receipts in case the board ever tried to pin one of their screw-ups on me. Just so I had a bit of leverage... Anything.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: But every stone I've unturned, the rot goes deeper and deeper. The more I look, the more I find...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Isn't it my job to know the ugly stuff; so I can shield the brand and help us focus on what really helps people?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Whatever we're doing now, it goes a hell of a lot deeper than the circles I'm part of.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: And this "Meadow Breeze" project I've seen referenced in new data entries... I can't tell exactly what it is, but I do not like the look of it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I think... I think I need to keep going. I wish I could put this genie back in the bottle and turn a blind eye but, this has all gone too far now

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Somebody's got to hold them to account. And if not me, then who?

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 11
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: How did we get to this stage in the first place, Kerry? I thought we agreed to can this idea after the failure of the first round of testing?

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: We did, but, we were very close, so I encouraged the boys to keep working on an improved formula in their down time.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: This is unacceptable. Even entertaining the idea of developing this "Meadow Breeze" weapon flies in the face of what this company stands for.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: I hear your concerns, I do, but think of it this way: If we get this right, then Abraxodyne Chemical will be helping protect our troops oversees.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: This stuff is so strong, it could be used as a deterrent against the Commies! Who knows, it might even prevent a war. Now that's patriotic!

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Patriotic? What malarkey! Have you lost your mind? We're a family company, Kerry, remember? That's just not how we do things here.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: I reckoned some of you might not be on board yet, so I took the liberty of compiling the projected revenue from the military contract.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: Mother of God...

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Well, when you put it that way... Perhaps it wouldn't hurt for the company to get with the times a bit more.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: Yeah, and I suppose we do have a national duty to protect our boys in uniform, after all. It'll be great for morale and market share. *chuckle*

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 12
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I know, ma, but I don't really have a choice right now.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I never thought I'd get promoted out of a secretary position in the first place. I can't mess this up!

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It's 'cause of this new "genius" contest idea that Tony came up with. Y'know the "Abraxo-bucks" one?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It wouldn't have been so bad if they'd done the cost projections before committing to it, but now they've realized they can't have "so many winners".

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Now I've got to sort through the distribution data and make sure it's "statistically unlikely" for anyone to actually collect enough of these tickets.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I can't demand that, ma.*Sigh* I'm just going to have to keep staying late until it's done. I'm too afraid to make a fuss about it.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I know, I know you're right. Anyways, can you put Mikey's dinner in the oven and put the kids to bed for me please? Love you.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: *Sigh*

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hey, Janice.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, hey Amrita, didn't see you back there! Don't mind what I was saying to my mom, she just worries is all. Everything's fine!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about you take off and go spend some time with those kids, huh? Tell Tony he can talk to me if he's got a problem with it.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, Amrita, are you sure? I don't want to get you in any trouble. I could really use the sleep though...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It's fine, get out of here, go get some rest. Don't worry, I'll lock up around here after you're gone.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 13
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: For the love of God, I am getting sick of this! It is ridiculous! Every damn thing we say ends up getting leaked to the press somehow!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: How are we even meant to have these meetings if there's no guarantee they won't end up in the hands of reporters?

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: All right, Harold, let's keep calm. Indiscretion has caused enough problems already. We just need to tighten up our flow of information, that's all.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: We're lucky that this reporter was caught and dealt with before anything could be published and our brand permanently damaged.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Even so, everything points to this being an inside job! How else would they have heard about project Meadow Breeze?

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: That is true. How about this then: If the mole is in this room, come forward, and we can smooth this all out. Right here, right now.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: No? Well, it was worth a try. So be it, tomorrow we'll begin upscaling our internal investigations and, if needed, we won't hesitate to-

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: What was that?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Sorry, I, uh... dropped my handbag.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: As I was saying, we will do whatever is needed to get to the bottom of this.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 14
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: This tape is being recorded for my own protection, as well as everyone else's. They're getting close, but I can't stop now.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It's taken months and several near-misses, but I think I've collected enough evidence to finally hold these bastards to account.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I don't even know who I should show this stuff to - a lawyer? The police? Hell, even the press?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: The important thing is this: project "Meadow Breeze" is not a cleaning product. It's some kind of awful, deadly weapon, and I can prove it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How it can decimate crops, ecosystems, hell even metal! It's all here in these reports. God only knows what its long term impact on human beings is!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How did I not realize all of this sooner? Julius was practically spelling it out to me all along. I've been so stupid...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I'll admit, I've had a part to play in our cover ups over the years, but not this. Never this.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I don't have much time. The board are tying up loose ends and it won't be long before they notice things going missing. I need to get out, and soon.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: All that's left is to listen to these few extra tapes I swiped from the security room. Here goes:

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Dealing with the bumps in the road ain't easy, but I'm sure the fine folks here appreciate your efforts.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I've got to start looking into ways to protect myself a bit more... We've all got to cover our backs, right?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Wait, but that's back when I was talking to... How did they get their hands on my copy? Oh God, oh God! I need to-

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 15
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hi, Janice! Come in, take a seat.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How's everything going? Is the "Abraxo-bucks" initiative making good progress?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It's going swell, thanks. But I actually had something else I wanted to talk to you about.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh. Well I'm always happy to talk things through. What's on your mind?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: You remember that problem the board had with the "flow of information"? From what I hear, they're getting mighty close to solving it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Huh. Well I'm glad to hear that things are-

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: And if I was someone involved in that situation whatsoever, I would sure start thinking about moving on. Sooner rather than later.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Alrighty, well, I've gotta skedaddle now. It was really nice chatting with you again Amrita. Take care, won't you?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh God...

transcript.speaker: Calvin van Lowe
transcript.text: Ahem... "Now beginning behavioral reprogramming on model number," uh... RX, zero, zero... and so on.

transcript.speaker: Calvin van Lowe
transcript.text: "I, Calvin van Lowe, hereby agree... accountability... death and or dismemberment..." blah, blah, blah...

transcript.text: Well, that was a waste of time. Listen here, Ms. Assaultron; I'm going to be augmenting your behavioral subroutines.

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: Doctors. Hello from Earth. The full Board is here, waiting for your reports. Dr. Carol, can you begin?

transcript.speaker: Dr. Bernard
transcript.text: Phase two analysis: Subject Daguerre is responding well. The sleeping pod is performing within all expected parameters.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Bernard
transcript.text: Physiologically... her body is in perfect stasis.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Bernard
transcript.text: Mentally... it took about five minutes for her to progress into standard R.E.M. sleep after Serum Z was administered at the prescribed 10cc dose.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Bernard
transcript.text: Additional Sleeping Pods have been installed for Phase III. Any other questions for me? Standing by.

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: Thank you, Doctor. Yes, the Board has a question for you. How long can the subject remain in your device?

transcript.speaker: Dr. Bernard
transcript.text: I wouldn't expect much degradation to occur for at least a few decades. Hard to estimate beyond that. Over.

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: Is Doctor Nowak on the line?

transcript.speaker: Dr. Nowak
transcript.text: Oh! Uh. Yes, that's me. I'm here. And by here, I mean, I'm in orbit in space looking down at the Earth where you all are---

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: We got it, Doctor. Thanks. We have a question for you. Can you determine whether the connection has been made?

transcript.speaker: Dr. Nowak
transcript.text: Yes. I can determine that the connection has been made. The A.T.H.E.N.A. unit has full access.

transcript.speaker: A.T.H.E.N.A.
transcript.text: Confirmed. Pathways are open. Connection is complete.

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: Thank you. We have a question for Dr. Lee---

transcript.speaker: Dr. Lee
transcript.text: I'm here!

transcript.speaker: Dr. Lee
transcript.text: *strange banging sounds*

transcript.speaker: Dr. Lee
transcript.text: Sorry, just had to fix a transmitter refraction--

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: Enough. Dr. Lee, how stable is the ship at its current position in orbit?

transcript.speaker: Dr. Lee
transcript.text: Uh... fine? It's fine. It should probably last, uh, as long as she does, anyway. Probably. Uh. I mean definitely.

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: Perfect. Is the ship's U.S.S.A. bot currently available and nearby?

transcript.speaker: Pandora
transcript.text: Affirmative. Pandora Unit is ready for orders.

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: Excellent. Pandora -- escort the Doctors to their own personal Deep Sleep pods.

transcript.speaker: Board Member
transcript.text: You need to say the code, Rob. Your team made it, you should know that. *laughs* Red Sunrise.

transcript.speaker: Pandora
transcript.text: Expulsion will begin in 30 seconds. Enter your assigned pod immediately.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Lee
transcript.text: Wait. What? This isn't part of the experiment methodology. Also, we don't agree? Right, Doctors? You can't do this!

transcript.speaker: Dr. Nowak
transcript.text: Daguerre's sleep pod is inside the main escape capsule. We need to get it out so we can get out of here. Come on, someone help me open this thing!

transcript.speaker: Dr. Bernard
transcript.text: The Board is in violation of our contract. I want the U.S.S.A. on the line right now.

transcript.speaker: Emerson
transcript.text: The U.S.S.A. is well aware of the current status, Dr. Carol, thank you. Please cooperate now.

transcript.speaker: Pandora
transcript.text: Expulsion will begin in 30 seconds. Enter your assigned pod immediately.

transcript.speaker: Pandora
transcript.text: Blade electrified. 10 seconds.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Nowak
transcript.text: Get in! Get in quick!

transcript.speaker: Pandora
transcript.text: *pod doors slamming shut*

transcript.speaker: Emerson
transcript.text: Phase III is now officially underway. Now, we just have to wait and see how ATHENA responds with three sources.

transcript.speaker: Emerson
transcript.text: Congratulations everybody.

transcript.speaker: Pandora
transcript.text: *clapping*

items.name: Filtcher Farm Interview
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Vigilant Citizen
transcript.text: This is... A Vigilant Citizen. And this is an interview with Gladys Filtcher.

transcript.speaker: Vigilant Citizen
transcript.text: Can you repeat that?

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: So those soldiers, they drove onto my land and started fencing off the north part of my farm. Two years back.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: Well, I ain't one to take that lying down. After making a ruckus, their Captain came by.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: Said it was for my own safety. That there were dangerous level of radiation over there.

transcript.speaker: Vigilant Citizen
transcript.text: Did they say what caused it?

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: They wouldn't say word one. Before I could carry on too much, this man in a black suit comes over. Says it's eminent domain.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: And he gives me this check with more zeroes in it that I've ever seen.

transcript.speaker: Vigilant Citizen
transcript.text: Did you take it?

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: Damned right I did. These are hard times.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: Everyone else I know took the deal, too. We was told to keep it quiet. Not to create a needless panic.

transcript.speaker: Vigilant Citizen
transcript.text: Did you ever see any evidence of the radiation?

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: This is off-the-record. Like you said? Right?

transcript.speaker: Vigilant Citizen
transcript.text: Absolutely. You have my word.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: *grunt* Well, that's just it. I never saw any signs of anything dangerous.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: I got a couple cows that like grazing that aways. After the fence, I chased the cows off.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: But the damned animals always went back.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: Third time I caught them I gave up. Figured they were goners, anyhow.

transcript.speaker: Vigilant Citizen
transcript.text: So there's no evidence of anything suspicious?

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: No. Truth be told, I almost forgot about it. Except for the noise.

transcript.speaker: Vigilant Citizen
transcript.text: Noise?

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: Yeah, you can hear trucks coming and going every now and then. At the damnedest hours, too.

transcript.speaker: Gladys
transcript.text: A couple times I heard a train whistle, too. But that's about it.

transcript.text: Oh crap. Oh man. They weren't lyin'. It wasn't a story. There really is a... a thing down here.
Thought my mask was broken, and some kinda gas leak was gettin' in... Then I smelled it. Nearly puked up in my damn suit! Pretty sure I... woke it up...
Found some of that ore but when I hit it, it wasn't rock, it was... fleshy? Then came the noise, Jesus that noise...
Thought it was an earthquake til I saw it. (heavy breathing) shit... SHIT!
The wall moved, and had a mouth. Damn near pissed my pants! I don't care if that Ultracite stuff is down there.
(panicked breathing) I gotta warn people... Should I? Gotta keep moving.
No way I'm going near that, that thing again, it would take a nuke to get rid of it! I gotta get outta here. I gotta-
(creature screeching)
Oh God no-

items.name: Jesus Sunday's Holotape - Part 5

location.text: Given during Search Sunday Brothers Cabin.

items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: I... I don't even know how to say it... but JD's dead... I... I've murdered my own brother.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: After I found out he'd been stealing our supplies for Brianna Hawke, I couldn't wait, so I rushed out and found him scouting the ridge.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: I... I have a hard time remembering the rest.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: I don't know if he slipped, or I pushed too hard, but my brother... he fell... he's dead and it's all my fault.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: When Brianna found out what happened, she gathered her group and hit the cabin with everything they had. They wanted me dead.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: I killed them all, but they got in a lucky shot, and I don't think I'm going to last much longer. Probably better this way.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: This whole thing... what I did... it reminds me of a passage I read in the Bible once.

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: "Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer; and you know that no murderer has eternal life present in him."

transcript.speaker: Jesus Sunday
transcript.text: I guess... I proved that one right.

transcript.text: Lewisburg. A small town of big dreams, but just underneath that shining veneer lies and undercurrent of mystery and mischief.

transcript.text: Take one Calvin van Lowe as an example. Just your average--

transcript.speaker: Officer Sidney

transcript.speaker: Officer Klein
transcript.text: That a problem for you, Sidney? My novel needs this kind of professional realism.

transcript.speaker: Officer Sidney

transcript.speaker: Officer Sidney
transcript.text: Can we just head over to the Van Lowe place now? We need to interview the sister about his last known whereabouts.

transcript.speaker: Officer Klein
transcript.text: Family. The bonds that tie us, the roots that hold us. But also the key ingredient in... fratricide.

transcript.speaker: Officer Sidney
transcript.text: Knock it off! Let's get... hey. Check out that guy in the fancy suit. Ever seen him around here before?

transcript.speaker: Officer Sidney

items.name: Mort's Edu-Tape #01: Placing Your C.A.M.P.

location.text: Given during [W05 Holotapes] / Wastelander Mort Tutorial Quest 01.

items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Son of a-- what tiny-fisted rat built this... oh wait a sec, I think it's on. It's... Hello? Hello. This is Mort McCoy.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: And welcome to the first of Headmaster Mort's Edu-tapes! Today we're talking about your C.A.M.P.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Now, former vault resident or someone who killed a vault resident, let's start off with the basics - placing your C.A.M.P.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: When plunking down your camp -- C.A.M.P., that's an acronym -- for the first time, remember to... crap. Where'd that note... oh, here. Remember to take the lay of the land.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Consider the grade of the terrain, general defensibility, and proximity to your surroundings. Could that cliff edge be used to protect your flank?

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: You bet your chops it could! Once you've found the perfect spot, it's time to move on to the best part of working with your C.A.M.P. - construction!

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Construction can be an intricate process, so a steady hand and an eye for detainment... details... Damn, I had to get that one wrong! An eye for details are a must!

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: You should take a moment to familiarize yourself with the C.A.M.P.'s patented intuitive construction interface.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: But don't worry. We'll cover construction in gory detail in the next of Headmaster Mort's Edu-tapes! So long... "Bet your chops." Come on, Mort. What was that?

items.name: Mort's Edu-Tape #02: Building At Your C.A.M.P.

location.text: Given during [W05 Holotapes] / Wastelander Mort Tutorial Quest 02.

items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Hello dedicated listeners!

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Welcome back to Headmaster Mort's Edu-tapes. Today, in this second tape, we're talking construction.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Now, the first step of construction is-- Wait, what? Is that soda? ...soda's red, right? Oh! Electing! First electing what you're going to build.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Once you've made that election, it's just three easy questions to construction success:

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: One: is the location I've selected going to work for an object of the size and shape I'm building? Two: have I read the schematics thoroughly?

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: And three: do I have all the required materials to-- who the hell bled on my notes! Sol? If I find out that this was you, you're going to bleed on... whatever. Just finish, Mort.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Short on materials? Loot the local junkyard, mills, and warehouses for parts.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Missing a critical schematic? Your local vendors might have just what you're looking for!

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: And on that note, this has been Headmaster Mort's Edu-Tapes... Edu-Tapes... See you again soon... Solomon, so help me, this better be jam! Where are you hiding!?

items.name: Mort's Edu-Tape #03: Powering Your C.A.M.P.

location.text: Given during [W05 Holotapes] / Wastelander Mort Tutorial Quest 02.

items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Welcome back lovely listeners to Headmaster Mort's final tape in the C.A.M.P. series - powering your C.A.M.P.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: After listening to the second tape, you should already be well-trained enough to build a generator. If you haven't yet done so, I'll wait ...

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: ... ha doot doot doot doot doo, da doot doot doo .... ah, screw it.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Alright. I'll assume you nailed it. Now, generators are the heart of your C.A.M.P. power system.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Once your generator is built, all you need to do is connect it to the object that needs power with a wire.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Though be aware your wire will need a clear, unobstructed path to establish and maintain a direct connection.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Some objects, however, like simple light bulbs, do not require a direct connection.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: All you need to do is run a wire from your generator to a power pylon, place the power pylon near your lights. Then, voila! Let there be light.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Well, this has been Headmaster Mort's C.A.M.P. construction holotapes.

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: Please check back with Headmaster Mort himself at The Wayward to learn more about his other exciting courses including ...

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: ... "Mort, Can I Still Eat This?" and "Mutations: Am I a Monster Now?"

transcript.speaker: Mort
transcript.text: And thanks again for listening... heh. Nailed it.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Gasped breathing, coming to a rest)

transcript.text: ... Will yet restore me to the vital air... Death feeds on my mute voice, and laughs at our despair...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Pained laughter, coughing)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Loud rumbles in the distance, sirens)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: The leprous corpse, touched by this spirit tender exhales itself ... in flowers of gentle breath...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice

transcript.text: ... and... mock the merry worm that wake beneath! (coughing)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: The intense atom glows a moment... then is quenched in a most cold repose!

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice

items.name: Protocol Adonais #3

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Oh shit, it's really you.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (rasp) Yeah... Hi... Ray.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: We tried looking for you, we all knew you weren't... But, ya know, things... happened.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: ... I'm really happy you're all right.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: If you can call this... (cough) all right... I guess... Listen, Ray. Laura, she's (cough)...

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Stop. I appreciate what you're saying, but stop. She's coming back, man.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: No, I mean, I--

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Enough, Cal. It's good to see you. There's extra supplies in the living room. I haven't heard any break-ins, so they should still be there.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Take what you need... And get out of here. Appalachia, I mean. These hills, they... It...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: I know...

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: No, I mean... it was real, Cal. It... did this to me.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: I... know.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Do me a favor? Grab me a bottle of the good stuff from downstairs before you go? I'd get it myself, but...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: One step (cough) ahead of you...

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: You're the best, Cal... Take care of yourself, okay?

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: You can... come with me... you know?

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Any minute, Cal. She'll be back any minute.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: ... Good bye, Ray.

items.name: Protocol Adonais #4
