transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: (Inhale) (exhale) Ah! Appa-la-chi-yuh!

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Whoa, watch it, smoothskin.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Sorry, just needed a little stretch to go with that delicious, boggy air.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Also, I assure you, the skin under here ain't so smooth, Genie.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Don't call me that-- and yeah, whatever, figure of speech. You seem extra chipper, today.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Oh... That's right. You're a local here. Been a spell since you've been home?

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Oh, more than a spell, my trigger-happy undead friend.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: I swear to god, Aries--

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: This step is the first time my feet hath graced these gentle grounds in my decades long absence.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: You're not listening... Okay, Aries, I'm moving ahead.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Your wayward son returns, you slumbering beast of mists and mystery!

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Re-sculpted and carved into something new, I retread my old grounds with a fresh gleam in my eye, shining brighter than an atomic flash!

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Oh, brother...

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: ... That reminds me, why now?

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: What?

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: You've been on the Kentucky routes since you started. I thought you enjoyed it there. Why come back now?

transcript.speaker: Aries

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Uh... Look I don't know if you heard about that whole Scorched thing, but, well...

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Fear not. My family is here now.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Whatever you say, Aries. Let's go.

items.name: Protocol Adonais #6

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Carver. It's Aries. Look, I know we've had some weird... uh... encounters. I mean, even weird by my standards.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: There's something about me-- about us-- that I want to tell you. That you... and your family... deserves to know.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: My name is Calvin van Lowe. I'm the brother of your mom, Shelley. I know she ain't your birth mom, but that still makes you family.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Take a listen to these tapes, if you need the proof. Show them to your mom, she'll know.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: I'm not planning to up and change my life again. I am who I am now. No going back on that.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: But... I'm hoping, maybe... Maybe someday I can start repairing some bridges. And maybe you can help me with that.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: If... you think that's right. You know Shelley, er, your mom better than I do. Sorry to spring this on ya, kid.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: And P.S. - If you call me "Uncle Calvin," I'll leave you in a hole so deep in Big Bend they'll never hear you scream.

transcript.text: Convert report status: ten new recruits picked up by The Blood.

transcript.text: It was actually twenty, boss. Wasn't it?

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: We only count the survivors, Ted.

transcript.speaker: Blood Eagle
transcript.text: Oh! My official Blood Eagle name is now The Horn.

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: *sighs* Really? Fine. We only count the survivors, Horn.

transcript.speaker: Blood Eagle
transcript.text: No like... The Horn. Not Horn. You know? Like The Claw, The Blood...

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: You have to earn a "The" around here, Horn.

transcript.speaker: Blood Eagle
transcript.text: But... but... okay. Fine. What's your name? I'll use that one! In honor of you!

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: I am literally going to murder you.

transcript.speaker: Blood Eagle
transcript.text: But... but... okay. How about... The Bloodiest Eagle of them All!

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: Okay. Bloodiest Eagle. Please wait in the hallway while I finish the report.

transcript.speaker: Blood Eagle
transcript.text: Guard the door, kill any intruders. I can do this!

transcript.speaker: Background
transcript.text: *door closes*

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: *heavy sigh*

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: I think we need to ditch the whole "naming" thing. It's getting out of hand.

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: I will also need a new... assistant.

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: Ten survived the chems with no issue. Nine had reactions and were disposed of. One has been sent to see The Eye.

transcript.speaker: The Eye's Executioner
transcript.text: Oh, right. Better send someone to clean up the mess after their session is complete.

transcript.speaker: Gerald Whitehead
transcript.text: Maude.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Jerry. To what do I owe the pleasure?

transcript.speaker: Gerald Whitehead
transcript.text: Not a social call, Maude. They're coming.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: You want to be more specific? They who?

transcript.speaker: Gerald Whitehead
transcript.text: BADTFL.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: The Bureau of Alcohol, Drugs, and No Fun is paying Welch a visit? Says who?

transcript.speaker: Gerald Whitehead
transcript.text: Says me, Duchess. You need to skip town ASAP.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: You're a crooked cop, Gerald. Associating with known smugglers of firearms and illicit substances. How can you be trusted?

transcript.speaker: Gerald Whitehead
transcript.text: Why are you making this so hard? I'm trying to keep you out of jail.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: Gerald, please. This hurts to watch. Can we just be honest with each other? I'll start.

transcript.speaker: Gerald Whitehead
transcript.text: What're you...

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: My friends, plural, at the bureau say you've been making some big claims about this Appalachian drug kingpin you're about to bring in.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: The one you're trying to get rid of so your new friends from Charleston can take her territory.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: But wouldn't you know, all that extra yammering got them looking into your finances. And your house. And your car. And they didn't like what they found.

transcript.speaker: Duchess
transcript.text: So yes, Gerald, they're coming. But no one's coming looking for me.

items.name: Wanted: Sheepsquatch
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Hello. I assume you're listening to me now because you followed the poster. Well, I'm Shelley van Lowe and I'm looking for my brother.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Let me spoil the surprise now: my brother wasn't eaten by a damn Sheepsquatch, or at least, I doubt that's the case.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: But I think Calvin's obsession with proving it exists may have more than a little to do with his disappearance.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Calvin is... not right. Never been. When he suddenly showed up in town after years of being away, I knew there was something strange going on.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Next thing I know, he's vanished. All his belongings still here, him: gone. But it doesn't feel right, he didn't just move out again.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: I contacted the police about trying to find him, but the war broke out and... well, I'm sure you know how it all went.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: So, I'll get to the point: I'm leaving Lewisburg, I don't have a choice. But, I can't just forget Calvin.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: If you think you can help, then please... Head up to the office on the third floor. See if you can pick up his trail.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: If Calvin is still out there, he needs to know I'm looking for him. And if he's not... well, I think that's something I need to know, too.
